article.articleHeadline: 현대바이오, '제프티' 국내 SFTS 2상 추진⋯치료제 공백 노린다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hyundai Bio advances Phase 2 trial in Korea for SFTS with 'Jepti', aiming to fill the treatment gap.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-13, Hyundai Bio Science announced at the Seoul Korea Press Center that Jepti, an oral host-targeting antiviral with improved niclosamide absorption, will enter Phase 2 in Korea for Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS). SFTS is a tick-borne disease with Korea’s domestic fatality around 18–20% and no approved therapy. Jepti targets host cell processes required for viral replication, aiming to overcome viral mutation and resistance. The candidate is also in dengue trials in Vietnam. Korea Phase 2 enrollment will rely on prior human and nonclinical data. Supporting results cited include: in a COVID-19 cohort (~300), steady-state plasma concentration over five days averaged 0.28 μM, above the 0.125 μM EC50 for SFTS inhibition; and a 13-week repeat-dose toxicity test showed no adverse effects at the maximum non-toxic dose. Given SFTS seasonality (April–November) and domestic cases, MFDS pre-submission discussions are planned. They also referenced Japan’s Favipiravir-Avigan approval as urgency context.

triage.headline_ja: 現代バイオサイエンス、SFTS治療薬「ジェプティ」の国内第2相試験を推進…治療薬の空白を狙う
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は韓国企業によるSFTS治療薬（ジェプティ）の臨床試験進捗に関する創薬ニュースであり、新規感染症の発生や異常な流行を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は治療薬開発（第2相試験）に関する企業発表であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。韓国・日本は対象国リストに含まれず、ベトナムは別薬剤のデング熱治験実施国として言及されているのみで、実際の感染症発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 俄羅斯爆鼠疫及大陸是否有相關疫情？ 卓榮泰：兩岸往來密切 全面監控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia reports a plague outbreak; is there a related outbreak in Mainland China? Cho Jung-tai: Cross-strait exchanges are close; comprehensive monitoring.
article.articleSummary: Russia reports a suspected plague death with no laboratory-confirmed pathogen yet; no confirmed human cases identified. Plague can be bubonic, pneumonic, or septicemic; pneumonic plague transmits via droplets and can spread rapidly, with mortality up to 60% even with antibiotics. Taiwan’s government expresses high-level concern, instructing the Ministry of Health and Welfare to liaise with the WHO and closely monitor Russia’s situation. Given Taiwan-China exchanges, authorities are implementing comprehensive surveillance of cross-strait personnel movement and preventive measures via the small three-links. The Premier noted a related briefing two weeks ago and reinforced ongoing monitoring of international outbreak developments; as of now, no related outbreak is confirmed in Mainland China. Authorities will continue to track imported/exported risk and laboratory findings through international collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト流行発生、中国大陸関連の流行はあるか？卓栄泰氏：両岸往来は密接、全面的に監視
triage.triage_reason: ロシアで疑いのあるペスト死亡例が報告され、肺ペストはヒト-ヒト感染による急速な拡大と高致死率のリスクがあるため、IHR基準のうち重篤性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの3項目が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアでの疑いペスト死亡例であり、台湾政府が両岸（中国大陸）との往来に関する監視体制を強化しているが、中国大陸での確定症例は報告されていない。台湾・ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Madagascar Reports 3 Suspected Plague Deaths in South
article.articleSummary: Three suspected pneumonic plague deaths in Madagascar’s Andranolalina, Midongy Atsimo district, with two more patients under treatment, all from one elderly couple and their grandchild. Lab confirmation pending; samples sent to Institut Pasteur de Madagascar in Antananarivo. Ministry reported on 12 October 2026; rapid diagnostic tests reportedly positive. Nearly 200 contacts have received preventive antibiotics; about 15 homes disinfected and insecticide sprayed to kill fleas; ongoing contact tracing and local awareness efforts; extra staff, medicines, rapid tests, and a mobile laboratory dispatched. Begogo near Iakora has three suspected bubonic plague cases from last week’s vaccination campaign; bubonic is flea-borne and less transmissible person-to-person. Midongy Atsimo is a known plague zone with peak cases Sept–Dec; distance to clinics and rapid-test shortages hinder case finding. US risk is low, though global cases mainly originate from Madagascar and the DRC (2019–2025).

triage.headline_ja: マダガスカル南部でペスト疑い3例の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が複数発生し、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクがある感染症であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本イベントはマダガスカル（対象国リスト外）で発生しており、DRCは過去の流行地域として言及されているのみで本記事の主題ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。肺ペストは歴史的に国際的関心を集めやすい疾患であり、感染拡大の推移を要継続監視。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Flu di Singapura Tertinggi Sejak 2024, Kunjungan di IGD Nanjak Imbas Karhutla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu Cases in Singapore Highest Since 2024, ED Visits at Nanjak Affected by Forest and Land Fires.
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Singapore is at its highest level since 2024, driven by haze from Indonesia's forest and land fires. Weekly CDA data show 44% of tested respiratory samples were influenza-positive for Sept 27–Oct 3, 2026, more than double the 20% in early August and the highest since tracking began in February 2024. MOH says facilities have haze-response plans and adequate medical supplies, with ongoing stock monitoring. SGH pulmonology chief Dr Chew Si Yuan says influenza is now the main cause of respiratory infections, with cases this month 2–3 times usual, triggering measures: reallocation of staff, use of air purifiers, closing windows/doors of non-AC wards, and intensified monitoring for high‑risk patients. The elderly, children, pregnant women, and those with heart or lung disease are advised to limit exposure. A Duke-NUS–SGH study (2016–2022) links PM2.5 spikes to more ED visits for asthma and chronic lung disease; effects may appear within two days.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポールのインフルエンザ症例数、2024年以来最高に―森林・泥炭火災によるヘイズの影響でERへの来院急増
triage.triage_reason: シンガポールでインフルエンザ陽性率が2024年の統計開始以来最高となり、ヘイズを背景にER来院が通常の2〜3倍に増加、病院が人員再配置等の対応を取っていることから、異常性・重症度・継続的曝露の観点でスクリーニング基準に該当し、保健当局の対応も報じられている。
triage.notes: イベントの主体はシンガポールでの季節性インフルエンザ増加（ヘイズが誘因）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシアは火災・ヘイズの発生源として言及されているが、インフルエンザ症例自体はシンガポールで発生しているため、インドネシアはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội cảnh báo nguy cơ tăng ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết dù số ca giảm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi warns of the risk of a dengue outbreak rising even as the number of cases declines.
article.articleSummary: 3,946 dengue cases in Hanoi across 119 wards/communes since the start of 2026, with 15 new dengue outbreaks identified in districts such as Thanh Oai, Chuong My, Duong Noi, Dai Mo, Ha Dong, Hoang Mai, Lang, and Ngoc Hoi. Cumulative outbreaks reach 177, of which 35 remain active. In the same period, 269 hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) cases were recorded this week, bringing the annual total to 5,727 with 95 outbreaks, 6 active. Rabies: a dog-origin outbreak reported in Doai Phuong commune; four people exposed and treated with post-exposure prophylaxis; Hanoi has recorded 9 dog rabies outbreaks this year. Measles: 6 cases this week; cumulative 406. COVID-19: 5 cases this week; cumulative 1,660. CDC Hanoi expands surveillance, targets 20 communes for dengue prevention, strengthens environmental sanitation, larviciding and mosquito control from September to November, and urges vaccination and animal-health coordination.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、デング熱症例数は減少も新規発生地の増加リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: ハノイにおけるデング熱・HFMD・狂犬病・麻疹等の季節性サーベイランス報告であり、重篤度や国際的拡大の兆候は見られないが、デング熱の新規発生地増加や蚊媒介感染の継続曝露の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 複数疾患（デング熱、HFMD、狂犬病、麻疹、COVID-19）の定例サーベイランス報告。CDCハノイが監視強化と予防対策を実施中であり、通常の季節性公衆衛生管理活動の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Tim Ekspedisi Patriot ITB kenalkan pencegahan TBC lewat buku cerita di Yapsi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ITB Patriot Expedition Team Introduces TB Prevention Through a Storybook in Yapsi.
article.articleSummary: TB prevention education was conducted for students at Kwarja State Preparatory Elementary School in Yapsi District, Jayapura Regency, Papua, Indonesia, by Tim 12 and Tim 15 of ITB Patriot Expedition (TEP ITB). Under the theme 'Know How to Prevent TB and Practice Clean and Healthy Living Behaviors (PHBS),' sessions used a storytelling book 'Aku Kan Sehat, Kenapa Harus Minum Obat?' and videos, including 'Petualangan Si Kuman' and a proper handwashing demonstration. After viewing, students engaged in Q&A, practiced coughing and sneezing etiquette, and joined PHBS-related activities and a handwashing chant game. The activity concluded with reflections and the TB mantra 'Find, Treat, Until Cured' to reinforce recognizing TB and completing treatment. ITB TEP aims to boost TB prevention understanding and PHBS adoption in schools and homes. Tim 12 was led by Yangie Dwi Marga Pinanga; Tim 15 by Abdul Rohman Supandi.

article.articleHeadline: Rusia Gempar Kasus Pes Pneumonik, Pakar Ingatkan Indonesia Tetap Harus Waspada |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia Shocked by Pneumonic Plague Case, Experts Warn Indonesia Must Remain Vigilant | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-13, Russia’s Irkutsk, Siberia reports a suspected plague outbreak with the death of a laboratory worker tied to Yersinia pestis exposure, triggering concerns about pneumonic plague. Indonesia's Ministry of Health has increased vigilance at entry points in anticipation of possible spread. Clinically oriented microbiologist Prof. Tri Wibawa of Universitas Gadjah Mada notes that plague is a bacterial infection primarily transmitted by fleas from wild rodents; transmission is also possible through direct contact with infected animal fluids or tissues, and via droplets. Pneumonic plague, the most severe form, involves lung infection and can spread between humans through droplets or from animals to humans via droplets. To mitigate risk, Prof. Wibawa emphasizes continuous surveillance for Y. pestis in vectors—especially rats—and urges intensified rodent control near human settings. The article notes that Indonesia has had no confirmed human plague cases for decades.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで肺ペスト症例発生、専門家はインドネシアに警戒継続を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの実験室関連と見られるペスト死亡例が報告されているが、対象国であるインドネシアでは確定症例はなく水際警戒強化に留まるため、現時点ではフルRRAに進むには情報不足。
triage.notes: 事案の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシアでは確定症例なく、保健省が水際対策を強化しているのみのため、記事主題国としては対象国に該当しない。続報（実際の感染拡大や確定症例の有無）を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Macau e Hong Kong reforçam rastreio após morte por "pneumonia" na Rússia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Macau and Hong Kong step up screening after death from "pneumonia" in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Macau and Hong Kong intensified border screening for travelers from the Irkutsk region in Siberia, Russia, after a researcher from an Institute of Pneumonic Plague Research died of pneumonia of unknown origin. Travelers who spent 14 days in Irkutsk must voluntarily declare this on arrival to Macau and undergo medical screening; anyone with suspect pneumonia will be immediately transferred to a public hospital. Macau will reinforce border temperature checks and health assessments, with ongoing monitoring and cooperation with the WHO. In Russia, Rospotrebnadzor reported the death of researcher Daria Shipilova, 28; preliminary tests found two COVID-19 and two rhinovirus infections among nearly 5,000 contacts, with no pathogenic organism detected and no epidemic risk in Irkutsk. The WHO has been urged to enhance transparency; Hong Kong also tightened airport checks as the US, China, and Mongolia sought details on the potential threat.

triage.headline_ja: マカオと香港、ロシアでの原因不明「肺炎」による死亡を受け検疫を強化
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所の研究者が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、複数国（マカオ・香港・中国・モンゴル・米国）が懸念を示し渡航者スクリーニングを強化しており、IHR基準（異常性・渡航制限）が2項目該当するため。
triage.notes: 死亡例および検体検査はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。マカオ・香港・中国は検疫強化等の対応のみで、当該感染症の発生事例は報告されていないため verified_locations には含めなかった。ロシア当局はイルクーツクでの流行リスクはないと発表している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 현대바이오, '살인진드기병' 치료제 도전...제프티 임상 2상 추진
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hyundai Bio Takes on Treatment for 'Deadly Tick Disease'... Jepti to Enter Phase 2 Clinical Trials
article.articleSummary: Hyundai BioScience in Seoul aims to fast-track Jefti (XAFTY, CP-COV03), a niclosamide-based antiviral with drug-delivery tech, for severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS). Instead of new compounds, they leverage existing COVID-19 clinical data to support an IND with Korea’s MFDS and enter Phase 2 after clinician and regulator input. In vitro SFTS inhibition has been observed; animal data show 100% survival at relevant exposure, reproduced in their formulation. Five-day dosing maintained blood levels above the antiviral threshold in patients, supporting Phase 2 progression. SFTS in Korea has high mortality—about 18% overall, 26.1% among those aged 70+, with 280 cases and 41 deaths last year; healthcare workers accounted for 97% of secondary infections. Japan approved favipiravir for SFTS in 2024 (15.8% fatality). Hyundai is also pursuing dengue in Vietnam, US talks on respiratory pathogens and Ebola, and expansion to vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: 現代バイオサイエンス、「殺人ダニ病」治療薬に挑戦...ジェプティ第2相臨床試験を推進
triage.triage_reason: 製薬企業によるSFTS治療薬の臨床開発に関する企業ニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクイベントを報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国の製薬企業による抗ウイルス薬（Jepti/XAFTY）のSFTS治療に関する臨床試験計画についての企業発表記事。韓国自体は対象国リストに含まれず、ベトナムのデング熱言及も将来的な事業展開の文脈であり、実際の発生イベントの記述ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Macau e Hong Kong reforçam rastreio após morte por "pneumonia desconhecida" na Rússia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Macau and Hong Kong step up screening after death from 'unknown pneumonia' in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, Macau and Hong Kong intensified border screening for travelers from the Irkutsk region in Siberia after a Russian researcher died from pneumonia of unknown origin. The death, announced on 5 October, occurred at the Institute of Plague Research in Shelekhov, Irkutsk region. Macau's Health Services (SSM) will require travelers to complete a health declaration on entry and will immediately hospitalize anyone with suspected unknown-origin pneumonia for evaluation and tests; border screening will be enhanced with temperature checks and health assessments. Officials say the immediate risk to Macau remains low, with ongoing monitoring alongside the World Health Organization. Hong Kong also boosted checks for arrivals from Russia. Russia’s health agency stated no plague and reported two COVID-19 and two rhinovirus infections among close contacts; nearly 5,000 tests found no dangerous pathogen, with the WHO seeking more transparency.

triage.headline_ja: マカオと香港、ロシアでの『原因不明肺炎』による死亡を受け検疫を強化
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所関連施設で原因不明肺炎による死亡が発生し、マカオ・香港が国境検疫を強化するなど渡航制限的措置が取られており、IHR基準（異常性・渡航制限）の2項目に該当するためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 実際の感染症イベント（原因不明肺炎による死亡）はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。マカオ・香港（中国）は検疫強化などの対応措置を取っているのみで、現地での発症・流行は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア当局はペストを否定し、濃厚接触者からはCOVID-19およびライノウイルスのみ検出、約5000件の検査で危険な病原体は検出されていないと報告。WHOは透明性向上を求めている。

article.articleHeadline: 俄羅斯爆鼠疫傳聞 卓榮泰：緊盯當地疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rumors of a plague outbreak in Russia: Zhuo Rong-tai says he is monitoring the local outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, Siberia, Russia, reports a laboratory researcher’s death suspected to be caused by plague, triggering international concern. Taiwan’s Premier Zhuo Rong-tai said the government, two weeks ago, instructed the Ministry of Health and Welfare to closely liaise with international organizations and monitor Russia for any outbreak, while China-related cases are also under note with reinforced mobility controls on the Taiwan-China small three-link routes. The Ministry of Health and Welfare, via the Foreign Ministry, has consulted the WHO to verify the cause; to date, no pathogen or related samples have tested positive, leaving plague unconfirmed. Plague can be bubonic, pneumonic, or septicemic; pneumonic plague spreads by droplets and carries up to ~60% mortality, though antibiotics exist. Taiwan will maintain heightened monitoring and inform residents and businesspeople traveling to China as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト流行の噂、卓栄泰氏「現地疫情を注視」
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアで研究者の死亡がペスト感染疑いとされ、台湾政府がWHOに確認を依頼するなど国際的懸念が高まっており、渡航管理強化も行われているためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア（シベリア）での研究者死亡疑いが中心であり、ロシア・台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。中国については『関連ケースも注視』との記述のみで、実際の発生事実は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。病原体の確認（ペストかどうか）は未了であり、続報の精査が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Российская туристка потеряла способность говорить после укуса комара во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Russian tourist lost her ability to speak after a mosquito bite in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-13, Mash reports a Russian woman doctor on vacation in Vietnam who developed dengue fever. After initial headache and fever, her condition deteriorated with epistaxis, severe pruritus on her palms and soles, and a critically low platelet count requiring urgent hospitalization. Six days into treatment in a Vietnamese hospital, she remains severely ill, with a widespread rash, marked fatigue, and temporary loss of speech. Dengue fever is an acute viral illness transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; in severe cases it can cause internal bleeding, persistent vomiting, and respiratory failure. The article documents her clinical course, laboratory finding of thrombocytopenia, and ongoing management in Vietnam. No additional imported/exported case details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人観光客、ベトナムで蚊に刺された後に発話能力を失う
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで流行地域病であるデング熱に罹患した単一の渡航者症例であり、アウトブレイクや異常事象を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの流行地域病であり、本記事は個人の重症化事例を報じる人間ドラマ的記事。公衆衛生上の新規シグナルとは判断されない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれず、ベトナムも単一輸入症例のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda secures 3,000 Ebola vaccine trial doses
article.articleSummary: Uganda is conducting a Phase I trial of the ChAdOx BDBV vaccine candidate for Bundibugyo Ebola Virus disease in Masaka City, having received part of 3,000 investigational doses allocated for the Uganda study. The trial is led by the MRC/UVRI & LSHTM Uganda Research Unit in partnership with the Oxford Vaccine Group and Pandemic Science Institute, with CEPI funding for both Uganda and the UK studies. A parallel UK trial is assessing safety and immune response. ChAdOx BDBV was developed by University of Oxford; production and quality testing supplied by the Clinical Biomanufacturing Facility. Serum Institute of India has manufactured and stockpiled about 620,000 doses, delivering 300 vials to the UK and roughly 3,000 investigational doses for Uganda. Uganda has previously contained Bundibugyo Ebola within its borders; meanwhile DR Congo reports the fastest-growing, deadliest Ebola outbreak, highlighting the vaccine need.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラワクチン治験用に3,000回分を確保
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウガンダでのエボラワクチン（ChAdOx BDBV）第I相治験に関するニュースであり、新規の感染拡大事案ではない。ただしDRCで進行中の深刻なエボラ流行への対応文脈であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのワクチン治験であり、ウガンダ・インド・英国は対象国リスト外または製造拠点としての言及のみ。DRCは現在進行中の深刻なエボラ流行国として本文中で明示的に言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Mambasa : cinq enseignants par école bientôt formés à la prévention d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mambasa: Five teachers per school will soon be trained in Ebola prevention - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola prevention training for five teachers per school will be rolled out in Mambasa, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as part of ongoing Ebola risk measures. The initiative covers 137 schools: 12 nursery, 84 primary and 41 secondary. After the training, these schools will receive handwashing kits and thermoflash devices to improve hygiene and fever screening. In the meantime, school administrators have been urged to install handwashing facilities at classroom entrances and around school premises and to procure thermoflash thermometers to screen students before entry. Dieudonné Asaba, head of the Mambasa 1 provincial sub-division (EDUC-NC), announced the plan in northeastern DRC to protect students and staff during the Ebola epidemic period.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサ：各学校の教員5名が近くエボラ予防研修を受講へ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既存のDRCエボラ流行期間中における学校での予防研修・衛生対策に関する記事であり、新規感染拡大や症例数の情報は含まれていないため、進行中の流行状況として継続注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行期間中の学校での予防教育・衛生対策（手洗い設備、体温スクリーニング）の導入に関する行政的対応報道であり、新規感染者数や症例詳細の記載はない。既存のDRCエボラ流行（イトゥリ州）の継続的な対応状況として扱うべきで、最新の疫学状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Program Speling Pemprov Jateng Fasilitasi Warga Periksa TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Java Provincial Government's Speling Program Facilitates Residents in Undergoing TB Screening
article.articleSummary: On 13 October 2026 in Sukodono Village, Tahunan District, Jepara Regency, Central Java, the Speling (Dokter Spesialis Keliling) program integrated with Free Health Check (CKG) facilitated TB screening through Active Case Finding (ACF). The event, attended by Central Java Secretary Sumarno, Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus, and Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Akhmad Wiyagus, aimed to locate TB cases in the community. Participants underwent sputum smear testing for acid-fast bacilli, chest X-ray, blood pressure and height measurements, and additional laboratory tests as needed. Residents such as Dina Amelia, who has TB in her family, and Nurhamidah, with prior chest symptoms, highlighted early detection and transmission prevention. Public Health Center Tahunan’s Pramita Sukti Setyarini emphasized tracing of contacts—symptomatic and non-symptomatic—especially close contacts of confirmed TB cases. Routine monthly TB screening, including contact tracing, is planned, with data entered into the Satu Sehat system, and services co-located with Speling.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ジャワ州政府のスペリンプログラム、住民の結核検査を支援
triage.triage_reason: これは既存の結核対策プログラム（積極的症例発見）の通常実施に関する報道であり、異常な集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地方流行病であり、本記事は政府主導のスクリーニングプログラムの紹介に過ぎず、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。政府関係者（副保健大臣等）の出席はあるが、これはプログラム宣伝目的であり、緊急対応ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : l'application stricte des mesures barrières contre Ebola recommandée à la population - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Strict implementation of barrier measures against Ebola recommended to the population - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 13, 2026, Kisangani in Tshopo Province, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, urged strict adherence to barrier measures to curb an Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak. The governor stated the disease remains active and continues to claim lives, calling on opinion leaders, religious leaders, journalists, health workers and teachers to educate communities about the dangers. Measures include a ban on the circulation of corpses, limits on public gatherings, hygiene requirements, and the creation of a provincial outbreak-response coordination body. He noted resistance from segments of the population, with assaults on health workers and destruction of response equipment. Sanctions have been or may be imposed on public and private facilities handling suspected or confirmed EVD cases without notifying the response teams. The provincial government, health ministry and provincial health division pledged to sustain control efforts with central government and partners, urging households to protect relatives by rigorous preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:エボラ出血熱に対する予防措置の厳格な適用を住民に勧告 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な死亡例と地域での流行が報告されており、コンゴ民主共和国での公衆衛生上の脅威として国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 住民の抵抗や医療従事者への暴力など、対応の困難さを示す要素があり、状況の悪化が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Kabut Asap Selimuti Banggai, Dinkes Ingatkan Warga Waspadai 4 Jenis Penyakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Smog Blankets Banggai, Health Office Reminds Residents to Beware of Four Types of Diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, smog blankets Banggai Regency in Central Sulawesi, prompting the Banggai Health Office to warn residents about four diseases linked to haze and hot, dry conditions. Acting Head Nurmasita Datu Adam says weather changes are driving Acute Respiratory Infection (ARI) symptoms such as cough, runny nose, and sore throat from dry air. They also cite gastrointestinal illnesses like diarrhea and cholera due to limited access to clean water, dengue fever from water stored in uncovered containers, and dehydration from heat exposure. Officials urge reducing outdoor activity, wearing masks outdoors, increasing water intake, and sealing water storage; advocate 3M: drain, cover, bury water containers. People with symptoms should seek care at nearby health facilities. Emphasis is on prevention in Luwuk, Luwuk Utara, and Luwuk Selatan.

triage.headline_ja: バンガイ県に煙害、保健局が住民に4種類の病気への注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例報告や発生ではなく、煙害（スモッグ）に伴う一般的な健康注意喚起であり、コレラ・デング熱の実際の発生を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の症例数や発生状況を報告しておらず、保健局による予防的注意喚起のみ。コレラ・デング熱の実発生情報がないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Pune Records 2,391 Dengue Cases From June To September, PMC Steps Up Checks
article.articleSummary: Post-monsoon dengue remains a public health concern in Pune as October heat and humidity sustain Aedes breeding. From June to September, PMC logged over 1,700 suspected dengue cases and 662 in September; total confirmed between June and September reached 2,391 (including patients outside PMC limits), with 256 confirmed in September. Testing relied on IgM and NS1 ELISA. Ward hotspots included Kothrud (229), Nagar Road–Vadgaon Sheri (222) and Aundh–Baner (212); September tallies were led by Aundh–Baner (107), Nagar Road–Vadgaon Sheri (83) and Kothrud (80). Keshavnagar rose from 11 in August to 49 in September. Complications—serositis, dengue hepatitis, dengue shock syndrome and thrombocytopenia—are rising; delayed hospitalisation worsens outcomes. Early testing and timely hospitalisation are advised. The PMC intensified inspections and used biological larvicides; preventive measures must continue through winter. As of Oct 8, 96 suspected and 25 confirmed cases had been reported, with no chikungunya increase.

triage.headline_ja: プネー、6月から9月にかけてデング熱2,391例を記録、PMCが対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行で国際的拡大リスクは低いが、症例数増加や合併症（デング性肝炎、ショック症候群等）の増加が報告されており、動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: インド・プネー市における季節性デング熱流行。毎年繰り返されるパターンだが、合併症増加や特定地区（Keshavnagar等）での急増が見られる。地元自治体（PMC）が主体的に対応しており、国際支援の必要性は現時点で示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 치명률 18%인데도 속수무책 '살인진드기병' 치료제 임상 2상 추진
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Despite an 18% mortality rate, helpless, Phase 2 clinical trial for 'Killer Tick Disease' treatment advances.
article.articleSummary: Tick-borne Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) in Korea has a cumulative fatality rate around 18%, rising above 25% in patients aged 70+ with underlying conditions. At a Cheongju hospital last summer, 9 physicians involved in CPR for an SFTS patient experienced 2nd infections; 7 were reinfected, underscoring dangerous nosocomial transmission, with about 97% of domestic secondary SFTS infections occurring in healthcare workers. There is no approved antiviral or vaccine; management remains supportive. Hyundai BioScience announced advancing Jepti, a niclosamide-based antiviral delivered by a drug-delivery system to boost systemic absorption, into Phase 2 domestic trials for SFTS. Prior evidence includes cell studies and a multicenter COVID-19 trial showing symptom improvement and reduced viral load. In Japan, Favipiravir is approved for SFTS, highlighting urgent needs. Korea will refine protocols with MFDS and draw on Vietnam’s National Hospital for Tropical Diseases dengue experience to accelerate trials.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率18%にもかかわらず手の打ちようがない「殺人ダニ病」治療薬、臨床2相試験推進
triage.triage_reason: SFTSの致死率が18%と高く、医療従事者間での二次感染（院内感染）が確認されるなど異常な感染動態が見られるため、IHR基準の2項目以上に該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国（忠清北道・清州市）でのSFTS治療薬開発に関する内容であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。日本・ベトナムへの言及は治療薬開発の参考事例であり、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。
