article.articleHeadline: Lo nhập viện do cúm A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over hospitalization due to Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A hospitalizations are rising in Vietnam as seasonal transitions bring more respiratory illness. In Ho Chi Minh City, 59-year-old Nguyen Van Hung and 70-year-old Nguyen Thanh Hung sought influenza vaccination after reading reports of severe Influenza A cases that require hospitalization. In Hanoi, 68-year-old Tran Thi Hoa, with diabetes, was previously hospitalized for Influenza A three years ago, developed pneumonia and needed oxygen, and now follows annual vaccination. The National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases reports increasing flu admissions, with Influenza A predominating; VNVC notes circulating subtypes A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B. High-risk groups include older adults and people with chronic conditions such as diabetes, COPD, heart or kidney disease; vaccination is advised, typically one dose per year, with immunity developing about two weeks. Some countries use high-dose vaccines; co-infections with pneumococcus, RSV, or SARS-CoV-2 can occur. Preventive measures include masks, hand hygiene, and vaccinating family members.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAによる入院の懸念
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAによる入院増加を報じる内容で、高齢者や基礎疾患患者への注意喚起が中心だが、異常な流行拡大やアウトブレイクの明確な兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、ワクチン接種推奨が主旨。重症度やアウトブレイクの規模についての具体的数値は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: [바이오현장] 치명률 18%인데 치료제 '0'...현대바이오, '살인진드기병'에 정면 도전 - 이비엔(EBN)뉴스센터
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Bio Field] An 18% mortality rate, but zero treatments... Hyundai Bio takes on 'Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome' (SFTS) head-on - EBN News Center.
article.articleSummary: Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) in Korea carries an 18% cumulative mortality, with no approved disease-specific therapy. Hyundai BioScience declares Phase 2 entry for CP-COV03 (Gefti), a host-targeted universal antiviral, to address SFTS and outlines a full development roadmap after MFDS discussions. SFTS is tick-borne; Korea last year recorded 280 confirmed cases and 41 deaths, with 96 cases through September this year. Elderly patients face 26.1% mortality. Secondary infections are predominantly among healthcare workers (97%), including a Cheongju hospital ICU outbreak where seven staff were infected during CPR. Current care is supportive; no approved antivirals exist. Preclinical/clinical data, including Microbiology Spectrum findings, support efficacy. Hyundai BioUSA, a MCDC member, cites collaboration with U.S. agencies; domestic experience with dengue trials in Vietnam informs accelerated Phase 2. SFTS is seasonal (4–11 months) with Asia-wide spread risk, potentially expanding due to climate-driven tick ecology.

triage.headline_ja: [バイオ現場] 致死率18%なのに治療薬「ゼロ」...現代バイオ、『殺人ダニ病(SFTS)』に正面挑戦
triage.triage_reason: 記事は韓国で季節性に発生する既知感染症SFTSに関する製薬企業の治験進捗報道であり、対象国リストに韓国・ベトナムとも実質的な発生国として該当しないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は韓国内で発生するSFTS（マダニ媒介性感染症）に対する現代バイオサイエンスの治療薬開発動向。ベトナムはデング熱の治験実施国として言及されているのみで、ベトナム国内でのアウトブレイク発生を示す記述はない。韓国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Isiro : la plupart des cas proviennent de Bas-Uele (Un médecin) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Isiro: Most Cases Come from Bas-Uele (A Doctor) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Isiro, Democratic Republic of Congo — Most confirmed Ebola cases reported in the Isiro Health Zone originate from Bas-Uele province in the northeast DRC, according to Dr. David Kamalu, medical director of Isiro General Reference Hospital. He said patients are arriving from outside Isiro's health zone, notably Viadana and Limba in Bas-Uele, as well as Rungu zone at PK 14 on the Kisangani road and the Wamba zone (between Bolebole and Mambati), feeding the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE). The CTE currently holds five patients: three laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and two suspected cases. One 3-year-old child is on day 8 of treatment and progressing well. Health officials urged the public to report suspected cases and strictly observe barrier measures to defeat the Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: イゾロにおけるエボラ:ほとんどの症例はバス・ウエレ州由来(医師)
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の確認症例が複数州にまたがり拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にIndonesiaやRomaniaが含まれているが、記事本文はDRCのイゾロ・バス=ウエレ州での症例報告のみを扱っているため、これらは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Putus Rantai Penularan TBC di Desa Raknamo, Dosen Poltekkes Kemenkes Kupang Latih Kader
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking the TB Transmission Chain in Raknamo Village, a Lecturer from Kupang Health Polytechnic Trains Cadres
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) control efforts are under way in Raknamo Village, Amabi Oefeto District, Kupang Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, through a community service by Poltekkes Kupang health lecturers. On 12 June 2026, the team trained local TB cadres to strengthen case finding, education, and treatment support, with Raknamo designated as a TB-free village model for 2030. The effort is conducted in coordination with Fatukanutu Puskesmas and the village government. Previously, Raknamo lacked dedicated TB cadres. Led by Fransiskus Salesius Onggang, the program covers needs assessment, training strategy, implementation, and evaluation based on knowledge gains and cadre engagement. Activities include pulmonary TB education, discussions, simulations, and provision of learning modules with pre/post assessments. Aimed at enabling cadres to recognize suspected TB, educate the community, and support prevention of transmission. Reported 13 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナモ村でのTBC感染連鎖を断つ、クパン保健専門学校講師が幹部を育成
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策・啓発活動であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地域限定のコミュニティ活動報告であり、結核対策の通常業務の一環。シグナルとしての緊急性なし。

article.articleHeadline: Taiwan closely monitoring China pneumonic plague rumors: Premier
article.articleSummary: Taiwan, as of 2026-10-13, is closely monitoring online rumors that a pneumonic plague outbreak has spread from Russia into China and may strengthen quarantine measures. Premier Cho Jung-tai said border quarantine measures were implemented after briefing the Executive Yuan about the issue two weeks earlier. Legislator Wang Ting-yu raised concerns about reports of cases in several Chinese provinces, including Sichuan, and Taiwan’s authorities will track online information from China to detect suspicious developments and decide on tightened controls. Mainland Affairs Council Minister Chiu Chui-cheng noted China’s opacity and said MAC will keep Taiwanese businesspeople in China informed. Health Minister Shih Chung-liang said the ministry has consulted the World Health Organization to verify whether the Oct. 2 death of a 28-year-old researcher at Russia’s Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute was due to pneumonic plague; no positive test results yet, so plague cannot be confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾、中国における肺ペストの噂を注視：首相
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストというIHR通報対象疾患に関する未確認情報だが、複数省庁（行政院・衛生福祉部・大陸委員会）が関与し、検疫強化の検討やWHOへの照会まで行われており、国際的拡大・渡航制限リスクの懸念が顕在化している。
triage.notes: ロシア・イルクーツクでの研究者死亡例は検査未確定であり、中国国内（四川省を含む）での症例報告もオンライン上の噂に基づくもので未確認。台湾当局は検疫強化を検討中だが、実際の発生国・感染状況は不明確なため続報に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Во Вьетнаме врач из России шестой день не может говорить из-за денге
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Vietnam, a Russian doctor has been unable to speak for six days due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Vietnam involves a Russian doctor, Maria, hospitalized for six days in a Vietnamese hospital after contracting dengue fever while on vacation. She initially had headache and fever, but symptoms progressed to nosebleed, itching on the palms and soles, and a drop in platelets. A full-body rash developed, and she reports severe fatigue, falling asleep about every three hours. The vector is infected mosquitoes; severe dengue can cause bleeding, vomiting, and respiratory distress. October marks the second dengue case among Russian tourists in Vietnam this month, after a Moscow-region woman bitten by an Aedes aegypti (yellow fever mosquito) in Da Nang. The report underscores travel-associated dengue among Russians abroad; there are no further details on recovery or discharge at this time.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでロシア人医師がデング熱のため6日間話せない状態に
triage.triage_reason: 個別の旅行者感染事例であり公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大は見られないが、ベトナムでのデング熱流行の蚊媒介リスクとして経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア人旅行者個人の症例報告であり、ベトナム国内の公衆衛生対応や感染拡大規模についての情報はない。デング熱は同国で季節的に流行する疾患であり、今回の記事単独では新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Pakar Gizi Unair Ungkap Bahaya Telur Mentah bagi Bayi, Bisa Picu Infeksi hingga Dehidrasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNAIR Nutrition Expert Reveals the Dangers of Raw Eggs for Infants, Could Trigger Infections and Dehydration
article.articleSummary: On 13 October 2026, Universitas Airlangga nutrition expert warns against giving raw eggs to infants, following the death of a baby in Sidoarjo, East Java, allegedly fed raw eggs by a grandparent. Dosen Mahmud Aditya Rifqi of the university’s Department of Nutrition notes that 0–6 month-olds should receive only exclusive breastfeeding (ASI), with no other foods or even plain water. Eggs, honey, bananas, or porridge at such a young age provide no nutritional benefit and pose serious risks. Raw eggs can harbor Salmonella and other pathogens, and the neonate’s developing gut and immune system may not handle pathogens, potentially causing infection, choking/aspiration, severe diarrhea, and dehydration. The exact cause of the baby's death awaits hospital investigations. The case drew public attention after the aunt posted about it on Threads on Oct 8, 2026, from Sidoarjo.

triage.headline_ja: UNAIR栄養専門家、乳児への生卵の危険性を指摘 感染症や脱水を引き起こす可能性
triage.triage_reason: 単一の乳児死亡例に関する栄養指導の記事であり、公衆衛生上の広範な影響や感染拡大リスクを示す根拠がない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にTyphoid/Paratyphoidが付与されているが、記事内容はSalmonella食中毒の一般的な注意喚起であり、腸チフス・パラチフスの集団発生を示す情報はない。単発の個別症例であり感染症危機管理の観点での優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: وضعیت کرونا و آنفلوآنزا در اصفهان هفتگی رصد می‌شود؛چالش واکسن گریزی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The status of COVID-19 and influenza in Isfahan is monitored weekly; the challenge of vaccine escape.
article.articleSummary: Isfahan Province, Iran conducts weekly surveillance of influenza, SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) and other respiratory illnesses. As of early October, influenza activity had not risen significantly, but autumn is expected to bring higher cases; the usual peak occurs in November, with a possible second wave around March. Public health measures—handwashing, staying home when ill, and masking in crowded places—help reduce transmission. Influenza vaccination should be continued through the cold season; some imported vaccines are allocated to the government for vulnerable groups, including pregnant women, per MOH guidelines. Domestic vaccine production cannot yet meet national demand; Iran relies on imports, notably from India, though lines should be strengthened to ensure steady supply. In Isfahan, vaccination coverage is 95–98%, but pockets of hesitancy persist requiring cultural outreach. Vaccination programs have prevented globally about 154 million child deaths, nearly 90 million measles-related deaths, and about 20 million polio paralysis cases.

triage.headline_ja: イスファハンでコロナとインフルエンザの状況を毎週監視、ワクチン忌避の課題
triage.triage_reason: イランのイスファハン州における通常の季節性インフル・COVID監視とワクチン接種率に関する定例報告であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されない。対象国（インドなど）はワクチン輸入元として言及されるのみで発生国ではない。
triage.notes: イランはトリアージ対象国リストに含まれない。インドはワクチン輸入元として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Come la Germania forma personale sanitario per la lotta contro Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Germany trains healthcare workers for the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri and North Kivu reporting 9,000 infections and 4,000 deaths (50% mortality). Some 800–1,000 patients are currently ill or in treatment centers in these provinces, and around 200 health workers have been infected through exposure. Germany is training frontline staff on site to ensure safe patient care and limit transmission, deploying teams to DR Congo, Kenya, and Uganda. A demonstration illustrates PPE challenges, including suits usable 45–60 minutes and tens of thousands of suits later burned, while goggles, boots and durable aprons last longer. An innovative barrier-wall concept lets nurses monitor patients with reduced PPE. Since June, Germany has allocated about €21 million for PPE and training, forming a cohort of about 120 clinicians from East African partner countries, with Kinshasa graduates organizing their own courses. Kenya has one death; Uganda reports dozens of cases.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツがエボラ対策のために医療従事者を訓練する方法
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラが9,000例・4,000人死亡（致死率50%）と大規模に拡大し、医療従事者への感染や近隣国への波及も確認されており、国際支援（独による訓練・資金提供）が行われている重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア（1死亡）・ウガンダ（数十例）への感染拡大も言及されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ドイツは支援国であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: وزارة الصحة في كينيا تعلن عدم تسجيل حالات إصابة جديدة بالإيبولا - بوابة الأهرام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya's Ministry of Health Announces No New Ebola Cases Recorded - Al-Ahram Portal
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Kenya's Ministry of Health reports no new Ebola cases after confirming the first Ebola-related death tied to an infection acquired abroad from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 13 October 2026, about 300 samples have been analyzed; 108 of 122 identified contacts remain under quarantine, with no symptoms observed. The first death occurred on 6 October and was linked to the current East Congo outbreak via a traveler who had traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Kenya becomes the fourth country to report a case linked to the ongoing East Congo Ebola outbreak, the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record, with more than 8,000 cases to date.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア保健省、新規エボラ感染者なしと発表 - アル・アハラム・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（東部）で発生中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは史上2番目の規模（8000例超）で既に4カ国に拡大しており、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 本記事はケニアでの輸入症例（渡航死亡例）に関する続報だが、根本的な感染源は東部コンゴで進行中の大規模アウトブレイク（8000例超、史上2番目の規模）であり、既に4カ国への国際拡大が確認されている。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、発生源であるDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: 面向农村地区"一老一小" 福建启动流感疫苗免费接种
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fujian launches free flu vaccinations for the elderly and young children in rural areas.
article.articleSummary: Fujian Province launches a free influenza vaccination program for the 2026–2027 flu season, targeting rural residents under the “one old, one young” policy: people aged 65+ and compulsory-education students in grades 1–9, based on rural household registration. The vaccination is voluntary with informed consent, providing a single dose of trivalent inactivated influenza vaccine at no vaccine or service fee. Eligible individuals should go to township health centers or designated community health service centers within their county/district, carrying an ID or hukou. Contraindications include allergy to any vaccine component; acute illness or fever; uncontrolled epilepsy or progressive neurological diseases; and history of Guillain-Barré syndrome, with on-site physician assessment. The program aims to reduce rural medical burdens and strengthen immunity to respiratory infections in Fujian.

triage.headline_ja: 農村地域の「高齢者と子供」に向けて 福建省がインフルエンザワクチン無料接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: これは季節性インフルエンザワクチンの定期接種プログラムに関する行政広報であり、異常な感染症イベントや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの公的案内であり、感染症の発生や流行を報告するものではないため、対象国への発生事例としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Nashik: 81 Dengue Cases Reported In September, Mosquito Menace Persists
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Nashik rises to 81 cases in September 2026, bringing the nine-month (Jan–Sep) total to 182. Monthly breakdown: 56 cases Jan–Jul, 45 in August, 81 in September. Post-monsoon conditions—stagnant water, uncovered water storage, and water accumulation at construction sites—maintain mosquito breeding and elevate transmission risk even after rainfall subsides. Public health experts stress that eliminating breeding sites is as crucial as fogging and other preventive measures. Nashik Municipal Corporation’s health department is conducting preventive actions including household inspections, fogging, larvae detection, and public awareness campaigns. Areas with higher incidence include East Nashik, CIDCO, and Panchavati, with officials focusing on identifying and eliminating breeding sites in neighborhoods with suspected dengue cases to curb the ongoing transmission in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ナシク:9月にデング熱81件を報告、蚊の脅威続く
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域（ナシク)における季節性デング熱の増加だが、地方自治体が通常の対策を実施中であり国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。地域的な流行動向として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 地域の季節性デング熱流行であり、自治体による既存の対策（防疫・幼虫駆除・啓発活動）が継続中。重症度や死亡者数の情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Hari Rabies Sedunia, Pemkab Tangerang Gelar Vaksinasi Rabies Gratis, 95 Hewan Sudah Divaksin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Rabies Day, Tangerang Regency Government Holds Free Rabies Vaccination, 95 Animals Have Been Vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive in Tangerang Regency, Indonesia, organized by the Department of Agriculture and Food Security and the Indonesian Veterinary Doctors Association (PDHI) Banten II, was held in the parking area of GUD Puspemkab Tangerang on 12 October 2026 as part of World Rabies Day and Tangerang’s 394th anniversary. About 300+ animals were registered with an initial service target of 400. By the event’s end, roughly 80 cats, 14 dogs, and 1 civet had been vaccinated; additional vaccination and health-check services are planned for any remaining animals. Vaccination services will also be offered at veterinary health facilities in Curug and Balaraja per schedule. Regent Moch. Maesyal Rasyid stressed ongoing prevention through vaccination, health checks, and public education, urging pet owners to vaccinate and seek veterinary care for suspicious conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 世界狂犬病デー、タンゲラン県政府が無料狂犬病ワクチン接種を実施、95頭の動物が接種済み
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病デーに合わせた通常の予防的ワクチン接種イベントであり、感染拡大や異常な公衆衛生事象を示す情報は含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の発生事例ではなく、地方自治体による予防接種啓発イベントの報告。対象国リストの該当国で発生している感染症イベントではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases continue to decline -- DOH
article.articleSummary: Dengue in the Philippines continues to decline, according to the Department of Health. From 10–23 September, 21,937 dengue cases were reported, down 1% from 27 August–9 September’s 21,997. Since the start of 2026, total dengue cases tallied at 192,112, remaining below the country’s alert and epidemic thresholds. As of 7 October, dengue-related deaths also decreased by 23% compared with 2025. The DOH notes the year-to-date total is 24% lower than the 254,137 cases recorded during the same period in 2025, indicating an improving trend in case counts and fatalities. The report highlights ongoing surveillance and thresholds but does not specify outbreaks or provincial breakdowns. No laboratory confirmation or infection source details are provided in the brief.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例数は減少傾向が継続 -- 保健省
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数・死亡者数ともに減少傾向で、警戒閾値・流行閾値を下回っており、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はフィリピンにおけるデング熱症例の減少傾向を報告する定例的な状況報告であり、流行閾値を下回っているためシグナルとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: China's Hulunbuir Issues Plague Risk Alert After Death in Russia
article.articleSummary: Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia, China, issued a precautionary plague-risk advisory after a Russian researcher died following severe pneumonia, triggering questions about pneumonic plague. The World Health Organization, in an Oct 10, 2026 update, said Russian authorities reported the death as pneumonia of undetermined cause and found no evidence of ongoing transmission or plague. The deceased, a 28-year-old researcher at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia, developed severe illness and was hospitalized Sept 29, dying Oct 2, 2026. Russian authorities reported testing for plague and other pathogens among the deceased and contacts; results were negative, and no laboratory biosafety incident occurred; contacts remained asymptomatic during observation. Hulunbuir notes no human plague since 1927 and a low local outbreak risk, but travelers from plague-endemic areas should monitor health and disclose travel. Plague is Yersinia pestis; diagnosis requires lab confirmation; antibiotics are effective when treatment begins early.

triage.headline_ja: 中国フルンボイル、ロシアでの死亡例を受けペスト警戒アラートを発令
triage.triage_reason: WHOがロシアでの死亡例について原因不明の肺炎としペストの証拠なしと確認しており、検査も陰性、接触者も無症状でヒト-ヒト感染や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 中国フルンボイルは予防的措置としてアラートを発令したのみで、実際の感染事例は確認されていない。ロシアでの死亡例もWHOによりペストではないと否定されており、対象国での実際のペスト発生事実はないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Nghiên cứu quốc tế cảnh báo nguy cơ nhiễm giun móc ở người trưởng thành
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An international study warns of the risk of hookworm infection in adults.
article.articleSummary: Hookworm infection remains detectable among adults in southern Vietnam and the Central Highlands. A study by the Ho Chi Minh City Institute of Malaria, Parasitic Diseases and Insects (Ministry of Health) with Thai Nguyen University of Medicine and Pharmacy, published in Tropical Biomedicine in September 2026, analyzed 1,241 stool samples from individuals aged 2+ across Lam Dong, Tay Ninh, Binh Duong, and Ba Ria–Vung Tau (including Con Dao) in 2024. Using Kato-Katz, researchers found 89 infections (7.2%), with hookworm dominating (85/89, 95.5%). Trichuris trichiura accounted for 4 cases; no Ascaris lumbricoides detected. Regional prevalence ranged from 12.7% in Lam Dong to 0.8% in Ba Ria–Vung Tau. Age groups: 19–65 years 9.5% (74/783); >65 years 7%; 2–18 years 2.2%. All infections were mild. Authors call for broader surveillance and control targeting working adults, alongside daily hygiene and soil-contact precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 国際研究、成人における鉤虫感染リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 鉤虫（寄生虫）感染の疫学研究であり、全感染例は軽症、新興・異常事象でもなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められないため見送り。
triage.notes: 疾患名はBluedotにより'Malaria'と分類されているが、記事内容は鉤虫（hookworm）など土壌伝播性寄生虫感染症に関する学術研究であり、マラリアとは無関係。感染症危機管理の観点からは低優先度。

article.articleHeadline: 치명률 18% '살인진드기병'⋯현대바이오, 제프티로 치료제 개발 도전
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 18% fatality rate 'killer tick disease' — Hyundai Biotech takes on developing a therapy with Jepti
article.articleSummary: Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS), a tick-borne viral disease, caused Korea to report 280 cases and 41 deaths last year; the national cumulative fatality is about 18%. No approved SFTS therapy exists in Korea. Hyundai Biotech announced plans to advance Jepti (XAFTY), an oral antiviral candidate that improves solubility and absorption of niclosamide, into a Phase 2 SFTS trial (IND) with submission to the MFDS, aiming to enroll the first patient in May 2027. The company will leverage safety and drug-exposure data from roughly 300 COVID-19 patients, plus SFTS cell experiments and two external animal studies suggesting higher survival with nano-formulated niclosamide and reduced S100A4-driven inflammation. In Japan, Avigan (Favipiravir) was approved for SFTS in 2024, despite questions about efficacy; PMDA approved due to limited alternatives. Hyundai also conducts dengue trials in Vietnam using Jepti to assess broad antiviral potential.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率18%「殺人ダニ病」⋯現代バイオ、ジェプティで治療薬開発に挑戦
triage.triage_reason: 記事は韓国でのSFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）治療薬の開発に関する製薬企業のニュースであり、対象国における新規の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではない。ベトナムの言及も単にデング熱治療薬の臨床試験実施地としてであり、実際のアウトブレイクではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は韓国SFTSに対する治療薬開発（製薬企業の事業発表）であり、対象国リストに韓国・日本は含まれない。ベトナムはデング熱の臨床試験実施地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生イベントの報告ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 流感來勢洶洶 醫：治療藥物及儲備有更多選擇 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza surges; doctors say there are more options for treatment drugs and stockpiles | am730
article.articleSummary: Influenza surges in Hong Kong, with a 10-year-old boy infected by H1N1 requiring admission to Prince of Wales Hospital’s Pediatric Intensive Care Unit for septic shock; Kowloon Hospital reports eight fever/respiratory cases testing positive for H1N1. ASPID urges vaccination for 0–5-year-olds to curb severe disease. Do not rely solely on rapid tests due to possible false negatives; seek medical assessment for persistent fever, poor appetite, or respiratory distress. Antivirals include oseltamivir and baloxavir marboxil. Baloxavir is approved for children five years and older weighing ≥20 kg, and must be used within 48 hours of onset; it is a single-dose regimen that can reduce transmission. Oseltamivir requires a five-day course (10 doses); incomplete treatment risks rebound, ongoing contagion, and resistance. Side effects: oseltamivir may cause neuropsychiatric events; baloxavir has fewer reports, with GI upset possible. Vaccine uptake and stockpiling influence winter outbreak risk and preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 流感急増、医師は治療薬と備蓄に選択肢が増えたと説明 | am730
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）が急増し、小児の重症例（敗血症性ショック）が発生、専門家団体がワクチン接種を呼びかけるなど社会的関心が高まっているため、WPRO基準の複数該当とあわせてフルRRAへの移行を検討すべき事案と判断した。
triage.notes: 香港（九龍地区）での季節性インフルエンザ流行報道。小児重症例（ICU入院）と医療専門家団体による注意喚起があり、WPRO基準（重症度・持続的曝露・流行性）に複数該当。ただしIHR基準（国際的拡大・渡航制限等）には該当せず、季節性・地域的な事象と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM: Ca tay chân miệng tăng mạnh, nhiều trẻ đồng nhiễm virus hô hấp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease cases surge; many children co-infected with respiratory viruses.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) cases surge in Ho Chi Minh City (TPHCM). In week 40 of 2026 (Sept 28–Oct 4), 1,673 HFMD cases were recorded, up 47.8% from the four-week average, bringing year-to-date HFMD toll to 38,463. Dengue fever cases stood at 1,505 that week, down 2.3% from the prior four-week period, with 37,369 total since January. Notably, about 10–20% of HFMD admissions feature respiratory virus co-infections, presenting cough, runny nose, wheeze, alongside HFMD symptoms (fever, rash, vesicles, drooling, irritability). Most HFMD cases are in children; roughly one-third of hospitalised HFMD patients are severe (grade 2A/2B). Ho Chi Minh City's Children's Hospital 2 reports rising admissions; >100 beds prepared, with ventilators and dialysis capabilities for severe HFMD or dengue, including patients transferred from other provinces. HFMD shows two annual peaks, Sept–Nov aligns with school return; parents advised hygiene, rest, and isolation.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：手足口病の症例が急増、多くの小児が呼吸器ウイルスと混合感染
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病の症例が季節平均を大幅に上回り急増し、入院例の約3分の1が重症（グレード2A/2B）、呼吸器ウイルスとの混合感染も報告されており、医療機関が病床・人工呼吸器等の体制強化を進めている点から、重症度・流行しやすさ・医療対応の観点でスクリーニング基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事は毎年9〜11月に見られる季節的流行パターン（新学期開始時期と一致）との記載があり、異常性については限定的。ただし重症例の割合や病床準備状況から経過観察以上の注視が必要。デング熱は前期比減少傾向。

article.articleHeadline: Sandiganbayan Acquits Janette Garin and Co-Accused in P3.5-B Dengvaxia Case
article.articleSummary: Sandiganbayan’s Second Division acquitted Janette Garin, then Health Secretary and Iloilo 1st District Rep., of graft and technical malversation over the 2015 Dengvaxia vaccine procurement. Prosecutors alleged Garin conspired with former DOH officials, including Julius Lecciones, to illegally divert funds for Dengvaxia. The Dengvaxia controversy erupted in April 2016 after the vaccine was given to more than 830,000 students nationwide, with some children experiencing severe dengue symptoms and fueling public fear of vaccination. Sanofi Pasteur later refunded about P1.4 billion of unused doses in 2018 at the DOH’s request. Other acquitted individuals included former DOH undersecretaries Gerardo Bayugo and Kenneth Hartigan-Go, and Joyce Ducusin; bonds were released and hold departure orders lifted. Garin described the decision as vindication for health experts and emphasized the importance of vaccination as a public health measure amid climate change and viral threats.

triage.headline_ja: サンディガンバヤン、ジャネット・ガリンおよび共同被告をP35億デングワクシア事件で無罪判決
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2015年のデングワクシア調達をめぐる汚職裁判の無罪判決に関する司法・政治的報道であり、現在進行中の感染症発生事例ではないため公衆衛生上の緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去（2015-2016年）のデングワクシア予防接種プログラムに関する汚職裁判の判決報道であり、現在のデング熱発生状況を扱うものではない。疾患名はDengueとされているが、実質的な感染症イベントではないため対象国リストに該当する発生国は特定されない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Tangerang Kembali Buka Program Vaksinasi Rabies Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tangerang City Government Reopens Free Rabies Vaccination Program.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, Tangerang City Government reopened a free rabies vaccination program for residents with pets, offering a quota of 50 animals. The initiative, tied to National Veterinary Public Health Day, aims to strengthen rabies prevention by vaccinating household pets. Registration is open at bit.ly/VaksinHariPuskeswan. Vaccinations will take place at Kantor Puskeswan, Dinas Ketahanan Pangan Kota Tangerang, Jalan Seni Pahat, Sukaasih, Tangerang, on Thursday 22 October from 08:00 to 11:00 WIB. Drh Wina Listiana, head of UPTD Puskeswan Kota Tangerang, emphasizes the free service and limited slots to protect both animal and public health; no case counts or laboratory confirmations are mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: タンゲラン市政府、無料狂犬病ワクチン接種プログラムを再開
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の予防接種プログラムに関する通常の公衆衛生活動の告知であり、症例報告や異常な流行の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的ワクチン接種プログラムの告知であり、症例数や検査確認情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DOH maintains vigilance over Russia plague scare
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague scare in Russia prompts DOH vigilance. A reported death of a laboratory worker in Irkutsk linked to a pneumonic plague investigation; nearly 200 people are under medical observation, and one hospital facility was quarantined. The Philippines Department of Health says the risk to the Philippines is very low and no special precautions are needed. Emphasizes continued adherence to everyday hygiene (handwashing, covering coughs/sneezes). The Bureau of Quarantine is conducting airport screening; the Research Institute for Tropical Medicine (RITM) can test for plague, and designated hospitals can isolate and treat suspect cases if required. The death relates to pneumonia of undetermined origin at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute; authorities placed a hospital facility under quarantine and intensified monitoring. DOH will remain vigilant as of 2026-10-13.

triage.headline_ja: DOHはロシアでのペスト警戒に対し監視を継続
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクで肺ペストによる検査技師の死亡と約200人の経過観察が報告されており、重篤かつ異常な事象としてIHR基準に複数該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行が適切と判断される。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピンは監視対応のみで実際の症例発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Какие бедствия принесет супер-Эль-Ниньо в 2027 году: пожары, тайфуны, наводнения, засуха, эпидемии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What disasters will the Super El Niño bring in 2027: fires, typhoons, floods, droughts, epidemics.
article.articleSummary: El Niño, intensifying in late 2026, triggers widespread fires in Indonesian peatlands and forests, with West Kalimantan fires displacing hundreds of thousands and driving record greenhouse gas emissions. October–November 2026 will see Pacific typhoons fueled by warm seas, raising the threat of super typhoons toward East Asia. December 2026–January 2027 brings floods and droughts across Africa: northern and eastern Africa facing droughts, while the Horn of Africa (Somalia, Kenya, Ethiopia) endures deluges; southern Africa (Malawi, Zambia, Zimbabwe) experiences record low rainfall, jeopardizing crops and livestock. January 2027 foresees floods and storms in the Americas, including Peru heavy rains causing landslides and coastal flooding in California. March–April 2027 epidemics in Africa due to floods—cholera and leptospirosis—with malaria and dengue rising in vulnerable regions. May–June 2027 coral bleaching peaks in the Philippines and Caribbean; heatwaves in summer 2027 threaten health and agriculture, followed by a transition to La Niña.

triage.headline_ja: 2027年にスーパーエルニーニョがもたらす災害とは：火災、台風、洪水、干ばつ、感染症
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2026年末〜2027年にかけてのエルニーニョに起因する将来予測（火災・台風・洪水・干ばつ・感染症流行の可能性）を扱う推測的な内容であり、実際に発生した感染症イベントの報告ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本記事は気候予測に基づく将来のシナリオ記事であり、マラリア・デング熱・コレラ・レプトスピラ症などの感染症流行は2027年3〜4月にアフリカで『起こりうる』とされる仮説的内容。対象国（インドネシア、フィリピン、ザンビア等）は火災・サンゴ白化・干ばつなど感染症以外の文脈で言及されており、実際の感染症発生報告ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: A Kitten Scratch Was the Clue Behind a Transplant Patient's Hidden Blood Infection and Rare Immune Storm
article.articleSummary: China’s Second Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University reports a 33-year-old kidney transplant recipient who developed HLH after Bartonella henselae bacteremia—the agent of cat scratch disease. A kitten scratch about a month earlier was only linked after metagenomic next-generation sequencing. She presented with fever, pancytopenia, high ferritin, elevated soluble IL-2 receptor, and bone marrow hemophagocytosis. Immunosuppressants were briefly halted; she received doxycycline and rifampin, guided by serial sequencing, plus dexamethasone and IVIG to control HLH. Six months later HLH had not recurred and the transplanted kidney remained functional. The authors propose including B. henselae among HLH triggers after kidney transplantation and suggest repeat sequencing to tailor antibiotic duration. The report notes a 2014 pediatric case of HLH from B. henselae post-transplant. Cat scratch disease poses higher risk to immunocompromised individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 子猫による引っかき傷が、移植患者の隠れた血液感染と稀な免疫暴走(HLH)の手がかりに
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生への影響や国際的拡大のリスクはなく、免疫不全患者における稀な合併症の症例研究にとどまる。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国重慶の病院における単一の腎移植患者の症例報告（猫ひっかき病によるバルトネラ菌血症からのHLH）であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。疾患は免疫不全患者個人の合併症管理に関するものであり、ヒト-ヒト感染性や集団発生の性質を持たない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue : यूपी में बारिश थमते ही डेंगू का कहर तेज, लखनऊ के चार बड़े अस्पतालों में बढ़ी मरीजों की संख्या
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: As rains subside in Uttar Pradesh, the dengue outbreak intensifies; the number of patients has risen in four major hospitals in Lucknow.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak intensifies in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh as rains subside, with 34 laboratory-confirmed dengue patients across four major hospitals: Lohia Institute, KGMU, Balrampur Hospital, and others. Patients predominantly present with high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, nausea, and fatigue; severe cases exhibit abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, bleeding from nose/gums, breathing difficulties, or marked weakness. Aedes mosquitoes, active by day, breed in stagnant water found in coolers, pots, old tires, rooftops, and containers; control measures include eliminating standing water, regular cooler-water changes, covering water tanks, and cleaning around homes. Schoolchildren should wear full-sleeved clothing and use mosquito nets at night. Gomti River floodwater receded by ~12–15 cm, relieving water in areas around Gauhat, Hanuman Setu, and Gomti Barrage, though dengue risk remains during the current trend.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：ウッタル・プラデーシュ州で雨が収まるとデング熱が猛威、ラクナウの主要4病院で患者数増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行であり毎年発生する地域的事象。重症例の言及はあるが規模は限定的で、IHR基準・社会的関心の明確な高まりは確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インド・ウッタル・プラデーシュ州ラクナウにおける季節性デング熱流行。34例のラボ確認症例、4病院での患者増加。毎年の雨季後の典型的な流行パターンであり、特異な重症化・拡大の兆候は記事内で確認できず。

article.articleHeadline: KNUN calls for strict border screening measures to prevent Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: KNUN calls for stricter border screening to prevent Ebola from entering Kenya. KNUN Secretary General Seth Panyako urged departure-point screening and strict adherence to WHO Ebola protocols at border points and airports, arguing travellers from outbreak-hit areas should be identified, assessed, and quarantined before boarding to Kenya, citing Endeppe Airport in the DRC. He said that departure screening helps identify potential cases early and reduce cross-border spread, urging authorities to ensure agencies responsible for screening are prepared. He noted that Kenyan nurses’ Covid-19 experience improved infection prevention and personal protection. At Nairobi Hospital, health workers under quarantine showed no Ebola symptoms at the time. In Kisumu, JOOTRH’s expansion from 500 to 900 beds increased pressure on staff and resources, highlighting ongoing challenges at this Level Six referral hospital.

triage.headline_ja: KNUN、エボラ流行拡大を防ぐための厳格な国境検疫措置を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行を受けたケニア側の予防的な国境スクリーニング強化の要求に関する記事であり、ケニア国内での新規発生情報はないため、継続的な経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア（対象国外）における国境検疫対策の要求であり、DRCでのエボラ流行は既知の背景情報として言及されている。新規の発生・拡大に関する具体的データはないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Why safe burial protocols matter in containing the virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease in Kenya: Kenya reported its first fatal case last week; the Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine, making early detection and strict infection prevention vital. Early symptoms include fever, sore throat and abdominal pain; travellers or contacts should seek care promptly and disclose travel exposure. Safe burial protocols are essential to prevent transmission; the Kenya Red Cross Society conducts safe and dignified burials during emergencies. A standard burial team consists of seven members, expanded to nine for the imported case, covering body handling, infection prevention, community engagement and security, with transport from hospital to Lang’ata Cemetery. Bodies are disinfected and placed in burial bags, single-use PPE is discarded, and all equipment is properly decontaminated. Kenya remains vigilant as Ebola cases are reported in the DRC; ASEOWA-trained teams (about 170 Kenyan health workers) conducted prior West Africa missions, with ongoing refresher training and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：安全な埋葬プロトコルがウイルス封じ込めに重要な理由
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで輸入例としてエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による初の死亡例が報告され、DRCでの継続的な発生と合わせて国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入エボラ死亡例と埋葬対応だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは継続的な発生地として言及されているため含めた。アンゴラは記事本文中に言及がなく除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases top 192,000, leptospirosis cases rise nearly half as of Oct. 7
article.articleSummary: Philippines: leptospirosis up 48% to 13,158 cases as of Oct 7, 2026, CFR 5.34% (down from 10.47% last year); recent three-to-four-week decline to 1,814 (Sept 10–23) from 3,340 (Aug 27–Sept 9). Thirteen areas flagged for leptospirosis; authorities monitor downward trend. Dengue down 24% to 192,112 cases as of Oct 7; CFR 0.39%; cases had risen since early June but recently declined, 21,937 (Sept 10–23) vs 21,997 (Aug 27–Sept 9). DoH strengthens hospital coordination, patient navigation and referral across hospitals and partner facilities, supported by unified leptospirosis and dengue case tracker. Ongoing surveillance, human resources deployment, doxycycline prophylaxis and essential medicines for leptospirosis, and stock monitoring of insecticides and supplies for dengue control. Diseases typically peak during the rainy season; 13 areas across eight regions remain under close monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例が19万2000件を超え、レプトスピラ症症例は10月7日時点で約5割増加
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで毎年雨季に発生する季節性のデング熱・レプトスピラ症の定例統計報告であり、むしろ直近3〜4週間は減少傾向にある。政府が通常のサーベイランス・医療体制で対応しており、異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱・レプトスピラ症ともにCFRは前年より改善傾向にあり、フィリピン保健省が既存の体制（統一症例追跡システム、ドキシサイクリン予防投与、殺虫剤備蓄等）で管理している定例報告。新規性・異常性は低く、継続的なルーティン監視対象として扱うのが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Letter from Mogadishu: Nairobi Ebola virus case has the region sneezing
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola case as of 2026-10-13, linked to infection in DR Congo via Uganda. The regional alert follows, with Somalia's Puntland declaring code red and strengthening surveillance, rapid response, and lab readiness; East African authorities emphasize cross-border information sharing and infection control. Uganda distances itself, urging Kenya to address surveillance gaps. Kenya, described as well-prepared after Ebola drills, is expanding laboratory capacity, specimen collection/testing, isolation facilities, PPE, and case management. About 28 contacts are identified and being monitored, including 23 passengers on the Jambo jet and four crew members who traveled with the deceased patient, along with family members and health workers. WHO and Africa CDC mobilized support: Africa CDC dispatched a high-level team to Nairobi; WHO focuses on screening at risk points, risk communication, and rapid contact tracing. No travel restrictions advised.

triage.headline_ja: モガディシュからの手紙：ナイロビのエボラウイルス症例が地域を警戒させている
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初の輸入エボラ症例が確認され、DRC由来の感染がウガンダ経由で拡大、複数国（ケニア・ウガンダ・ソマリア）で警戒レベルが引き上げられWHO・Africa CDCが支援に乗り出しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ソマリア・モザンビークは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは感染源として記事で明示的に言及されているため含めた。渡航制限は現時点で推奨されていない旨が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Como a Alemanha forma profissionais de saúde para a luta contra o Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Germany trains healthcare professionals for the fight against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has infected about 9,000 people and killed around 4,000, with a case fatality of roughly 50%; active cases are in Ituri and North Kivu. German specialists are training local clinicians to treat patients safely, including a session in Entebbe, Uganda for about 30 doctors and nurses. Some 200 health workers have been infected in field operations. Berlin’s Charité notes Kinshasa-based trainers are expected to cascade knowledge to the capital as cases rise. The initiative aims to build a regional cadre across East Africa, with roughly 120 health professionals from partner countries, and Congolese trainers beginning their own sessions in Kinshasa. Germany has allocated 21 million euros for PPE and training since June. Kenya reports one death; Uganda has several dozen cases as the outbreak extends beyond the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツがエボラ出血熱対策のため医療従事者を養成する方法
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で約9,000人感染・4,000人死亡（致死率約50%）という大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中で、ウガンダ・ケニアへの国際的拡大も確認されており、医療従事者感染も多数発生しているため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州・北キヴ州）での大規模エボラ流行とウガンダ・ケニアへの拡大、ドイツ（ベルリン・シャリテ病院）による医療従事者訓練支援を報じている。ウガンダ・ケニア・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Врач из России лишилась возможности говорить из-за самолечения при лихорадке денге
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Russian doctor lost her ability to speak due to self-medication during dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever case reported in Vietnam involving a Russian tourist. A Russian woman, after a mosquito bite in Vietnam, attempted self-medication and has been in hospital for six days, now unable to speak. She experienced abrupt headache and fever, nasal bleeding, and itching of the palms and soles, with a falling platelet count. Her body is covered in a rash, she is markedly weak, and she sleeps about every three hours. The report notes that dengue is mosquito-transmitted, and severe dengue can include bleeding, vomiting, and breathing difficulties. Earlier, another Russian contracted dengue in Vietnam and, after several days of self-treatment, developed a rash and numb legs; he is now recovering. Meanwhile, many Russian tourists are canceling trips to Thailand due to a COVID-19 outbreak there, with some falling ill during holidays.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人医師、デング熱の自己治療により発話能力を喪失
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの個人旅行者のデング熱自己治療による重症化事例であり、公衆衛生上の集団的異常や拡大リスクを示す情報はない。タイのCOVID-19流行についても具体的な規模・詳細が不明で、独立したシグナルとは判断できない。
triage.notes: 記事は個別のロシア人観光客2例のデング熱重症化（自己治療による）とタイでのCOVID-19流行による旅行キャンセルという断片的情報で構成されており、集団的発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す具体的データ（症例数、致死率等）は含まれていない。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: इंदौर में HIV संक्रमण के 357 नए मामले! MGM मेडिकल कॉलेज की जांच में सबसे ज्यादा 215 संक्रमित मिले, 6 मरीज अब भी ART से दूर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 357 new HIV infections in Indore! MGM Medical College's screening found the highest number of infections at 215, with 6 patients still not on ART.
article.articleSummary: Indore, Madhya Pradesh, recorded 357 new HIV infections from April–September 2026 after screening 44,259 individuals at ICTC centres; 351 were linked to antiretroviral therapy (ART) and 6 remain not on treatment. MGM Medical College accounted for the largest cluster: 1,152 tested, 215 positives, with 209 started on ART and 6 not linked yet (these 6 are only noted in MGM’s figures). Overall ART linkage stood at about 98.3%, but the six untreated patients highlight gaps in linkage to care and follow-up. The First-95 campaign screened 6,313 people across public and private hospitals to identify infections and connect them to services. Other centres reported smaller counts (e.g., District Hospital Indore 24 infections from 5,135 tests; Malhar Ganj 22/3,503; Arvindobo 16/4,130; PC Sethi 17/4,259; Index Medical College 12/3,074). All listed centres claimed 100% ART linkage, though ongoing adherence data were not provided. Emphasizes timely ART, follow-up, and stigma reduction.

triage.headline_ja: インドール市でHIV感染357件の新規症例！MGM医科大学の検査で最多215人の感染確認、6人はいまだART未導入
triage.triage_reason: ICTCセンターでの定期的なHIVスクリーニング結果報告であり、異常な集団発生や新たな公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。ART連携率は98.3%と高く、通常の保健医療活動の一環と判断される。
triage.notes: HIVは慢性感染症であり、本記事はインド・マディヤプラデーシュ州インドールにおける定期的なHIV検査・治療連携（ART）の実施状況に関する行政報告。IHR(2005)Annex2やWPRO基準で想定する急性感染症の異常事象には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội ghi nhận 400 ca sốt xuất huyết trong một tuần: Những dấu hiệu cảnh báo không thể chủ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi records 400 dengue fever cases in one week: Warning signs cannot be ignored.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases surge in Hanoi: 400 new infections in the week of Oct 2–9, 2026, across 81 wards/communes, with 12 new outbreaks; total this year 4,351 cases in 120 wards/communes and 193 outbreaks, with 27 active. Dengue is caused by the dengue virus and transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. Early symptoms include abrupt high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pain, nausea, and rash, often mistaken for other febrile illnesses. In Sept 2026, the National Infectious Diseases Hospital reported diverse presentations, including severe cases; a 37-year-old woman initially thought she had flu self-medicated before developing severe dengue. Critical risk window is days 3–7 after fever onset when plasma leakage can cause hypovolemia, shock, and bleeding with thrombocytopenia. Do not use NSAIDs; monitor for warning signs and seek prompt care. Mosquito control and vaccination per guidance are advised.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイで1週間に400件のデング熱症例を記録：軽視できない警告サイン
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでデング熱症例が急増し重症例や出血性ショック等の警告症状も報告されており、WPRO基準（重症度・持続曝露・流行しやすさ）を複数満たし社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで季節性に流行する既知の疾患だが、本年のハノイでの症例数増加（4,351例、193アウトブレイク）と重症例の報告があり、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Самая грязная вещь: инфекционист объяснила, можно ли заразиться через деньги
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Dirtiest Thing: An Infectious-Disease Specialist Explains Whether You Can Get Infected Through Money
article.articleSummary: Money can theoretically transmit infections, according to infectious-disease specialist Olga Golubovskaya. She notes banknotes can carry pathogens, but the chance of infection via currency is very low and would require a substantial microbial load plus poor hygiene. She references China, where the 2019 coronavirus outbreak began, noting that authorities disposed of and even burned banknotes as part of containment efforts. For transmission via money to occur, pathogens would need to contaminate notes and enter the body, for example by licking or otherwise introducing material into mucous membranes. Money carries everyday, conditionally pathogenic flora that people encounter daily, making transmission possible only if basic hygiene is neglected. The piece also mentions a tick-borne virus detected in China causing a severe illness similar to influenza, and briefly notes U.S. explanations about the origin of the coronavirus.

triage.headline_ja: 最も汚いもの：感染症専門医が「お金を介して感染するか」を解説
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な衛生啓発記事であり、特定の新規感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は貨幣を介した感染リスクに関する一般的な解説であり、中国での2019年コロナウイルス起源やダニ媒介性ウイルスへの言及は補足的なもので、具体的な現在進行中のアウトブレイク情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تعلن عن عدم تسجيل حالات إصابة جديدة بالإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya announces that no new Ebola cases have been recorded.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Ministry of Health announced on Oct 13, 2026, that no new Ebola virus disease cases have been recorded after reporting the first Ebola-related death linked to travel from abroad. Authorities confirmed that a person who traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo died from Ebola, marking the case as imported. In active surveillance, approximately 300 samples were analyzed; 122 individuals were identified as contacts, with 108 currently under quarantine and asymptomatic. The update indicates that quarantined contacts show no symptoms to date. The response follows intensified surveillance in Nairobi and surrounding counties after the possible imported case, with authorities continuing to monitor transmission chains and assess ongoing risk of export/import. No further infections have been detected to date.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、新たなエボラ感染例の報告なしと発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCへの渡航歴を持つ者からケニアで輸入エボラ死亡例が確認され、接触者108人が隔離中であり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける輸入エボラ症例（DRCへの渡航歴者が死亡）であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRCは感染源として言及されるのみで、DRC国内での発生拡大は記載されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia impondrá sanciones por incumplir las medidas para evitar la propagación del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya will impose sanctions for failing to comply with measures to prevent the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya imposes sanctions for non-compliance with new Ebola prevention measures after detecting its first imported case. A 40-year-old Kenyan died Oct 5 in Nairobi; he arrived Oct 3 after road travel from Kampala, Uganda, linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) outbreak, which remains active as the second-worst Ebola epidemic in history. The DRC outbreak has 8,978 confirmed cases and 4,336 deaths; Uganda reported 20 infections (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths before the WHO end-date of Aug 26. Kenya is the fourth country with a case linked to the DRC outbreak, after Uganda, France and the Netherlands. The directive requires immediate notification of suspected cases, contact tracing, health checks for arrivals, truthful travel histories, and possible isolation/quarantine in a designated center, with police support if needed; only designated labs may test Ebola, and bodies must be handled by trained personnel with PPE. Violations carry legal sanctions.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱の拡散防止策違反に対し制裁を科す方針
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続くエボラ流行がウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダに波及し、ケニアで輸入症例による死亡と渡航制限措置が発生しているため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）すべてに該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生したエボラ流行の国際的波及であり、ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: " Il a chopé le virus auxerrois " : James Zhou fête ses dix ans à la tête de l'AJ Auxerre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "He caught the Auxerrois virus": James Zhou marks ten years at the helm of AJ Auxerre.
article.articleSummary: Ten years into his ownership of AJ Auxerre, Chinese businessman James Zhou marks a decade at the helm with ORG Packaging, cementing a deep bond between the club and Auxerre in the Yonne department, France. City officials laud his commitment to the club and town, noting initial visa hurdles and cautious beginnings after past Chinese-owned clubs, such as Sochaux. Zhou is portrayed as approachable and community-minded, with anecdotes of sharing kebab lunches, visiting youth teams, and attending matches across all club levels. His generosity extended to the COVID-19 response: Auxerre Hospital received 100,000 masks, 5,000 gowns, and 20,000 testing kits in April 2020, and Ultras were hosted for a trip to China. The piece recalls a 2024 Ligue 2 title celebration trip to Beijing and frames Zhou as safeguarding the club’s philosophy while pursuing future development.

triage.headline_ja: 「彼はオーセロワのウイルスに感染した」：ジェームズ・ジョウ、AJオーセール会長就任10周年を祝う
triage.triage_reason: 記事はサッカークラブ会長の10周年を祝う人物紹介記事であり、COVID-19は過去の支援活動（2020年のマスク寄付等）の文脈で言及されているのみで、現在の感染症イベントではない。
triage.notes: 記事はスポーツ・人物紹介記事であり、COVID-19は2020年当時の寄付エピソードとして過去形で言及されているのみ。現在進行形の感染症イベントではないため対象国の該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Combo explosivo o efecto paradoja? El impacto que puede tener el súper Niño sobre una temida enfermedad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Explosive combo or paradoxical effect? The impact that the super Niño could have on a feared disease.
article.articleSummary: Argentina faces dengue risk as El Niño intensifies, potentially boosting Aedes aegypti populations during the 2026–2027 summer. The virus (four serotypes) and chikungunya could surge across Misiones (dengue season starts in October) and the Buenos Aires Metropolitan Area (AMBA; November–December), with climate forecasts calling for heavy rainfall in the Litoral, Northeast, Cuyo, and northern Patagonia. Experts warn about uncertainty: a major outbreak is not guaranteed, but conditions may align for increased transmission. Vector ecology hinges on water stagnation, where mosquito eggs deposited in containers persist and larval development from egg contact to adult typically takes 9–13 days, faster in Misiones than in AMBA. Past outbreaks (2023–2024) loom in memory. Argentina has seen vaccination efforts reaching around one million people, though public-sector access remains limited amid import issues and repellent shortages. Close monitoring and robust vector-control remain essential as rainfall patterns evolve.

triage.headline_ja: 爆発的コンボか逆説的効果か？スーパーエルニーニョが恐れられる感染症に及ぼす可能性のある影響
triage.triage_reason: 記事はアルゼンチンにおけるエルニーニョに伴うデング熱・チクングニア熱の将来的リスク予測に関する分析記事であり、対象国（フィリピン等）での実際の発生事例ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippines, Arizona, United States等が含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はアルゼンチン（対象国外）における季節性デング熱・チクングニア熱の将来予測であり、実際の発生報告ではない。対象国での発生事例は確認できないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Emergency FMD vaccination activated in Zambezi
article.articleSummary: Foot and Mouth Disease emergency vaccination activated in Kalala Island, Kabe constituency, Zambezi region, after confirmation of the outbreak. On 5 October, 20 cattle showed FMD signs; 12 samples were collected and sent to the Central Veterinary Laboratory (CVL) in Windhoek on 6 October, with all tests positive on 7 October. The National FMD Contingency Plan under the Animal Health Act 2011 has been activated to contain and control the outbreak, with intensive surveillance underway. Immediate measures include suspension of movement of all cloven-hoofed animals and their raw products across the entire Zambezi region, cancellation of all permits, and suspension of marketing, trade, and animal gathering events. Slaughter at local abattoirs, informal markets, and social events is halted; slaughter at export abattoirs is permitted only after favourable traceability of cattle in quarantine. Roadblocks are being established to enforce restrictions. FMD is highly contagious among cattle, sheep, goats, pigs, and some wild species; farmers are urged to report suspicious cases to the State Veterinary Office and await regular updates.

triage.headline_ja: ザンベジ地域で口蹄疫の緊急ワクチン接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: ナミビア・ザンベジ地域における家畜(牛)の口蹄疫(FMD)発生であり、ヒトへの感染症ではなく対象国にも該当しないため見送り。
triage.notes: 発生地域はナミビアのZambezi RegionでありBluedot付与地域に含まれるThailandへの言及は記事サマリーになく誤付与と判断。動物衛生（家畜）のイベントであり人の感染症監視の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Cómo Alemania forma al personal sanitario para luchar contra el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Germany trains healthcare workers to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: 9,000 Ebola infections and 4,000 deaths in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) with ~50% fatality. Germany trains local health workers to treat Ebola safely, sending teams to DRC, Kenya, and Uganda; about 120 clinicians from East African partner countries are being trained, and Kinshasa graduates have begun organizing further courses. In Entebbe, Uganda, 30 clinicians were trained on the ground. Some 200 health professionals have been infected to date. Between 800 and 1,000 patients remain actively ill or admitted in treatment centers across Ituri and North Kivu. ICU nurse Louise Götze of Charité Berlin has traveled seven times this year to train frontline staff and aims to build a cross-African trainer network. The German Development Ministry has increased aid by 21 million euros for PPE and training; the outbreak has spread to Kenya (1 death) and Uganda (dozens of cases).

triage.headline_ja: ドイツはエボラ対策のため医療従事者をどう訓練しているか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）で感染者9,000人・死者4,000人（致死率約50%）に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、ケニア・ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツによる医療従事者訓練支援を主題としているが、感染拡大の主たる発生地はDRC東部（イトゥリ・北キブ）。ケニア・ウガンダへの拡大も報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ドイツも対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: La marmotta può trasmettere la peste?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can the marmot transmit the plague?
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis-caused plague persists as a zoonosis centered in Mongolia and southern Siberia. In Hustai National Park, Mongolia, tarbagan marmots (Marmota sibirica) harbor plague bacteria in their burrows, with fleas facilitating transmission to humans who handle or consume infected animals. Archaeological work near Irkutsk links the oldest known human plague foci to about 5,500 years ago, with Y. pestis detected in 18 individuals; marmot teeth found in graves suggest close human–marmot contact. In the 19th–20th centuries, Siberian expeditions and the 1910–1911 Manchuria outbreak (~60,000 deaths) underscored animal-to-human transmission. Modern Mongolia continues to report risk: 2020 cases tied to raw marmot organs, and a 15-year-old boy died after hunting and eating such a mammal. Marmots show high infection prevalence (50–80%), sustaining spillover potential, modulated by climate.

triage.headline_ja: マーモットはペストを媒介できるのか？
triage.triage_reason: モンゴル・シベリア地域におけるペストの生態・歴史を解説する啓発記事であり、対象国における現在進行中の発生報告ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はモンゴル・ロシア（シベリア）を中心とした歴史的・生態学的解説記事。中国（満州・内モンゴル）は1910-1911年の歴史的アウトブレイク言及のみで、現在の発生事例ではない。対象国での現行イベントとは言えずDISMISS判定。

article.articleHeadline: Oriental Mindoro logs 1,424 dengue cases, 3 deaths
article.articleSummary: Oriental Mindoro reports 1,424 dengue cases and 3 deaths as of October 13, with Calapan City included in the tally. The Provincial Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit (PESU) dashboard logged 117 new cases from October 4–10, prompting intensified dengue-prevention efforts by the Provincial Health Office in coordination with local government units, municipal health offices, and barangays. Measures underway include public information campaigns, community cleanups, and removal of mosquito breeding sites. Residents are urged to participate in prevention by removing stagnant water, using mosquito nets and repellents, and wearing clothing that minimizes bites. Anyone experiencing fever or other dengue symptoms should seek prompt medical consultation. The response emphasizes cooperative action among authorities, families, and communities to curb transmission in Oriental Mindoro.

triage.headline_ja: オリエンタル・ミンドロ州、デング熱症例1,424件・死亡3件を記録
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンでは季節性のデング熱流行が通常みられ、現地保健当局が既に対策を実施中であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例数の増加傾向が続いているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで季節的に発生する風土病であり、地方保健局が既に予防活動（清掃・啓発・蚊の繁殖地除去等）を実施中。致死率(約0.2%)も特段高くなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないが、週単位で症例が増加しているため今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Tshopo : l'application stricte des mesures barrières contre Ebola recommandée à la population | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Tshopo: Strict application of barrier measures against Ebola recommended to the population | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains active in Tshopo province, centered around Kisangani, with authorities urging strict adherence to barrier measures to curb transmission. During a Oct 12, 2026 press briefing, Governor Paulin Lendongolia urged opinion leaders, religious leaders, journalists, health workers and teachers to strengthen community awareness of Ebola dangers. Measures highlighted include a ban on the circulation of corpses, limits on gatherings, and adherence to hygiene practices, plus the establishment of a provincial Ebola response coordination structure. He deplored local resistance and reports of assaults on health teams and destruction of response equipment. Health facilities that admit suspects or confirmed cases without informing the response teams face suspensions or other sanctions. The provincial government, health department and provincial health division pledged to maintain outbreak response with central government and technical/financial partners, and urged families and neighbors to apply preventive measures to protect one another.

triage.headline_ja: ツショポ州：エボラに対する防護対策の厳格な適用が住民に勧告される | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: DRCツショポ州でエボラ出血熱の感染が継続しており、住民の抵抗や医療チームへの襲撃も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年10月時点でのエボラ流行対応に関する最新報告であり、州知事が住民への防護措置の徹底を呼びかけている。地域住民の抵抗や医療従事者への暴力も報告されており、対応の実効性に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Ebola Rules Take Legal Force From 12 October
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Ebola rules took effect Oct 12, 2026, binding airport screening, isolation, quarantine and case reporting under Legal Notices No. 204 (Public Health Rules) and No. 203 (Declaration of Formidable Epidemic Disease). Entry-point health officers can assess, isolate, refer travellers, and require decontamination. Hospitals, doctors and labs must notify authorities and conduct contact tracing. The regime covers safe burials, transport and repatriation of bodies, and penalties. It follows Kenya’s first Ebola case announced Oct 6; on Oct 11 there were 108 contacts in quarantine and no new cases. The patient was Kenyan, who had lived in Congo, and flew via Kampala to Nairobi, passed routine screening, was isolated at Nairobi Hospital and died Oct 5; Bundibugyo is the Congo strain involved. For US travellers, screening is enforceable; Kenya requires travel health insurance for US visitors, and the CDC lists no Kenya Ebola travel notice as of Oct 13.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ規則、10月12日より法的効力発生
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ症例（コンゴ由来Bundibugyo株）に伴い、空港検疫・隔離・接触者追跡を義務付ける法規制が施行され、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア初のエボラ症例とそれに伴う法規制。患者はコンゴ（DRC）在住歴がありBundibugyo株（コンゴ株）に感染していたが、発症・発生自体はケニアで確認されたものであり、DRC国内でのアウトブレイク発生を示す記述はないため、対象国リストに該当する国はなし（Kenya, Uganda, USは対象国リスト外）。

article.articleHeadline: 自由說新聞》俄羅斯「肺鼠疫疑雲」這幕嚇壞中國人！他驚揭一驚悚可能
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Freedom Talk News: Russia's "pneumonic plague scare" shocks Chinese people! He reveals a chilling possibility.
article.articleSummary: Russia’s pneumonic plague scare is reported by Freedom Talk News, provoking alarm among Chinese readers. The segment centers on claims of a pneumonic plague incident in Russia and exposes a chilling possibility related to the disease, described as shocking to audiences in China. Dated 2026-10-13 17:34, the report emphasizes fear and concern without providing concrete epidemiological details such as case counts, transmission routes, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources. The article appears to be a video-driven feature, inviting viewers to watch via the program’s content platform and noting content-rating guidelines and Taiwan’s Website Classification and Promotion Foundation in relation to page labeling. No official health authorities, outbreak status, or verified imported/exported case information are cited within the piece.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: PS Muthoni holds talks with UNICEF as Kenya steps up response
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) case; the patient died after testing positive, with case confirmed on Oct 6, 2026. The Kenyan citizen, previously resident in the Democratic Republic of Congo, travelled through Uganda and arrived in Nairobi on Oct 3 aboard Jambojet flight 8523. Contact tracing has identified 57 contacts, with some placed under quarantine as authorities bolster surveillance, entry-point screening, laboratory testing, and infection prevention in healthcare facilities. Public health actions emphasize risk communication and community engagement, alongside case investigation and contact monitoring. UNICEF Representative Dr. Shaheen Nilofer and Public Health Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni discussed collaboration to ensure timely, accurate information and prevent fear and misinformation. Kenyans are urged to stay vigilant, seek medical attention for concerning symptoms, and use the toll-free line 719 for guidance. WHO highlights risk communication and community engagement as key elements.

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯疫情疑云引关注，蒙煤运输会受影响吗？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's outbreak rumors attract attention; will Mongolian coal transport be affected?
article.articleSummary: One death from pneumonia of unknown origin in Russia’s Irkutsk Oblast (hospitalized Sept 29, died Oct 2) prompted regional concern. Although initial speculation linked the case to pneumonic plague due to the worker’s affiliation with a plague-control institute, the World Health Organization reports negative tests for high-risk pathogens, no linked cases or sustained transmission, and cannot rule out laboratory exposure entirely; at present, no human plague case is confirmed. Mongolian and Chinese border authorities heightened preventive monitoring, but there is no evidence the event disrupted China–Mongolia coal trade; Ganqimaodu Port resumed clearance on Oct 8. Separately, Mongolia supplied about 60.7% of China’s imported coking coal in H1 2026 (6688 Mt total; 4058 Mt from Mongolia; +64% YoY). The bottleneck is cross-border transport, not mining. Port shares: Ganqimaodu ~50%, Ceke ~34%, Mandula ~15%; expansions and cross-border rail projects aim to diversify risk, but full operational capacity remains unproven. Prices stable; inventories tight; demand underpins steel sector, but margins constrain procurement.

article.articleSummary: Published 2026-10-13, Freedom Talk News discusses a pneumonic plague mystery linked to Russia that supposedly terrified Chinese audiences, with references to the Russia–China border, Mongolia, and Hulunbuir (Inner Mongolia). It mentions COVID-19 (Wuhan pneumonia), lockdown imagery, and Chinese CDC units, but offers no verifiable epidemiological details, imported/exported case information, or active outbreak data. The article appears promotional, including YouTube links and calls to action, rather than serving as a substantiated public health update. No actionable public health guidance or official outbreak status is presented within the available content.

article.articleHeadline: 科学防控传染病 共筑校园"健康盾"烟台一职开展秋冬季传染病预防专题讲座-今日聚焦-水母网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientific Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases, Building a Campus Health Shield — Yantai No.1 Vocational College Launches Fall/Winter Infectious Disease Prevention Seminar - Today’s Focus - Jellyfish Net
article.articleSummary: On October 10, 2026, Yantai No.1 Vocational College (Yantai Economic School) held a fall/winter infectious disease prevention seminar to bolster campus health protection. Gu Ruilai, chief physician from the Yantai CDC Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Division, spoke to all students, covering respiratory infections such as influenza, SARS-CoV-2 infection, Mycoplasma pneumoniae, and Streptococcus pneumoniae. Vaccination was highlighted as the most economical preventive measure for influenza and pneumococcal infection, with recommended practices including hand hygiene, adequate ventilation, and cough etiquette. The talk also addressed norovirus-induced winter vomiting disease and provided monkeypox care guidance. Misconceptions about antibiotics were corrected, noting that they do not treat viruses or Mycoplasma and should be used under medical guidance. The school will continue hygiene, ventilation, cleaning, and health education to build a robust campus health shield, translating knowledge into daily protective habits.

article.articleHeadline: ▷ ¿Efecto inesperado o fenómeno contradictorio? Cómo el súper Niño podría influir en una enfermedad alarmante | Actualizado octubre 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ▷ An unexpected effect or a contradictory phenomenon? How the Super Niño could influence an alarming disease | Updated October 2026
article.articleSummary: Argentina faces a dengue and chikungunya risk uptick as a Super Niño drives heavy summer rains across the Buenos Aires Metropolitan Area (AMBA), the Plata Basin, and parts of Cuyo and the north Patagonian Andes. While sustained dengue transmission has waned, the virus persists in neighboring regions and could re-enter. Aedes aegypti breeding thrives in standing water; intense rains can accelerate or wash away larval habitats, depending on local conditions. Vaccination efforts are limited: fewer than one million Argentines have been vaccinated against dengue; the Ministry of Health reports 303,180 doses distributed to 11 provinces at epidemic risk. Clarín notes the vaccine producer delivered 2.4 million doses, suggesting unused or unregistered doses in NOMIVAC. The national plan vaccinates 4–59-year-olds in exposed provinces, regardless of serostatus; no vaccine exists for Chikungunya, underscoring the continued need for vector-control and preventive measures such as eliminating breeding sites and protective clothing.

article.articleHeadline: 中俄疑爆發「肺鼠疫」 卓榮泰：往返兩岸全面檢控、提前防範
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China and Russia Suspected Pneumonic Plague Outbreak; Zhu Rongtai: Comprehensive Cross-Strait Checks and Proactive Prevention.
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague in Irkutsk Region, Russia has triggered cross-strait vigilance. A 28-year-old female researcher died from an undiagnosed pneumonia; Russian authorities have not confirmed a plague diagnosis. China reportedly reports related rumors across several provinces, but Taiwan’s health authorities say laboratory tests have been negative so far, with no pathogen detected. The World Health Organization has been briefed to understand the outbreak’s cause, though specifics remain unconfirmed. Pneumonic plague is transmitted by droplets and can be highly lethal, with a case fatality up to about 60% for the pneumonic form; bubonic and septicemic forms are also noted. Taiwan’s Premier Zhu Rong-tai has ordered comprehensive checks between the two sides and proactive prevention, with the health ministry and MAC closely monitoring and leveraging COVID-19 experience for early deployment. No concrete cases have been reported, but surveillance will continue given cross-strait travel and business ties.

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A gây suy hô hấp nặng dù người bệnh chỉ sốt nhẹ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A causes severe respiratory failure despite the patient having only a mild fever.
article.articleSummary: Two patients with influenza A developed severe respiratory failure requiring ventilation and were admitted to the National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases Hospital in Hanoi, Vietnam. The first, 72-year-old H.X.T., admitted Oct 6 for fever, cough, and progressive dyspnea. A rapid test confirmed influenza A; chest imaging showed pneumonia with extensive lung injury, needing 40–50% FiO2 to maintain oxygenation. After three days fever subsided and hemodynamics stabilized, but lung injury remained severe, and he remained on non-invasive ventilation. A history of hypertension and a recent stroke reduced cough efficiency, increasing mucus retention and ventilation risk. The second patient had COPD and a long smoking history; despite only ~38°C fever, dyspnea worsened rapidly. He required high-flow oxygen, then endotracheal intubation and intensive care. Influenza A can worsen inflammation and airway obstruction in COPD, hastening respiratory failure. Vaccination is urged for high-risk groups, alongside hand hygiene and cough etiquette.

article.articleHeadline: 肺鼠疫蔓延至北京？網傳2病例是7年前 中俄再加強邊境控管
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague spreading to Beijing? Two online-reported cases date back seven years; China and Russia tighten border controls again.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague concerns tied to Russia’s Far East have prompted China to bolster border controls. In Russia’s Irkutsk region, a 28-year-old female plague-researcher died of pneumonia of unknown origin; over 5,000 tests have found no causative pathogen, and WHO reports no evidence of ongoing transmission. China’s northeast cities, including Manzhouli and Hulunbuir, issued risk notices and strengthened port and customs surveillance to track entries from Russia. Online posts claimed two pneumonic plague cases in Beijing, but these referred to a 2019-11 incident, not a current outbreak. The two patients from Inner Mongolia’s Xilingol League Sunitezuoqi were treated in Beijing’s Chaoyang District; one was critically ill, the other stable, with close contacts quarantined for 9 days and no additional infections. This was China’s first imported pneumonic plague case in a major city; Inner Mongolia later reported isolated bubonic plague cases, which were controlled.

triage.notes: 記事の主眼はネット上の『北京に肺ペストが拡大』との噂を否定する内容であり、実際に言及されている北京・内モンゴルの症例は2019年の既往例。現時点で確認されている新規事例はロシア・イルクーツク州の研究者の死亡（原因病原体未特定、WHOはヒト-ヒト感染の証拠なしと報告）であり、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。中国は国境管理強化という行政対応のみで、国内での新規感染確認情報はないため対象国として計上せず。続報でロシア側病原体特定や中国国内での新規症例確認があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Isiro : planification de nouveaux mécanismes pour réduire le taux de mortalité - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Isiro: planning new mechanisms to reduce the mortality rate - ACP
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak response update from Isiro, Haut-Uélé, in North-East Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), dated 13 October 2026, reports planning new measures to lower mortality. The coordination team plans to add non-Ebola diagnostics and management at the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC), including screening and treatment for diabetes, hypertension, and HIV/AIDS, to address comorbidity-related deaths. Laboratory teams will perform broader tests beyond Ebola sampling. The plan envisions intensive care capacity and a blood bank, along with meeting other urgent needs, leveraging existing equipment at Isiro's General Referral Hospital and the health zone. Surveillance leadership notes most fatalities arise from complications related to comorbidities. Recommendations were issued for immediate implementation in the presence of the provincial Ebola response coordinator, WHO representatives, and all response pillars. No case counts are provided in the report.

article.articleHeadline: Fevers, influenza cases surge in Hyderabad hospitals
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad hospitals report a sudden surge in viral infections, especially upper respiratory tract infections. Over the past week private nursing homes, clinics, and government hospitals have seen a heavy influx of patients with high fever, persistent cough, and respiratory distress across age groups. Paediatric wards, including Niloufer Hospital and Fever Hospital, note a sharp rise in young patients. Doctors warn that a simple viral fever can progress to influenza, underscoring the need for timely, accurate diagnosis and appropriate treatment, and caution against self-diagnosis and improper antibiotic use. Vulnerable groups with chronic conditions should watch for warning signs and seek prompt medical evaluation. Experts attribute weather pattern changes in Hyderabad and Telangana to slower acclimatization, contributing to susceptibility. Precautions emphasize early recognition of symptoms, avoiding self-medication, and seeking care for prolonged flu-like symptoms; no lab-confirmed figures or infection source provided; no imported/exported cases mentioned.

article.articleHeadline: Health Matters newsletter: Pathogens, pandemics and parleys
article.articleSummary: Russia reports a plague-related death amid uncertainty over pneumonic plague; WHO cites unconfirmed reports and seeks clarification on the causative agent as a lab worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute died on October 2; Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor says extensive testing found no plague and attributes illness to pneumonia, urging transparency. Separately, Kenya confirms its first Ebola case imported from Congo, with the patient dying in Nairobi; this marks the first Ebola death in a country outside DRC/Uganda during the outbreak, prompting stricter airport controls and testing, though WHO has not imposed travel bans. In India, the Supreme Court calls for capping trade margins on essential medicines, proposing 30% margins for patented and non-patented cancer drugs, and urging wider margin caps and display of rates for international patients; regulatory moves include tighter advertising controls and ethics rules for digital patient acquisition. Mental health topics include loneliness linked to distress among empty-nest parents, treatment-resistant depression, and dental anxiety.
