article.articleHeadline: 1889 - Epidemia de febre amarela mata em Corumbá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1889 - Yellow fever epidemic kills in Corumbá.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever outbreak in Corumbá, Brazil, prompted the steamship Dona Constança to reach Cuiabá around noon on October 13, 1889, carrying news and an appeal for help. The arrival caused widespread alarm in Cuiabá, with newspapers describing the deadly fever and the public distress it generated. Early death counts were not published; however, by November reports indicated the death toll in Corumbá had risen to about 300. Due to government precautions, the epidemic did not reach Cuiabá proper, though information reached the nearby village of Miranda, where yellow fever was reported to be invading. The governor acted promptly upon learning of the outbreak. The article cites contemporaneous sources: A Província de Mato Grosso (Oct 20, 1889), A Gazeta (Nov 21, 1889), and O Matto-Grosso (Jan 12, 1890).

article.articleHeadline: ООН: число подтвержденных случаев Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 8,9 тыс.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo has surpassed 8,900.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 8,900 confirmed cases, with 8,914 cases and 4,315 deaths (case fatality 48.4%) as of week 41 ending Oct 11, 2026. The outbreak now spans 65 districts across seven eastern provinces, up from the prior week. It began May 15 in the DRC and Uganda; Uganda declared its outbreak over July 28, with WHO confirmation Aug 25. On Oct 6, Kenya reported its first Ebola case, a Kenyan national who had visited the DRC and died in hospital. Since Oct 5, 472 new confirmed cases and 235 deaths have been recorded. The UN OCHA bulletin notes ongoing transmission in eastern DRC and rising cross-border risk to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ確定症例数が8,900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8,900例・致死率48.4%に達し、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染も確認されており、国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既に終息宣言済み（2026年7月28日）、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの継続的な流行拡大が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Comment l'Allemagne forme le personnel soignant contre le virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Germany trains healthcare workers against the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains uncontrolled in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with 9,000 infections and 4,000 deaths to date; 800–1,000 patients are hospitalized in Ituri and North Kivu. Uganda has been declared Ebola-free by the WHO, but Kenya has reported a fatal case and Uganda has dozens of infections. German specialists are training frontline health workers on the ground, including a recent session in Entebbe, Uganda, where around 30 local clinicians were instructed by Louise Götze. Berlin-based experts aim to build a regional pool of about 120 clinicians from East African Community states; graduates in Kinshasa have begun organizing further trainings. In Berlin, simulations using mannequins illustrate Ebola care, while plastic wall panels reduce PPE needs, enabling staff to observe patients without full suits. Since June, Germany has committed 21 million euros for PPE and training, highlighting global health investment.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツがエボラウイルスに対抗するため医療従事者を訓練する方法
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で9000人感染・4000人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が依然制御不能であり、ケニア・ウガンダへの国際的拡大も報告されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）での大規模エボラ流行を主題とし、ケニア・ウガンダへの拡大にも言及しているが、ウガンダ・ケニア・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ACAPS Briefing Note: Democratic Republic of Congo - Mpox outbreak affecting Kasaï province (13 October 2025)
article.articleSummary: Mpox outbreak declared in Democratic Republic of Congo’s Kasaï province after 16 September 2026, with 1,017 cases and over 24 deaths reported across all 18 health zones by 1 October. The surge follows the government’s 2 April shift from national mpox emergency to resilience; it remains unclear whether transmission is ongoing locally or represents a new introduction. Early reporting (1–2 September) pinpointed Kambangoma and Mukwandjanga in Luebo health zone as main affected sites, with laboratory confirmation pending from the National Biomedical Research Institute and reliance on outsiders for diagnostics. Hospital reports highlighted limited equipment and vulnerable patients, including infants aged 2–3 months. On 4 October, Rapid Intervention Teams were deployed to Tshikapa to bolster surveillance, case investigation, management, and community awareness, while resources are stretched by concurrent measles outbreaks and suspected yellow fever; as of 9 October, no Ebola cases had been reported in the province.

triage.headline_ja: ACAPSブリーフィングノート:コンゴ民主共和国 - カサイ州で拡大するエムポックス流行（2025年10月13日）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国カサイ州で死亡者24名以上・症例1,017件のエムポックス流行が報告され、麻疹や黄熱疑いも併発しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態と判断される。
triage.notes: 麻疹・黄熱疑いの同時発生によりリソースが逼迫、診断は外部機関に依存。エボラは報告なし（2025年10月9日時点）。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : le gouverneur menace de sanctions les hôpitaux qui cachent des cas d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: the governor threatens sanctions against hospitals that hide Ebola cases - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Kisangani. Since the outbreak was declared on 28 June 2026, Tshopo has recorded 62 confirmed Ebola cases, with 25 deaths, 29 recoveries, and eight patients currently in care; nearly 3,000 contacts have been identified. Governor Paulin Lendongolia warned that public and private health facilities treating Ebola patients without informing the response teams will face heavy sanctions, saying such withholding jeopardizes the response. Sanctions have already been imposed on non-compliant facilities, with further action planned for repeat offenders. He announced several decrees to strengthen prevention and urged health professionals to cooperate while calling on the public to strictly adhere to hygiene and prevention measures. Rapid notification of suspected or confirmed cases and transparency in health facilities are stressed as essential to early care and curbing spread.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:知事がエボラ症例を隠す病院に制裁を警告 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続中(62例確定・25死亡)であり、医療機関による症例隠蔽が報告されるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念と管理可能性の問題が認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラはDRCでは既知の疾患で既に対応体制があるため異常性は低いが、致死率約40%、約3000人の接触者、医療機関の症例隠蔽という管理上の課題があり継続監視・フル評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 中俄疑爆發「肺鼠疫」 卓榮泰：往返兩岸全面檢控、提前防範
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China–Russia Suspected Pneumonic Plague Outbreak; Zhu Rong-tai: Full cross-strait checks and proactive prevention.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Irkutsk region is suspected of pneumonic plague after a 28-year-old female researcher died of pneumonia of unknown origin; while no confirmed plague case has been laboratory confirmed, reports of suspected infections in China have circulated. Taiwanese Premier Zhu Rong-tai ordered comprehensive surveillance and proactive prevention; no concrete cases have been identified domestically. The Ministry of Health and Welfare, citing MOFA-assisted coordination, said its team has liaised with the WHO; samples tested so far are negative for Yersinia pestis, the plague bacterium, with no pathogen detected. Health authorities note pneumonic plague, unlike bubonic and septicemic forms, spreads via droplets and carries a fatality rate up to 60%. Mainland Affairs Council says it will closely monitor information from China, leveraging COVID-19 experience to preempt emerging threats and will inform Taiwanese businesspeople and cross-strait travelers as needed. No imported or exported cases have been reported in Taiwan so far.

triage.headline_ja: 中露で疑われる『肺ペスト』発生 台湾の卓栄泰行政院長：両岸往来の全面検査・事前防範を指示
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で原因不明肺炎による死亡例が肺ペスト疑いとして報告され、台湾政府が全面的な検疫・監視体制を敷くなど行政・社会的関心が高いため、確定診断前だがフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 疑い例の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国での感染報告は未確認の噂レベルであり、記事本文でも検体検査はエルシニア・ペスティス陰性とされているため、現時点では確定事例地域として中国を含めない。台湾は監視体制強化のみで国内発生なし。続報での確定診断・感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Measles Makes A Comeback: Could The US Outbreak Spark A Worldwide Spread Of Cases?
article.articleSummary: Measles is resurging worldwide, despite elimination in the United States in 2000. By Oct 8, 2026, the US reported 4,080 confirmed cases, with New York declaring a disaster emergency and Pennsylvania reporting over 1,000 cases. Bangladesh faces an exceptionally severe outbreak, with more than 166,000 suspected cases and 999 suspected or confirmed measles-related deaths since March 2026, including 100 confirmed deaths. The CDC global surveillance summary notes major outbreaks February–July 2026 in Bangladesh, Guatemala, India, Yemen, Pakistan, Mexico, Cameroon, South Africa, Kazakhstan and Angola. The piece emphasizes vaccination gaps as key drivers; India’s Universal Immunization Programme yields about 98% first-dose and 95% second-dose coverage, but pockets of under-immunisation persist. Experts warn herd immunity should exceed 95% to interrupt transmission, and advocate catch-up vaccination and rapid outbreak response to protect vulnerable children.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が再流行：米国のアウトブレイクは世界的な感染拡大を引き起こすか？
triage.triage_reason: 米国やバングラデシュなど複数国で麻疹の大規模流行・死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）が複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は主に米国（2000年に排除達成後の再流行）とバングラデシュ（166,000例・999例の死亡）の深刻な流行を中心に報じているが、インドについても予防接種率（98%初回・95%二回目）と未接種地域の存在に言及があり、対象国として含めた。他の言及国（パキスタン、南アフリカ、イエメン、グアテマラ、アンゴラ、カメルーン、カザフスタン、メキシコ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola/Tshopo : le gouverneur menace de suspendre les structures sanitaires fautives | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in Tshopo: the governor threatens to suspend the defective health facilities
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains active in Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Kisangani. As of October 12, 2026, 60 confirmed cases have been recorded with 25 deaths; 29 have recovered and eight are still under medical care. Response teams have identified about 3,000 contacts under surveillance to rapidly detect new infections. Governor Paulin Lendongolia announced sanctions against health facilities that conceal suspected or confirmed cases, ordering immediate suspension of involved structures and warning against obstructing response efforts. A temporary suspension of traffic on National Route RN4 was discussed to limit inter-provincial movement, though not yet decided. Preventive measures remain in force, including restrictions on transport and handling of corpses, crowd-control at gatherings, and adherence to hygiene measures. Residents are urged to report symptoms promptly and cooperate with health authorities to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ/チョポ州：州知事、不正を犯した医療機関の業務停止を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率の高いエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続中で、60例確認・25名死亡という重大な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、国境を越えた拡大や移動制限措置も検討されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約41.7%（25/60）と高く、約3000人の接触者が監視下にある。州間移動制限（RN4閉鎖）も検討されており、感染拡大のリスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 呼伦贝尔紧急发布鼠疫风险提示：1927年以来从未出现人间病例，但边境线那头出事了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hulunbuir Issues Urgent Plague Risk Warning: No Human Plague Cases Since 1927, but Something Happened Across the Border.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-11, Hulunbuir City Center for Disease Control and Prevention in Inner Mongolia issued a plague risk warning after a staff member at Russia’s Irkutsk Plague Prevention and Control Research Institute died of an unknown pneumonia. No human plague cases have occurred in Hulunbuir since 1927, and local surveillance has not detected pneumonic or bubonic plague outbreaks, but cross-border movement with Russia’s Far East keeps input risk under watch. Manzhouli, a major land port on the China–Russia border, held a risk assessment on 2026-10-08, stressing heightened monitoring of the ongoing input risk from Russia. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis (Class A, ‘No. 1 disease’), transmitted by fleas, contact with infected animals, or respiratory droplets; incubation 1–6 days, pneumonic plague can spread between people and has high mortality without early antibiotics. Guidance emphasizes three don’ts, three do’s, three protections; travelers from the Russian Far East should seek care and report travel history if symptomatic. No emergency status declared.

triage.headline_ja: 呼倫貝爾（フルンボイル）市がペストリスク警報を緊急発令：1927年以来ヒト感染例なしだが、国境の向こう側で異変が
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究機関職員が原因不明肺炎で死亡したことを受け、中国内モンゴル自治区フルンボイル市がペストリスク警報を発令。越境による感染拡大リスクが明示的に指摘されており、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスクに該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 実際の死亡事例はロシア・イルクーツク（対象国リスト外）で発生しており、原因もペストと未確定（『原因不明肺炎』）。中国（内モンゴル）側では確定症例はなく、あくまで越境リスクに対する予防的警報であるため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。続報でロシア側の原因確定や中国側での症例発生があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Opinion | After Russia's plague incident, U.S. readiness needs urgent review
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague death of Darya Shipilova at Irkutsk Antiplague Institute of Siberia raises global concerns about Moscow's biowarfare trajectory. Russia claims no cause for alarm, but U.S. officials caution given history of dual-use biology and past Biopreparat programs. The piece cites Ken Alibek's account of Soviet weapons development, references Stepnogorsk, and notes that many labs conduct both defensive biodefense and potentially offensive work. Irkutsk's institute studies brucellosis, anthrax, and tularemia alongside plague, illustrating dual-use ambiguity. The article cites a 2026 U.S. intelligence assessment stating Russia continues developing chemical-biological warfare capabilities and China probably possesses CBW capabilities. It links Russia's gray-zone actions, including an August Leipzig drone incident, to broader national-security threats. It argues that lowering transparency alone is insufficient and urges urgent reassessment of U.S. readiness and safeguards for potential outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 【オピニオン】ロシアのペスト事件を受け、米国の備えに緊急見直しが必要
triage.triage_reason: 本件はロシア（イルクーツク）での研究所関連ペスト死亡事例に関する米紙のオピニオン記事であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）における実際の発生事例ではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの研究所（イルクーツク抗ペスト研究所）での死亡事例を基にした生物兵器リスクに関するオピニオン記事であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生事例ではない。中国への言及はCBW能力保有の推測のみで、実際の発生イベントではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bahaya Telur Mentah untuk Bayi, IDAI Ingatkan Risiko Infeksi Salmonella
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Danger of Raw Eggs for Infants, IDAI Warns of Salmonella Infection Risk.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Indonesian Pediatric Society (IDAI) warns against feeding raw or undercooked eggs to infants due to Salmonella infection risk. In response to a reported case, IDAI notes there is no medical confirmation that raw eggs caused the infant's death. Salmonellosis can cause diarrhea, fever, vomiting, abdominal cramps, and dehydration, with infants and young children at higher risk of complications due to developing immune systems. Parents should avoid giving raw or undercooked eggs to babies and ensure safe food handling, appropriate nutrition, and readiness for age. Watch for warning signs: persistent diarrhea, fever, vomiting, severe irritability, or dehydration; newborns with fever of 38°C (100.4°F) or higher should seek medical evaluation. Guidance applies to infants in Indonesia, emphasizing precaution rather than attributing causation to dietary factors.

triage.headline_ja: 乳児への生卵の危険性、インドネシア小児科学会がサルモネラ感染リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、乳児への生卵摂取に関する一般的な健康啓発・注意喚起記事であり、単一の未確認死亡例を除き感染症の拡大や異常事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイク事例ではなく、小児科学会による食品安全に関する一般的な注意喚起であり、死亡例についても因果関係は医学的に未確認とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Comment l'Allemagne forme le personnel soignant contre le virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Germany trains healthcare workers against the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of October 13, 2026, Germany funds and coordinates Ebola training across East Africa. In Entebbe, Uganda, Louise Götze trained about 30 local clinicians on safe Ebola care to prevent staff contamination in the hot zone. Uganda is declared Ebola-free by WHO, while the Democratic Republic of Congo’s outbreak remains uncontrolled, with roughly 9,000 infections and 4,000 deaths, and 800–1,000 patients in treatment centers in Ituri and North Kivu. Götze has visited the DRC seven times this year; an eighth mission is planned. In Berlin, she demonstrates care on a mannequin, using innovative transparent walls to observe patients while reducing full PPE use. Since June, Germany has allocated 21 million euros for PPE and training, aiming to build a regional pool of about 120 clinicians from East African Community partners; Kinshasa graduates already organize local trainings. The initiative underscores robust international engagement to avert regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツがエボラウイルスに対抗する医療従事者をどう訓練しているか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で約9,000人感染・4,000人死亡という深刻かつ制御不能な大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツによる東アフリカでの医療従事者向けエボラ訓練支援が主題だが、根本的な感染イベントはDRCでの大規模かつ制御不能な流行（約9,000感染・4,000死亡）。ウガンダはWHOによりエボラ終息宣言済みのため発生国から除外。ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Malappuram's Wandoor reels under jaundice outbreak; confirmed cases cross 70
article.articleSummary: Jaundice outbreak in Malappuram's Wandoor with confirmed cases surpassing 70, including 66 in government hospitals; daily diagnoses rising across Wandoor and Kalikavu blocks. Majority of infections linked to a restaurant in Wandoor, which has been shut down. Several patients are seriously ill; others treated in private hospitals. Health officials, led by Panchayat President K.T. Shamsuddeen and Wandoor Taluk Hospital, have intensified awareness and preventive measures, with chlorination implemented and health checks for employees in all food establishments; health cards made mandatory. Concerns have been raised about health certificates issued without proper inspection. Neighboring panchayats are urged to heighten vigilance. Meetings have been held across panchayats, and directives issued to schools. Wandoor Taluk Hospital serves as the central hub for the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: マラップラム県ワンドゥールで黄疸(ジャンディス)の集団発生、確定症例が70人を超える
triage.triage_reason: インドのケララ州で飲食店を感染源とする黄疸(肝炎疑い)の集団発生が確認され重症例もあるが、原因病原体や国際的拡大の情報がなく、地域内で対応中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 黄疸の原因病原体（A型・E型肝炎など）は特定されておらず、地域の保健当局が飲食店の閉鎖や塩素消毒などの対策を実施中。続報での確定診断・感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: KDC'de 7 eyaleti etkileyen Ebola salgınında 8 bin 978 vaka, 4 bin 336 ölüm var
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak affecting seven provinces in the DRC: 8,978 cases, 4,336 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 8,978 confirmed cases and 4,336 deaths across seven provinces and 65 districts, with 2,356 recoveries. The case fatality rate is 48.3%, and contact-tracing coverage is 81%. In the last 24 hours, 18 people recovered, including a doctor in Tshopo province. No new confirmed cases were reported in Bas-Uele, South Kivu, or South Ubangi in that period. The outbreak was declared on May 15 after Ituri province reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths. The circulating Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant has no approved treatment or vaccine. Data come from the Democratic Republic of Congo Ministry of Communications, reflecting the ongoing eastern outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）、7州に拡大したエボラ流行で感染者8,978人、死者4,336人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%、7州・65地区に拡大した大規模エボラ流行であり、承認された治療法・ワクチンがないBundibugyo変異株が原因であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 5月15日の宣言以降、継続拡大中の東部エボラ流行。承認された治療・ワクチンがないBundibugyoウイルス変異株が循環しており、国際的な技術・資金支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Kwango: In Popokabaka, cholera spreads as access to safe water remains limited
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Popokabaka health zone, Kwango, DRC, declared 25 June 2026. By 22 July 2026, 345 suspected cases and 21 deaths (case fatality 6.1%) across 26 of 35 health areas; Vibrio cholerae confirmed by the National Institute of Biomedical Research. Sector Popo (Popo 1–2, Secteur Popo) accounts for 200 cases (58%). MSF supports the MOH with a cholera treatment centre at Popokabaka General Referral Hospital, four treatment units, and 31 oral rehydration points; 450 patients have been treated, including 175 at the hospital. Access to safe water is limited: 61% of people have less than 15 litres per person per day; 38% have functional latrines; open defecation remains common, with many relying on rivers. The outbreak unfolds amid fragile humanitarian conditions, including Mobondo violence and displacement from Angola. 36 chlorination points established; call for stronger coordination and sustainable water, sanitation and hygiene as the rainy season approaches.

triage.headline_ja: クワンゴ州:ポポカバカでコレラが拡大、安全な水へのアクセスは依然として限られている
triage.triage_reason: DRC・クワンゴ州ポポカバカで致死率6.1%のコレラ流行が継続・拡大しており、水衛生環境の悪化と人道危機が重なりIHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ポポカバカ保健区で345例・21死亡（CFR6.1%）、Vibrio cholerae確定。安全な水アクセス不足、モボンド紛争・アンゴラからの避難民流入による人道状況悪化、雨季接近により感染拡大リスクが高い。MSFが治療支援中だが持続的なWASH支援と調整強化が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: दून अस्पताल में वायरल मरीजों की भीड़, मौसम बदलते ही बढ़ी ओपीडी, एक दिन में डेंगू-चिकनगुनिया के 16 नए मरीज मिले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doon Hospital sees a crowd of viral patients as the weather changes; OPD visits rise; 16 new dengue-chikungunya cases detected in a day.
article.articleSummary: Dehradun, Uttarakhand: Doon Hospital reports rising viral illnesses as weather changes. On Monday (Oct 12, 2026), total OPD at Government Doon Medical College Hospital was 2,711, with Medicine seeing 501 patients. Fever, cough/cold, and body aches predominate, about 4 in 10 Medicine OPD cases. Dengue and chikungunya infections are rising in the district, with 16 new cases in a day—9 dengue and 7 chikungunya. Cumulative dengue cases reach 314 and chikungunya 203; 13 dengue patients are admitted across hospitals. Dengue testing: 471 samples tested on Monday with 9 positives; new cases include 3 from Dehradun and 6 from other districts. Overall, 40,080 dengue tests have been conducted with 314 positives; 152 Dehradun residents and 162 from other districts infected; 301 patients have recovered. Vector-control surveys of 7,201 homes found dengue larvae in 56, and 64 of 50,584 containers tested.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥーン病院でウイルス性疾患患者が急増、気候変動とともにOPD受診が増加、1日でデング熱・チクングニア熱16人の新規患者を確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱の増加であり、地域内で一定の対策（ベクターコントロール）が実施されているが、症例数の継続的増加があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性のベクター媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）の地域的増加。累計デング熱314例、チクングニア熱203例、13名入院。病原体監視・ベクターコントロール対策は実施中。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、国際的拡大の兆候もない。

article.articleHeadline: Ratusan Anak di Serpong Tangsel Alami Muntaber Massal, Air Perumahan Diduga Tercemar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of Children in Serpong, South Tangerang Suffer a Mass Gastroenteritis Outbreak; Housing Complex Water Suspected to Be Contaminated.
article.articleSummary: 146 residents, mostly children, in the SL housing complex in Serpong, Setu, South Tangerang (Tangsel) have suffered vomiting, diarrhea, and fever since Sept 14 through Oct 12, 2026, with dozens hospitalized. Authorities suspect contamination of the community water supply via the on-site Water Treatment Plant (WTP). Independent surveys show cases across six clusters within the complex. Laboratory testing of patient stool samples identified Escherichia coli, Salmonella, and Rotavirus infections, consistent with water- or foodborne transmission; water-supply samples are being tested by Labkesda, with results expected Friday Oct 16. Residents allege nearby lake area receives waste dumping, and a pipe feeding the house drainage appears to discharge into the lake, supporting but not yet confirming the contamination hypothesis. No response yet from developers or water suppliers; a public hearing with DPRD Tangsel is planned Oct 14. The outbreak remains under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 南タンゲラン・セルポンで数百人の子供が集団胃腸炎、住宅団地の水道水汚染が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: 住宅団地における146人規模の集団感染（嘔吐・下痢・発熱）で水道水汚染が疑われ、大腸菌・サルモネラ・ロタウイルスが検出されており、社会的・行政的関心（DPRD公聴会予定）も高いため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心ありでフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 単一住宅団地内での局地的な水系感染症アウトブレイクであり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、原因究明中であり続報（水質検査結果10/16予定）の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Plague in a Soviet weapons lab: Russia, Gog and the return of the plagues of Egypt
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague case at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia after 28-year-old Darya Shipilova breaks a test tube; she dies Oct 2 following severe pneumonia. In response, five hospitals are locked down and nearly 200 people placed in isolation; more than 60 institute staff confined. Border screenings are stepped up in Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan; authorities reportedly open a criminal investigation into health and safety violations. Rospotrebnadzor says Shipilova died of pneumonia of unknown etiology, with nearly 5,000 tests on contacts finding no dangerous pathogens, and notes she was vaccinated. The WHO reports negative tests for high-threat pathogens in Shipilova and contacts and no additional linked pneumonia cases, but cautions that no confirmed diagnosis exists. The Irkutsk institute, founded in 1934 to study plague and other agents, is described as a relic of Soviet biowarfare programs. The piece invokes parallels to COVID-era Wuhan and cites Pompeo’s warnings.

triage.headline_ja: ソ連時代の兵器研究所で発生したペスト：ロシア、ゴグ、そしてエジプトの疫病の再来
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの旧ソ連ペスト研究所で肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、多数の隔離・国境検査強化など国際的波及の懸念があり、WHOも調査に関与しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 事件発生地はロシア・イルクーツクであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。記事中で中国・武漢への言及はCOVID時代との比較のためであり、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。WHOの検査では高リスク病原体は陰性であり、確定診断は未確定とされている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго от лихорадки Эбола умерли 4315 инфицированных, число подтвержденных случаев превысило 8900: ООН
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 4,315 people infected with Ebola have died; the number of confirmed cases has exceeded 8,900: UN.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: 8,914 confirmed cases and 4,315 deaths (48.4% CFR) as of the 41st week ending Oct 11, 2026, per UN OCHA. Since Oct 5, 472 new confirmed cases and 235 deaths were reported. The outbreak now spans 65 districts across seven eastern provinces. It began May 15 in the DRC and Uganda. Uganda was declared to have overcome the outbreak on July 28, with WHO confirmation on Aug 25. On Oct 6, Kenya reported its first Ebola case; the patient was a Kenyan national who had been in the DRC and died in Kenya after returning home on Oct 5. Kenya’s health ministry said 293 tests were conducted and no additional cases were detected.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により4,315人が死亡、確定症例数は8,900人を超える：国連
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続中（8,914症例、CFR48.4%）で、ケニアへの国境越え感染も確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既にアウトブレイク収束が確認済み（2026年7月28日、WHO確認8月25日）。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事の主題はDRCにおける継続的なエボラ流行。

article.articleHeadline: 421 Desa/Kelurahan di Jateng Berstatus Siaga TB, Pemprov Terus Upayakan Skrining dan Pencegahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 421 Villages and Urban Villages in Central Java in TB Alert Status, Provincial Government Continues TB Screening and Prevention
article.articleSummary: TB in Central Java, Indonesia, is under intensified surveillance with 421 of 8,563 villages declared TB Alert as of 9 October 2026. District authorities report 68,617 TB cases detected (65.1% of the estimated burden), with 91.76% of patients starting treatment. Cure rates reach 84.07% for drug-susceptible TB and 79.54% for drug-resistant TB. New TB preventive therapy (TPT) coverage stands at 23.31% of a 326,038 target. The province promotes Active Case Finding (ACF) integrated into primary health services, aiming for coordinated screening, referrals, and treatment follow-up. Government programs—CKG clinics serving 18.8 million people as of 12 October 2026, and Speling mobile specialist doctors with 1,857 visits reaching ~131,500 people—are expanding access. Officials urge Ministry of Health support for workforce, diagnostics, digital tools, and ACF innovations; TB alerts were declared in Jepara Regency on 13 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ジャワの421村・字がTB警戒状態に、州政府がスクリーニングと予防を継続推進
triage.triage_reason: 結核(TB)は中部ジャワにおいて既知の風土病であり、本記事は既存のサーベイランス・治療プログラムの進捗報告であって、新規または異常な感染症イベントのシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性・既知の感染症であり、本記事は州政府による定例のスクリーニング・治療プログレス報告であるため、EBSシグナルとしての緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: DOH: Leptospirosis cases show continuous decline
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in the Philippines shows a downward trend: 1,814 cases Sept. 10–23, down 46% from 3,340 Aug. 27–Sept. 9; total 13,158 cases as of Oct. 7, up 48% versus 2025's same period (8,910). The DOH reports 13 provinces and 7 regions remain on alert; the year’s case fatality rate is 5.34%, down from 10.47% in 2025. Ongoing monitoring with local government units and Centers for Health Development, plus replenishment of doxycycline at rural health units and barangay health stations to support prophylaxis. Department Memorandum No. 2026-0427 authorizes doxycycline prophylaxis for eligible floodwater-exposed individuals and ensures distribution of essential medicines according to local needs. Public health guidance remains: avoid floodwater contact and seek early medical consultation after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: DOH:レプトスピラ症の症例は継続的に減少傾向
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症の症例は減少傾向にあるが、年間累計では前年比48%増加しており、一部地域で警戒が継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: DOHが継続的に監視・対応(ドキシサイクリン予防投与等)を行っており、国内管理下にあるイベント。症例数は減少傾向だが洪水時期の曝露リスクが継続しているため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Kasus Bayi Meninggal Diduga Diberi Telur Mentah, IDAI Peringatkan Bahaya Infeksi Bakteri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Infant Death Case Allegedly Given Raw Eggs, IDAI Warns of the Dangers of Bacterial Infections.
article.articleSummary: Infant death in Surabaya, East Java, reportedly linked to being fed raw eggs by a grandmother. IDAI warns raw eggs carry bacterial infection risks and urges strict adherence to age-appropriate feeding. Dr. Piprim Basarah Yanuarso states exclusive breastfeeding for six months is recommended, followed by complementary feeding (MPASI) with continued breastfeeding until age two or more. If breastfeeding is not possible, infant formula is advised by health professionals. MPASI is generally recommended at six months when energy and nutrient needs exceed what breast milk provides; in some medical conditions, early MPASI (around four months / 17 weeks) may be considered, but not routinely. Readiness for solid foods should be assessed holistically, including steady head/neck control, ability to sit with support, and swallowing coordination. Emphasis on food safety to prevent choking, aspiration, and infections.

triage.headline_ja: 生卵を与えられた乳児の死亡がバイラル化、IDAIが細菌感染の危険性を警告
triage.triage_reason: 単一の乳児死亡事例に関する育児・食品安全の啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本件は個別の乳児死亡事例に関する育児指導・食品安全啓発記事であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。SNS上で話題（viral）になっているが、これは育児に関する社会的関心であり、感染症危機管理の対象には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ülkedeki salgın 7 eyaleti etkisi altına aldı! Vaka sayısı 8 bini aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The outbreak in the country has affected seven states! The number of cases has surpassed eight thousand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo affects seven provinces across 65 districts, with 8,978 confirmed cases and 4,336 deaths. There have been 2,356 recoveries, a case fatality rate of 48.3%, and 81% of contacts followed up. In the last 24 hours, 18 people recovered, including a doctor in Tshopo Province; no new confirmed cases were reported in Bas-Uele, South Kivu, or South Ubangi. Ebola, a viral hemorrhagic fever, was first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC, with the name linked to the Ebola River near Ituri. The 2013–2017 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) infected about 30,000 and caused over 11,000 deaths. In eastern DRC’s Ituri, 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths led to an outbreak declaration on May 15. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant currently has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 国内の流行が7州に拡大！感染者数は8千人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認例8,978例、死亡4,336例（CFR48.3%）、7州65地区に拡大するエボラ出血熱の大規模流行であり、IHR基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事中のSudan、Sierra Leone、Liberia、Guineaは1976年発見時や2013-2017年西アフリカ流行の歴史的言及であり、現在の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。致死率48.3%と極めて高く、Bundibugyo variantには承認された治療薬・ワクチンがない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo nguy cơ suy hô hấp do cúm A ở người có bệnh nền
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Risk of Respiratory Failure Due to Influenza A in People with Underlying Conditions.
article.articleSummary: Two cases of influenza A cause severe respiratory failure at the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases in Vietnam, underscoring risk to the elderly and those with chronic disease. A 72-year-old man with hypertension and prior stroke was admitted on Oct 6, 2026 with fever, productive cough and progressive dyspnea; laboratory confirmation of influenza A revealed extensive lung injury and impaired oxygen exchange, requiring 40-50% oxygen and later non-invasive ventilation. A second patient, a longtime smoker with COPD, presented with cough, fatigue and mild fever, but rapidly developed dyspnea and required endotracheal intubation and intensive care. Influenza A inflames the airways and increases secretions, aggravating ventilation in damaged COPD airways and raising respiratory-failure risk. High-risk groups include children, the elderly, and those with chronic disease; prevention emphasizes annual vaccination, hand hygiene, coughing etiquette, and well-ventilated environments. Seek early medical evaluation for dyspnea, tachypnea, chest pain, cyanosis, confusion; avoid self-medication with antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 基礎疾患のある人における季節性インフルエンザA型による呼吸不全リスクへの警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの重症例2件の個別臨床報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、集団発生の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの基礎疾患患者における重症化事例の啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya gazettes new Ebola screening and quarantine rules
article.articleSummary: Kenya gazetted the Public Health (Ebola Disease) Rules 2026 to tighten screening, medical assessment, isolation and quarantine of travelers amid Bundibugyo Ebola importation. The regulations set entry controls, reporting and testing of suspected cases, investigations and contact tracing, facility designation, decontamination, and safe handling of deaths; they also assign transport operator duties. Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale declared Bundibugyo Ebola an epidemic disease under the Public Health Act. Kenya has recorded no new Ebola cases after 293 tests since the first confirmed patient’s death on Oct 5. The imported case involved a Kenyan who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and died in Nairobi, after traveling from DRC to Kampala, then flying to Nairobi on Oct 3. Kenya’s National Public Health Institute is the lead coordinator for prevention, preparedness, response and recovery. The outbreak in DRC stood at 8,978 cases and 4,336 deaths as of Oct 11.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、新たなエボラ検疫・隔離規則を官報告示
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラアウトブレイク（8,978例、4,336死亡）が継続しており、ケニアへの輸入症例も発生、ケニア政府が緊急規制を導入するなどIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの新規則制定だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アウトブレイクの発生源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ケニアでの輸入症例・規制導入は国際的拡大リスクの根拠として評価に反映。

article.articleHeadline: Hidden Microbes Ride Fine Particles in Indian Classroom Air, Study Finds
article.articleSummary: Agra, northern India (Indo-Gangetic Plain): a year-long study in four naturally ventilated classrooms finds indoor PM2.5 averaging 52.86 μg/m3 (SD 15.40), over ten times the WHO guideline of 5 μg/m3, driven by outdoor pollution and resuspension of dust. Using culture-based methods, researchers quantified bacteria and fungi associated with fine particles, including those below 1.0 μm; bacteria were more prevalent than fungi, with post-monsoon peaks for bacteria and monsoon peaks for fungi. Dominant bacterial genera were Bacillus, Staphylococcus, and Streptococcus; dominant fungal genera were Aspergillus, Penicillium, Alternaria, and Cladosporium. Shannon diversity indicated moderate-to-high culturable microbial diversity, higher for bacteria. The study implicates occupants and ambient air as sources of indoor bioaerosols, noting several genera are linked to respiratory illness, asthma, and allergic rhinitis in children. Findings reveal seasonal patterns in biologically active indoor air in one of the world’s most particle-polluted regions.

triage.headline_ja: インドの教室内空気中、微粒子に付着した微生物が発見される研究結果
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクや症例報告ではなく、教室内空気中の微生物叢に関する環境学術研究であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、インド・アグラの教室内空気質に関する学術研究であり、Streptococcusは検出された細菌属の一つに過ぎない。感染症イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Piranguçu divulga calendário de vacinação contra a brucelose para novembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piranguçu Announces November Vaccination Schedule Against Brucellosis.
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis vaccination campaign in Piranguçu, Minas Gerais, Brazil, runs 9–19 November 2026 across multiple communities. Organized by the Municipal Secretariat of Agriculture with Emater-MG support, the schedule assigns visits by date to guide rural producers in animal health and farm production. The lineup starts 9 November in Freires and Borges, moves 10 November to São Bernardo, Pintos, Bentos, Centro and Vila Maria, 11 November to Mouras and Antunes, 12 November to Antunes do Canto and Taquaral, 13 November to Boa Vista and Piranga, with a break then 16 November in Roques, Lemes and Usina São Bernardo, 17 November in Melos I/II, Capituba, Martins, Sobradinho, Pedra Vermelha and Correinhas, 18 November in Santo Antônio, Vera Cruz and Pouso Frio, and 19 November in Pedra Branca, Gamelão and Vieiras. At vaccination, rural producer number from IMA or owner's CPF is required. For details, contact Emater-MG Piranguçu at (35) 99135-0117.

triage.headline_ja: ピランギスーが11月のブルセラ症ワクチン接種スケジュールを発表
triage.triage_reason: 家畜向けの定期的なブルセラ症予防接種キャンペーンの案内であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 動物衛生当局による通常の予防接種啓発記事であり、疾病の発生事例報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 150 conducteurs de taxi-moto sensibilisés contre Ebola pour renforcer la surveillance communautaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 150 motorcycle taxi drivers sensitized about Ebola to strengthen community surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province prompts mobilization of 150 motorcycle taxi drivers to strengthen community surveillance. The initiative covers Bunia and health zones Rwampara, Nizi, Niania and Mungwalu, aiming to improve early detection, alert reporting, rumor control, and prevention messaging while protecting drivers. A briefing gathered 34 participants (14 associations presidents, 20 taxi-moto park chiefs) to reinforce their surveillance role. Drivers can alert authorities via the green hotline if asked to transport a sick person and are expected to relay prevention messages to counter misinformation, per WHO RDC risk communication focal point Katya Maliro. This effort complements the broader Ebola response in Ituri, seeking rapid alert transmission and trusted information within communities. Since the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, it has caused more than 4,100 deaths across seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele and Sud-Ubangi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：地域監視強化のためバイクタクシー運転手150人にエボラ啓発
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2026年5月15日に宣言されたエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中で、7州にわたり死者4,100人超という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事自体はイトゥリ州における地域監視強化の取り組み（バイクタクシー運転手への啓発）に焦点を当てているが、背景にあるエボラ流行自体は既に7州にわたり死者4,100人超の大規模アウトブレイクであり、継続的な監視対象として扱うべき。発生地域にはマリ・ルワンダも含まれるが、記事内容はDRCのみに関するものであり、対象国リストにも該当しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Nước mặt ở Đồng Nai: E.coli vượt hơn 1.000 lần, nhiều suối ô nhiễm nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surface water in Dong Nai: E. coli more than 1,000 times higher, many streams severely polluted.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli contamination dominates Dong Nai surface water quality concerns, with levels surpassing norms by up to 1,020 times in the fish-farming belt on the Dong Nai River. Across three 2026 monitoring rounds at hundreds of sites, widespread organic matter, nutrients, and microbial pollution persisted in multiple basins, including the Thao River and Dong Nai tributaries, while phenol, cyanide, and surfactants exceeded standards at several locations. Drinking-water intakes show drastic E. coli elevations: Thanh Son plant up to 550x (first round), still 6.5x in the third; Bien Hoa 55–70x; Thiện Tân 3.9–5.5x; Nui Le 13x; and the An Lộc Bridge area in Be River recording 110x. In the La Ngà basin, some sites remained heavily polluted (e.g., three Miệng drain with BOD5/COD). Tri An reservoir largely A–B, but Vĩnh An plant pH downgraded to D due to heat/algal blooms. Authorities urge tracing discharges from farms, livestock, and industries to protect drinking water and fisheries.

triage.headline_ja: ドンナイ省の表流水：大腸菌が基準値の1,000倍超、多数の河川・小川で深刻な汚染
triage.triage_reason: ヒトの感染症発生ではなく、河川・水源の水質（大腸菌等）環境モニタリング報告であり、公衆衛生上の症例報告や健康被害の記載がないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事は環境省庁による水質モニタリング（河川・飲料水取水口の大腸菌・有機物・重金属等の汚染状況）に関する報告であり、ヒトの感染症症例や発生状況の記載はない。公衆衛生イベントというより環境汚染問題として分類すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Dari Sekolah Mantri hingga FKUI, Semua Karena Penyakit Epidemi | Intisari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From the Mantri School to FKUI, All Because of Epidemic Disease | Intisari
article.articleSummary: During the 18th–19th centuries in the Dutch East Indies, Java faced epidemics of cholera, malaria, and smallpox, causing high child mortality. In Batavia, authorities established STOVIA to train native healthcare workers, leading to the Dokter Djawa title. Early data: smallpox mortality: 1781, 20 of 100 died; early 19th-century infant deaths: 102 of 1,019 newborns died of smallpox; 10–30% under 14 died. Willem Bosch proposed training indigenous vaccinators and healthcare assistants; 1849 Government Decision No. 22 authorized 30 Jawa youths to be trained as vaccinators in military hospitals. On Jan 1, 1851, the Onderwijs van Inlandsche élèves voor de geneeskunde en vaccine (first Bumiputra medical school) opened in Batavia; two-year program; Malay language instruction; curricula included Dutch language, basic science, medicine. Graduates titled Dokter Djawa by Government Decision No. 10, June 5, 1853. In 1874, radical reform extended programs to seven years; language shifted to Dutch.

triage.headline_ja: マントリ学校からFKUIまで、すべては流行病のせいだった | Intisari
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は18〜19世紀のオランダ領東インド時代における歴史的な疫病（コレラ・マラリア・天然痘）と医学教育の歴史を扱った歴史解説記事であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は現代の公衆衛生イベントではなく、歴史的背景を解説する教養記事。現在のインドネシアにおける疾病発生情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus respiratórios ainda estão em alta no país, alerta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory viruses are still on the rise in the country, warns Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin shows national SRAG (severe acute respiratory syndrome) rising due to rhinovirus, metapneumovirus, and SARS-CoV-2, while SRAG linked to COVID-19 remains low. COVID-19 vaccination is urged for the whole population; pregnant women should be vaccinated against RSV. Nationally, SRAG is increasing modestly among children and adolescents aged 2–14, with other ages stable. RSV and influenza B SRAG cases are decreasing; influenza A hospitalizations remain low. Regionally, Alagoas, Roraima, and Sergipe are at alert/risk/high SRAG in the last two weeks, with growth over six weeks; increases in Alagoas and Sergipe are linked to metapneumovirus, while the virus in Roraima is uncertain. Five states (Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina) and five capitals (Aracaju, Porto Alegre, Rio Branco, São Luís, Vitória) show alert/risk/high activity without long-term growth. Mortality peaks in older adults and incidence higher in under-2s.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器系ウイルス感染、国内で依然高水準 フィオクルスが警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の季節性呼吸器ウイルス(SRAG)サーベイランス情報であり、一部地域で増加傾向があるが、重篤性や国際的拡大の懸念は現時点で限定的。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症(RSV, hMPV, COVID-19, インフルエンザ等)の国内サーベイランス報告。一部州・州都で警戒レベルだが全国的な重症度急増や国際的懸念は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: เปิดภาพเคสคนไข้ พยาธิ ขดใต้ผิวหนังจนปูด พบประวัติเดินเท้าเปล่าในนาข้าว
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case image: parasite coiled under the skin into a bulge, with a history of walking barefoot in a rice field.
article.articleSummary: Cutaneous larva migrans (CLM) in a 58-year-old man who walked barefoot in a rice field. A red, intensely pruritic, serpiginous rash on the left foot gradually expanded over several days. Clinically diagnosed as CLM based on lesion appearance and environmental exposure; no laboratory tests or biopsy were performed. The patient received albendazole 400 mg once daily for 3 days. At a 2-week follow-up, pruritus had resolved and the lesion cleared, with no recurrence on subsequent check. The report highlights transmission by dog- and cat-hookworm larvae penetrating unprotected skin, particularly in moist, poorly sanitized soil. Preventive measures include wearing footwear and using mats or coverings when in contact with soil. If a migrating serpiginous rash appears, seek medical evaluation rather than self-medicating with antiparasitics.

triage.headline_ja: 皮膚の下にコイル状に寄生虫が隆起したケース画像、裸足で田んぼを歩いた既往歴
triage.triage_reason: 単発の皮膚幼虫移行症（人獣共通の寄生虫症）の症例報告であり、治療により軽快しヒト-ヒト感染もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の臨床報告であり、人獣共通感染症（犬・猫の鉤虫幼虫）による局所皮膚病変。ヒト-ヒト感染なし、治療反応良好で予後良好。

article.articleHeadline: Колькасць пацверджаных выпадкаў Эболы ў ДР Конга перавысіла 8,9 тыс. - ААН
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the DR Congo surpassed 8.9 thousand — UN.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 8,900 confirmed cases with over 4,300 deaths. UN OCHA’s 41st epidemiological week bulletin (week ended Oct 11, 2026) reports 8,914 confirmed cases and 4,315 fatalities, CFR 48.4%. Since the Oct 5 update, 472 new confirmed cases and 235 deaths were recorded. The outbreak now affects 65 districts across seven eastern provinces, one more district than the prior week. The outbreak began May 15 in the DRC and neighboring Uganda. Uganda’s outbreak was declared over on Jul 28 and subsequently confirmed by WHO on Aug 25. On Oct 6, Kenya reported its first Ebola case—an imported case involving a Kenyan citizen who had visited the DRC and died in hospital. The situation highlights ongoing transmission hotspots in eastern DRC and regional cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定症例数が8.9万人を超過 — 国連
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱が8,900例超・死者4,300例超（致死率48.4%）に達し、65地区に拡大、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは7月28日に終息宣言済み（8月25日WHO確認）、ケニアは10月6日に輸入症例を1例報告。両国とも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заражения Эболой в ДР Конго достигло 8 978
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in DR Congo has reached 8,978.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 8,978 confirmed cases and 4,336 deaths, according to the Ministry of Communications. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, it has spread across 65 districts in seven provinces. Recovered total stands at 2,356; case fatality rate is 48.3%. In the last 24 hours, 18 more patients recovered. Bas-Uele, South Kivu, and South Ubangi provinces reported no new confirmed cases. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Surveillance and control efforts remain ongoing across affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱感染者数が8,978人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する大規模アウトブレイク（感染者8,978人、死亡4,336人、致死率48.3%、7州65地区に拡大）であり、ワクチン・治療法未承認のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス変異株による大規模アウトブレイクで、承認済みワクチン・治療法がない。CFRが48.3%と非常に高く、7州65地区に拡大しており継続的な国際支援が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: ডেঙ্গু নিয়ন্ত্রণে আগাম প্রস্তুতিতে মৃত্যুহার কমেছে ৪০ শতাংশ : স্বাস্থ্য প্রতিমন্ত্রী
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 40% reduction in dengue mortality through proactive preparedness: State Minister for Health.
article.articleSummary: Dengue mortality in Bangladesh has fallen about 40% this year due to four months of proactive preparedness, with deaths dropping from 5 to 3 per 1,000 reported cases. State Minister for Health Dr. MA Muhith credited specialized doctor training and science-based treatment, alongside a national plan and anticipatory warnings that the September–October peak could extend into November. Field measures include nationwide sanitation drives led by the Prime Minister, with roughly 1,000 young volunteers from Red Crescent and Scouts, and weekly Saturday campaigns across government institutions. Dhaka and Khulna divisions face higher patient loads, and local authorities are intensifying mosquito and larva control in these areas, while stressing citizen responsibility for home hygiene. On vaccines, discussions with the Prime Minister emphasized cautious, data-driven approval in Bangladesh; several vaccines have progressed in trials in ~30 countries, with India permitting private use. Japan’s vector-control technology is also under trial to bolster control efforts, and about 2,000 doctors across 64 districts have received refresher dengue training.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策の事前準備により死亡率が40%減少：保健担当国務大臣
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュにおける季節性デング熱の対策進捗を伝える内容で、死亡率低下という好転報告であり、異常事態や新規シグナルには該当しない。また同国は対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性デング熱対策の進捗報告であり、バングラデシュが主題。同国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。インドは私的ワクチン使用の文脈で言及されるのみで、イベント発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 421 Desa di Jateng Berstatus Siaga Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 421 Villages in Central Java Are in Tuberculosis Alert Status.
article.articleSummary: TB in Central Java, Indonesia: By Oct 9, 2026, 421 villages (4.92% of 8,563 desa/kelurahan) were placed under Tuberculosis Alert status as part of expanded TB control. TB case finding reached 68,617 cases, about 65.08% of the target. Among those diagnosed, 91.76% began treatment. Cure rates among drug-susceptible TB stood at 84.07%, while drug-resistant TB treatment success was 79.54%. TB preventive therapy (TPT) progress is at 23.31% of a 326,038-target. Sekda Sumarno emphasized multisectoral engagement across central, provincial, district/city governments and communities as essential to TB control. The declaration at Desa Siaga TB in Jepara on Oct 13 calls for stronger prevention, especially for close contacts, and for integrating Active Case Finding (ACF) with primary health services to streamline screening, referrals, recording, and follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ジャワの421村が結核警戒状態に
triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域流行疾患（結核）に対する行政の通常対策・プログラム進捗報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は地域流行病であり、記事は政府のサーベイランス・対策プログラムの進捗報告。新規異常事態ではないためDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Hyundai Bioscience eyes Phase 2 trials for tick-borne disease drug
article.articleSummary: Hyundai Bioscience announced in Seoul on 2026-10-13 that it will advance antiviral XAFTY into Phase 2 trials for severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), a deadly tick-borne viral infection with no approved therapy. SFTS spreads via tick bites and can cause high fever, thrombocytopenia, multi-organ failure, and death. In South Korea, the disease shows a cumulative fatality rate around 18%; in 2025 there were 41 deaths among 280 reported cases (annual fatality 14.6%). Healthcare workers face occupational risk from transmission through blood and bodily fluids. Laboratory data indicate XAFTY can suppress viral replication, though human safety and efficacy remain untested. SFTS cases have been reported mainly in China, Japan, and South Korea, with additional cases in Vietnam, Myanmar, Thailand, and Pakistan."} }

triage.headline_ja: 現代バイオサイエンス、マダニ媒介感染症治療薬の第2相試験を計画
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は韓国企業によるSFTS抗ウイルス薬の臨床試験計画に関する創薬ニュースであり、新規の感染症発生や急性のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は製薬企業の治療薬開発進捗に関する報道であり、SFTSの既知の疫学的背景（中国・日本・韓国で主に報告、ベトナム・ミャンマー・タイ・パキスタンでも報告例）は一般的な説明として言及されているのみで、新規発生イベントではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: DPRD Tangsel Panggil Pengembang dan Warga usai Ratusan Anak Alami Gejala Muntaber Massal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Tangerang DPRD summons developers and residents after hundreds of children experienced mass gastroenteritis symptoms.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 13, 2026, South Tangerang City Council (DPRD) summoned housing developers, water-supply providers, and resident representatives for a Public Hearing (RDPU) on a mass gastroenteritis outbreak in Setu, Serpong, South Tangerang. At least 146 residents, mostly children, have reported vomiting, diarrhea, and fever since Sept 14–Oct 12, with dozens hospitalized across six housing clusters. Investigators suspect contamination of drinking water delivered via a Water Treatment Plant (WTP). Water samples have been taken; Labkesda results were expected by Oct 16. Stool tests and hospital reports show infections with Escherichia coli, Salmonella, and Rotavirus, pathogens linked to contaminated water or food. Residents allege the source is a lake (initials SL) within the housing area connected to the WTP; the lake reportedly receives waste disposal and a pipe discharges domestic wastewater into it. PDAM water is unavailable; RDPU is scheduled for Oct 14.

triage.headline_ja: 南タンゲラン市議会(DPRD)、数百人の子供に集団胃腸炎症状が発生後、開発業者と住民を召喚
triage.triage_reason: 住民146人（主に児童）が水系感染症（E.coli、サルモネラ、ロタウイルス）を発症し入院者も出ており、行政が公聴会を開催するなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 原因として水道供給(WTP)経由の水質汚染が疑われており、湖への生活排水流入が指摘されている。検査結果（Labkesdaの水質検査）は10月16日に判明予定で、続報で原因特定・対応状況を確認する必要がある。現時点では国内限定の事案で国際的拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ninh Bình tăng cường phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết trong cao điểm mùa dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ninh Binh strengthens dengue fever prevention and control during the peak dengue season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Ninh Binh Province, Vietnam, as of 13 Oct 2026: 341 dengue cases, 0 deaths; 67 outbreaks (57 ended, 10 active). Peak transmission in August–September: September alone recorded 151 cases; early October total 39. Nam Dinh Ward had the highest local incidence (26 cases). Ninh Binh Provincial Center for Disease Control reports routine epidemiological investigations, vector surveillance, and targeted environmental clean-ups in high-risk areas; gaps included outdoor water storage and vegetation. Six ongoing/long-lasting outbreaks: one active in Viet Hong Hamlet, Hai Hau Commune (6 cases); five ended with 13, 12, 12, 11, and 6 cases. Some cases imported from other localities. Response includes training about 450 health workers (September), expanded surveillance, chemical control, and community education; households advised to cover water containers, remove standing water, and conduct weekly larvivorous measures. Hot, humid, rainy weather and inter-provincial travel sustain transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: ニンビン省、流行ピーク期におけるデング熱予防・対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニンビン省における季節性デング熱の定例サーベイランス報告であり、死亡例なし、地元当局が通常の対応（媒介動物対策・教育）で管理できている。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病であり、8-9月の流行ピークは例年通り。死亡例なしで地元CDCが訓練・サーベイランス・環境対策を実施済み。外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 【新聞直擊】上海驚傳鼠疫 4省病例擴散？中共被爆操盤電詐！ | 俄羅斯 | 美軍 | 軍艦
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Breaking News] Shanghai Reports Plague Outbreak; Cases Spreading to Four Provinces? The CCP Exposed as Orchestrating Telecom Fraud! | Russia | U.S. Military | Warship
article.articleSummary: Unverified social-media claims allege a Russia-linked pneumonic plague outbreak is spreading in China, naming Shanghai and Chongqing as affected cities. Posts quote Henan and Inner Mongolia border areas, and even hospitals in Inner Mongolia’s Er’enhot (Erenhot), alleging dozens of cases and altered records to hide the disease. Other rumored locations include Hohhot, Chifeng, Tongliao, and Baotou, with further insinuations of hospital infections and deaths. Chinese health authorities in Inner Mongolia and officials in Shanghai and Chongqing have denied any confirmed pneumonic plague cases or local transmission, and no independent verification has been provided. Hong Kong’s Department of Health says surveillance is in place for potential imported cases. The piece highlights misinformation risks during health scares and emphasizes the absence of laboratory-confirmed data or official case counts.

triage.headline_ja: 【速報】上海で疫病流行か？4省に拡大との情報、中国共産党が電信詐欺を主導していたとの暴露も | ロシア | 米軍 | 軍艦
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト流行の噂はソーシャルメディア上の未検証情報であり、上海・重慶・内モンゴル当局が公式に感染例を否定している。独立検証や検査確定データがなく、信頼性の低い政治色の強いメディア発信のため現時点でのフルRRAは時期尚早だが、香港が監視体制を敷いているなど一定の関心があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事自体が『未確認のソーシャルメディア上の主張』であることを明記しており、中国当局（内モンゴル・上海・重慶）は公式に感染例や地域内伝播を否定している。情報源(NTDTV)は政治的偏向の強いメディアであり、独立検証や検査確定データは存在しない。香港衛生署は輸入症例への監視体制を敷いているとのことだが、これは噂への予防的対応であり、実際の発生確認ではない。対象国リストの中国(1814991)は地理的に言及されているが、サマリーの主題は『噂・誤情報』であり、実際の発生確認がないためverified_locationsには含めない。続報で公式な検査確定例が報告されるか注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A gây co giật ở trẻ, suy hô hấp ở người lớn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A causes seizures in children, respiratory failure in adults.
article.articleSummary: In Hanoi, Vietnam, influenza A causes severe disease. The National Hospital of Tropical Diseases reports two elderly cases with respiratory failure: a 72-year-old man with hypertension and a prior stroke, admitted on 6-10 after fever and productive cough; rapid test positive for influenza A, diagnosed with severe pneumonia requiring oxygen therapy (40–50% O2) and ventilation; a COPD patient with long smoking history developed progressive dyspnea and hypoxemia and required intubation. Meanwhile, the National Children’s Hospital treats about 40 influenza cases daily, mostly under 5 years old, especially under 3. A 2-year-old presented with fever (39°C) and convulsions; doctors warn of acute necrotizing encephalopathy (ANE), a rare but serious influenza A complication in children. The report emphasizes that influenza A can cause pneumonia, myocarditis, encephalopathy, and multi-organ failure. Vaccination and prompt care for high-risk groups are urged.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAウイルスが小児に痙攣、成人に呼吸不全を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: ハノイの病院で季節性インフルエンザAによる重症例（呼吸不全、脳症疑い）が報告されているが、流行規模や異常性を示す具体的データが不足しており、通常の季節性流行の範囲内か判断できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザAによる重症例（高齢者の呼吸不全、小児の急性壊死性脳症疑い）を報告しているが、症例数の急増や異常なクラスター発生など、通常の季節性流行を超える兆候は明示されていない。続報で患者数の推移や地域拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : 137 écoles de Mambasa ciblées pour former 685 enseignants à la prévention
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: 137 Mambasa schools targeted to train 685 teachers in prevention.
article.articleSummary: Ebola prevention training for teachers in Ituri's Mambasa territory: 137 schools will train 685 teachers to strengthen school-based prevention amid the Ebola outbreak in this part of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The schools comprise 12 kindergartens, 84 primary, and 41 secondary institutions. Five teachers per school will be trained to master behaviors to prevent transmission and to manage interactions with students during the epidemic. In addition to training, authorities will equip participating schools with handwashing stations and hydroalcoholic gels, and thermoflash devices for temperature screening. Temperature checks will be conducted before students enter classrooms, with handwashing facilities installed at classroom doors and school entrances. The initiative, announced by Dieudonné Asaba of EDUC-NC Mambasa 1 and reported by ACP on 13 October 2026, seeks to bolster protection of pupils and staff in the face of persistent Ebola in Mambasa.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ出血熱：マンバサの137校が685人の教員に予防教育を実施へ
triage.triage_reason: DRC・イツリ州マンバサ地域で持続的なエボラ出血熱の発生が続いており、学校での予防対策強化が報じられている。エボラは重篤度・国際的拡大リスクが高い疾患であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は新規感染報告ではなく、既存のエボラ流行下での学校向け予防教育・感染対策強化（手洗い設備、体温スクリーニング等）に関するもの。流行は継続中（persistent Ebola in Mambasa）であり、地域での感染リスクが依然存在することを示唆。
