triage.notes: 主発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれない。中国への波及は『未確認報告』レベルで、記事内でも確定症例は無いと明記されているため、China（1814991）は含めなかった。台湾政府の懸念・監視体制が報じられているが、台湾も対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Pensavamo fosse una malattia del Medioevo. Invece la peste non è mai scomparsa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: We thought it was a medieval disease. But the plague has never disappeared.
article.articleSummary: Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, remains endemic, circulating in natural cycles among small mammals and fleas; humans can be infected from animals or through respiratory droplets in pneumonic disease. From 2019–2025, WHO reports 3,847 suspected plague cases and 423 deaths (11% case fatality) across 10 countries; six countries reported confirmed cases: Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Madagascar, Uganda, China, and Mongolia, with most suspected cases in DRC and Madagascar. A current incident in Irkutsk, Russia, involved a female employee of the Anti-Plague Research Institute who died after severe pneumonia; initial reports suggested pneumonic plague and lab exposure, with about 200 contacts monitored. By Oct 10, 2026, WHO classified the event as pneumonia of undetermined cause; contacts remained asymptomatic, and tests for high-risk pathogens were negative; no transmission identified, and the deceased's diagnosis remains unresolved. Rapid antibiotics and surveillance distinguish today from medieval outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 私たちは中世の病気だと思っていた。しかしペストは一度も消えていなかった
triage.triage_reason: 記事はペストが依然として風土病として存在することを解説する一般的な科学記事であり、ロシア・イルクーツクでの事例もWHOにより原因不明肺炎と分類されペストは否定された。新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は2019-2025年のWHO統計に基づく歴史的・疫学的解説であり、DRCと中国は過去の確定症例報告国として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の発生事例ではない。ロシアの最新事例は最終的にペストと診断されず、原因不明肺炎として処理されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kemendagri Perkuat Kerja Sama Pemda hingga Desa dalam Eliminasi TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Home Affairs Strengthens Cooperation with Local Governments Down to the Village Level in TB Elimination
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Home Affairs strengthens cooperation with local governments, down to the village level, to accelerate tuberculosis (TB) elimination. Deputy Minister Akhmad Wiyagus outlines clear role division: provinces as policy-setters; regencies and municipalities as integrating APBD programs; districts as operational coordinators; and villages (desa) and lurah for data collection and case detection. The plan relies on interagency collaboration and community involvement, leveraging Posyandu, PKK, community leaders, academics, and media to raise awareness and reduce TB stigma. TB is curable, and elimination requires sustained collaboration and realization of constitutional rights to health services. Local governments are urged to ensure health programs in planning documents and APBD translate into on-the-ground action, not just paperwork. TB cadres, especially female volunteers, are praised for courage and dedication in implementing programs within communities.

triage.headline_ja: 内務省、結核撲滅に向けて村レベルまで地方政府との連携を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症（結核）対策に関する行政的・政策的な取り組みの報道であり、突発的な公衆衛生事象やアウトブレイクではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の新規発生やアウトブレイクではなく、既存の結核撲滅プログラムにおける行政連携強化についての報道。シグナルトリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo - Ebola : 60 cas confirmés et près de 3 000 contacts identifiés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo - Ebola: 60 confirmed cases and nearly 3,000 identified contacts.
article.articleSummary: 60 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in Tshopo province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, with 25 deaths; nearly 3,000 contacts identified and under surveillance. As of 12 October 2026, 29 patients have recovered and eight remain under medical care. Governor Paulin Lendongolia announced these figures in Kisangani, highlighting enhanced contact tracing to rapidly detect new infections and limit spread. Authorities warn health facilities that conceal suspected or confirmed cases may face sanctions, including immediate suspension. The possibility of temporarily suspending traffic on RN4 highway if the outbreak worsens was discussed but not yet enacted. Ongoing preventive measures include restrictions on handling corpses, limits on public gatherings, and adherence to hygiene measures. Residents are urged to cooperate with response teams and promptly report suspected cases to interrupt transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州 - エボラ出血熱：確認症例60件、接触者約3,000人を特定
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例60件・死亡25名という重大な公衆衛生イベントであり、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクと国際的関心が高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 致死率約42%（25/60）と高く、約3,000人の接触者追跡が進行中。RN4幹線道路の交通制限が検討されており、拡大リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Siaga TBC, Sekda Dorong Percepatan Eliminasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB Alert: Regional Secretary Urges Faster TB Elimination
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) control in Central Java, Indonesia, accelerates toward elimination via Desa Siaga TB (TB-Alert Villages). As of Oct 9, 2026, 421 of 8,563 desa/kelurahan are TB Alerts, with Deklarasi Desa Siaga TB held in Jepara on Oct 13. Regional Secretary Sumarno emphasizes village and community involvement to hasten case finding and ensure proper treatment. TB case finding reached 68,617 cases (65.08% case detection). Of these, 91.76% started treatment and 84.07% of drug-susceptible TB achieved treatment success. Tuberculosis Preventive Therapy (TPT) delivery stands at 23.31% of a target 326,038. Deputy Health Minister Benyamin Paulus Oktavianus praised contact-screening in Jepara, noting 107 of 161 screening points implemented. Desa Siaga TB seeks active local education, earlier case detection, patient support, and transmission prevention through collaboration among villages, health facilities, community cadres, and residents.

triage.headline_ja: 結核警戒：地方事務局長が結核撲滅の加速を促進
triage.triage_reason: 既知の地方病である結核対策の通常の行政活動を報じる内容であり、新規性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: インドネシア中部ジャワ州における結核撲滅プログラム（Desa Siaga TB）の進捗報告であり、通常の公衆衛生活動のニュース。

article.articleHeadline: Sister Nivedita: A brave soul who fought against plague & Marxists
article.articleSummary: During the 1899 plague outbreak in North Kolkata (Bagbazar, Shyampukur, Kumartuli, Chitpur), Margaret Elizabeth Noble—Sister Nivedita—took to the streets with broom, disinfectant, and care, cleansing drains, visiting the dying, and sheltering plague victims when authorities barred households. She funded medicines and food from her savings as relief lagged. After Vivekananda’s 1902 mahasamadhi, she broadened social and political renewal: championing women’s education at Bosepara Lane and guiding Anushilan Samiti and Jugantar, handing texts (Bhagavad Gita, Anandamath, French Revolution history), and helping revolutionary scientists (supporting Ray’s lab and Bose’s international recognition). Nivedita became a symbol of modern India’s nationalist revival, later vilified by Marxist/Left historians as Hindutva or bourgeois mystique. The clash was ideological: Vedantic nationalism versus dialectical materialism; her Kali the Mother (1900) and The Web of Indian Life (1904) were central to the critique, including M.N. Roy.

triage.headline_ja: シスター・ニヴェディタ：ペストとマルクス主義者と戦った勇敢な魂
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は1899年の歴史的なペスト流行とシスター・ニヴェディタの伝記的・政治的評論であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではないため該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事は1899年の歴史的出来事と人物の伝記・思想的評論であり、現代の公衆衛生イベントではないためトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Bayi Alena Meninggal Usai Diduga Diberi Telur Mentah, Ini Bahaya Salmonella bagi Bayi : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Baby Alena Dies After Allegedly Being Given Raw Eggs, This Is the Danger of Salmonella for Babies: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: A 28-day-old baby girl, Alena, died in Surabaya, East Java, after receiving intensive care at RSUD Dr. Soetomo on October 11, 2026. The infant had fever and was reportedly given raw eggs by a grandparent to reduce fever. Raw eggs can harbor Salmonella on the shell and inside, causing salmonellosis with diarrhea, fever, abdominal cramps, nausea, and vomiting. In newborns, Salmonella infection can lead to serious complications including dehydration. WHO guidance generally recommends exclusive breastfeeding for infants under six months and introducing complementary foods around six months; feeding raw eggs to a 28-day-old is not advised. Eggs should be cooked until both white and yolk are solid to reduce bacterial risk. Parents and caregivers are urged to avoid foods or traditional remedies as fever treatments for infants.

triage.headline_ja: 生卵を与えられたとみられる乳児アレナちゃん死亡、赤ちゃんにとってのサルモネラ菌の危険性
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個別家庭内事故による乳児死亡例であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や地域拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は家庭内での誤った育児習慣（発熱時に生卵を与える）による単一の乳児死亡事例を扱った健康啓発記事であり、腸チフス・パラチフスの集団発生やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。疾患タグ（Typhoid/Paratyphoid）は記事内容（サルモネラ食中毒）と直接一致しない可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Após as chuvas, lama e água contaminada aumentam risco de doenças; infectologista alerta para cuidados | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the rains, mud and contaminated water increase the risk of diseases; an infectious disease specialist warns about precautions | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Post-rain mud and contaminated water raise risks of leptospirosis, hepatitis A, and skin infections, with vector-borne dengue and chikungunya also a concern in Brazil. An infectious-disease specialist warns that exposure to floodwater and mud can lead to leptospirosis, caused by bacteria in the urine of animals (primarily rats); transmission occurs via contact with contaminated water or mud. Hepatitis A may present with jaundice; symptoms often appear weeks after exposure, so patients should report contact with rainwater, floodwater, or mud to clinicians. A recent case highlights chikungunya: professor Andreia Amaral was hospitalized, temporarily lost movement, and underwent about three months of treatment to regain walking. Protection during cleanup includes rubber boots and waterproof gloves; reduce exposure time and promptly remove mud. After rains, standing water also promotes Aedes aegypti breeding, raising dengue and chikungunya risk; eliminate standing water and seek care for suspected infections.

triage.headline_ja: 雨の後、泥と汚染水が病気のリスクを高める;感染症専門医が注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、異常な流行や新規事象の報告ではなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: 雨季に伴うレプトスピラ症・A型肝炎・デング熱・チクングニア熱への注意喚起記事で、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な増加を報告するものではない。個別症例（教授の入院例）も一般的な注意喚起の文脈で紹介されている。

article.articleHeadline: Über 9000 bestätigte Ebola-Fälle in Demokratischer Republik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 9,000 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 13, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak has 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, per the Congo Public Health Institute. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, declared in May, and has become the largest Ebola epidemic in DRC history, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain, with responders attempting to slow transmission. Globally, this outbreak is second only to West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,600 cases and 11,000 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone). The outbreak has spilled over to other countries: Kenya confirmed its first imported case last week, a Kenyan citizen who traveled from Congo via Uganda and died in Nairobi. Uganda had 20 cases and 2 deaths earlier in the year but was declared Ebola-free in August.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確認症例9000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が過去最大規模で拡大し死亡率も高く、ケニアへの国際的な波及も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダへの波及例が記載されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認されたワクチン・治療法がない点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS insiste en que es necesaria más evidencia sobre las vacunas contra el virus Bundibugyo causante del ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO insists that more evidence is needed on vaccines against the Bundibugyo virus that causes Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, WHO’s Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization (SAGE) says more evidence is needed to justify Bundibugyo-virus–targeted Ebola vaccines in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Although Ervebo shows immunogenicity data, randomized efficacy data are lacking. SAGE urged robust evidence via the Tumaini trial, to evaluate Bundibugyo and Ervebo candidates, with two early-phase trials under way: University of Oxford and Moderna. Oxford recruitment in Phase 1 is complete; Phase 2/3 expected by year-end, enabling adaptive inclusion of Bundibugyo vaccines if safety and immunogenicity permit. In parallel, SAGE reviewed HPV vaccination, recommending a single-dose schedule for 9–14-year-old girls and considering 4–8-year-olds to boost uptake (global HPV coverage ~33%, goal 90%). Also discussed: diphtheria outbreak campaigns, yellow fever fractional dosing (one-fifth) when supply is tight, mpox vaccine effectiveness, and a three-dose polio schedule (6, 10, 14 weeks) for countries with fewer than three doses.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ原因であるブンディブギョウイルスに対するワクチンについて、より多くのエビデンスが必要だと強調
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ(ブンディブギョウ型)ワクチンに関するWHO/SAGEの技術的議論が中心であり、新規の感染拡大や症例数など具体的なアウトブレイク状況の記載がないため、情報不足として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョウ種)流行に対するワクチン開発・臨床試験(Tumaini試験等)に関するSAGE会議の報告であり、現地の症例数や重症度など疫学的詳細は記載されていない。ワクチン候補の評価が議論の中心で、アウトブレイクの規模・深刻度は不明。

article.articleHeadline: 呼伦贝尔卫健委回应发布鼠疫提示_百度搜索
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hulunbuir Health Commission Responds to the Release of a Plague Advisory
article.articleSummary: Hulunbuir Health Commission responded in Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia to the release of a plague advisory. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis, a Gram-negative, bipolar-staining short bacillus. In nature, plague circulates mainly among wild rodents; humans become infected by flea bites carrying the bacterium or by inhaling aerosolized organisms. Clinical forms include bubonic plague (lymph node swelling), pneumonic plague (chest pain, cough, rapid breathing, dyspnea, with blood-tinged sputum), and septicemic plague (rapid deterioration with hypotension, altered consciousness, bleeding, purpura, necrosis). Less common types include intestinal, meningitic, ocular, and cutaneous plague. Highly infectious, transmission to humans occurs through close contact with pneumonic patients; inhalation can cause primary pneumonic plague. Streptomycin is the first-line treatment; duration generally 10–20 days, with regimens varying by disease form and source. Severe cases require intensive care and monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 呼倫貝爾市衛生健康委員会、ペスト注意喚起の発表についてコメント
triage.triage_reason: 内モンゴル自治区呼倫貝爾（ペスト常在地域）の衛生当局がペスト注意喚起への対応を発表したが、具体的な症例数や死亡者数など実際の発生状況に関する情報がなく、一般的な疾患解説にとどまるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 呼倫貝爾は野生齧歯類由来のペスト常在地域として知られ、季節的な注意喚起が定期的に発出される。本記事は衛生委員会の一般的な疾患説明・注意喚起への対応であり、実際の患者発生や感染拡大を示す具体的情報（症例数、死亡者数等）は記事サマリーに含まれていない。続報で実際の症例報告があるか確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заражения Эболой в ДР Конго превысило девять тысяч
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the DR Congo has exceeded nine thousand.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has reached 9,066 confirmed infections and 4,381 deaths, per the Congolese Institute of Public Health, as of 13 October 2026. Declared in May, it is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic, with no approved vaccines or therapies for this strain. Globally, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remains the record by far (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone). The outbreak has crossed borders: Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths and was declared Ebola-free in August; Kenya confirmed its first imported case last week, involving a Kenyan citizen who traveled from DRC via Uganda and died in Nairobi.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでのエボラ感染者数が9千人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大・最悪のエボラ流行であり、国境を越えてウガンダ・ケニアへの感染拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。承認されたワクチン・治療薬がない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Caritas setzt im Kampf gegen Ebola auf Priester und Ordensleute
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caritas relies on priests and members of religious orders in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with international attention waning amid war, displacement, malnutrition and unemployment. Caritas Austria warns of a potential further spread, citing weakened medical infrastructure, insufficient protective equipment, funding cuts, and scarce resources hindering relief. Africa project officer Zitania Badat says the key response is community education and prevention delivered through trusted church networks. Priests, nuns and other parish workers often have long-standing relationships with local populations and can reach remote areas, even when the government cannot. Caritas supports projects that train priests to carry Ebola-prevention messages, including transmission routes, symptoms and protective measures. In church health facilities, staff reinforce this with personal conversations and information materials to raise awareness and prompt protective actions.

triage.headline_ja: カリタス、エボラとの闘いで司祭や修道会員を頼りにする
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラの流行が継続しており、医療インフラの脆弱化や資金不足により拡大リスクが指摘され、外部支援の必要性が高いため。
triage.notes: 記事は国際的な関心の低下を指摘しつつ、資金不足と医療体制の脆弱化による流行拡大リスクを警告。地域検証によりオーストリアは除外、コンゴ民主共和国のみを対象地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: 39歲男子確診猴痘　情況穩定正接受隔離治療
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 39-year-old man diagnosed with Monkeypox; in stable condition and undergoing isolation treatment.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports a new Monkeypox case: a 39-year-old man who visited Hutong on Shanghai Street in Mong Kok during his incubation period and had sexual contacts there. He developed rashes around Oct 5, was seen at a private clinic, and admitted to Yan Chai Hospital for isolation; tests confirmed Monkeypox, and he was transferred to Queen Mary Hospital for isolation. Authorities inspected Hutong, provided health education to staff, and Hutong was temporarily closed; staff are asymptomatic. Individuals who visited Hutong since Sep 14, especially those with high-risk sexual contacts, are urged to call 2125 2373 for health assessment. Since August, 22 cases, representing 70% of 31 this year, all male with high-risk sex and most unvaccinated. Genetic analysis shows some identical sequences, suggesting a common source and multiple transmission chains among MSM. Vaccination uptake has risen by over 70% this month; high-risk individuals should vaccinate and provide partner contact details for tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 39歳男性が猴痘(エムポックス)と確診、容体は安定しており隔離治療中
triage.triage_reason: 香港で継続するMSM間のエムポックス感染クラスター（今年31例中22例）の新規症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続・ワクチン未接種者多数という流行しやすさの懸念があり、当局の接触者追跡・ワクチン接種呼びかけなど社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 本症例は8月以降香港で確認されている22例のMSM関連エムポックスクラスターの一部であり、単発の新規症例としては重篤度は低いが、継続する感染連鎖とワクチン未接種率の高さから流行継続のリスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : la fermeture de la RN4 envisagée en cas d'aggravation de l'épidémie d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Closure of RN4 considered in case of worsening Ebola outbreak - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Tshopo province, Democratic Republic of Congo, centered on Kisangani. Governor Paulin Lendongolia warns he could close National Road 4 (RN4) if the epidemic worsens, citing lax enforcement at checkpoints along the route. The RN4 is viewed as a key corridor for the spread due to population movement and illicit transport of corpses. He calls for strengthened screening at entry points, especially PK23 and Avakubi, and strict application of provincial decrees banning corpse movements and mass gatherings, with continued adherence to barrier measures. Thermal screening devices and disinfectants were distributed to field teams, and a provincial surveillance cell has been activated, alongside suspension of certain high-risk activities. The governor urged state services, community leaders, and residents to mobilize with response teams; closure of RN4 remains a preparatory, non-executable measure at this stage.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:エボラ流行悪化の場合に国道4号線(RN4)の閉鎖を検討 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCチョポ州でエボラ流行が継続・拡大の懸念があり、主要幹線道路の閉鎖検討という渡航制限措置にまで言及されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 死亡者数・感染者数など具体的な疫学データは記事に記載なし。州知事による予防的・準備的な対応措置の段階であり、実際の道路閉鎖は未実施。

article.articleHeadline: Amapá investiga 7 casos suspeitos de sarampo e intensifica vacinação diante do risco de surto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amapá investigates seven suspected measles cases and steps up vaccination amid the risk of an outbreak
article.articleSummary: Measles investigations in Amapá as Brazil records 52 confirmed cases this year prompt intensified vaccination. Seven suspected measles cases are under investigation in Amapá, a region near international borders, amid regional outbreaks in the Americas. Health authorities have intensified vaccination efforts by deploying extramural campaigns, delivering doses of the Measles-Mumps-Rubella (MMR) vaccine outside traditional posts to increase coverage. They are also verifying vaccination records in high-traffic areas and among vulnerable communities to reduce transmission risk. The measures come as the outbreak potential grows due to neighboring outbreaks in the United States, Mexico, Guatemala, and Peru, underscoring the threat of measles reintroduction. The principal defense remains vaccination with the MMR vaccine; officials stress checking individuals’ vaccination status to avert new cases and outbreaks in Amapá.

triage.headline_ja: アマパ州、麻疹の疑い症例7件を調査し、アウトブレイクのリスクを前にワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アマパ州で麻疹疑い症例7件の調査とワクチン接種強化が報告されているが、確定症例数や重症度などの詳細情報が不足しており、周辺国からの再流入リスクが懸念される段階。
triage.notes: 米国・メキシコ・グアテマラ・ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジル国内（アマパ州）の麻疹疑い例とワクチン接種強化が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : la transformation d'un centre Mpox en centre de traitement Ebola envisagée à Mutwanga - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: the transformation of an Mpox center into an Ebola treatment center envisaged in Mutwanga - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 13 October 2026, in Mutwanga health zone, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities considered converting a local Mpox care center in Kasindi into an Ebola treatment center (CTE) amid a resurgence of confirmed Ebola cases. Dr. Germain Kamaliro, chief physician, stated five Ebola cases were confirmed in Kasindi commune, out of 24 total in Mutwanga. There is currently no dedicated safe-burial response or adequate Ebola treatment capacity; teams are volunteering with the community to reduce local resistance. A suspect or confirmed case reportedly fled toward neighboring Uganda. The report also notes that the first Ebola case in Kenya originated in Beni and crossed the Kasindi border into Uganda, highlighting cross-border transmission and the need for strengthened border surveillance to intercept potential evacuees.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ムトワンガでMpoxセンターをエボラ治療センターへ転換することが検討される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラの再流行が確認され、国境を越えた感染拡大（ウガンダへの逃亡例、ケニアへの波及歴）とともに、治療体制・安全埋葬対応の不備が報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染の可能性が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。現地の治療能力・安全埋葬対応の不足が深刻なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: jaisalmer: मौसम बदला तो पोकरण अस्पताल में बढ़े मरीज, वायरल संक्रमण के मामले सर्वाधिक | Weather Change Brings More Patients To Pokaran Hospital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaisalmer: Weather changes bring more patients to Pokaran Hospital; viral infection cases are the highest.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, Pokaran, in Jaisalmer district, Rajasthan, reports a surge in seasonal viral illnesses at the Government District Hospital. Patients present with cold, cough, sore throat, and fever, with viral fever being the most common diagnosis. The daily patient load averages about 700, stressing OPD services and drug-distribution, with queues at registration and pharmacy counters. Diagnostic labs provide CBC and malaria results in 15–30 minutes, while liver and other tests take 1.5–2 hours, prolonging stays before treatment. People from surrounding villages and rural dhanis travel to the facility due to limited access to larger hospitals. Despite the higher demand, hospital staff say testing and medicines are adequately available and urge continued precautions amid changing weather.

triage.headline_ja: ジャイサルメール：気候の変化でポカラン病院の患者が増加、ウイルス性感染症の症例が最多
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のウイルス感染症（風邪・ウイルス性発熱）の増加に関する通常の地域医療報道であり、マラリアは診断項目の一つとして言及されているに過ぎず、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性ウイルス感染症（風邪様症状）による病院の患者増加を報じたもので、マラリアは検査項目の一つとして言及されているのみ。マラリア自体の流行や異常事態を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू के संभावित लक्षण दिखने पर सतर्क रहें:सीएमओ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stay alert for possible dengue symptoms: CMO
article.articleSummary: Lucknow, India—As of 13 October 2026, after floods the Gomti river water receded, but dengue cases are rising in hospitals. Most patients report fever with chills and low platelets. Laboratory confirmation identified 34 dengue patients across four major facilities, including Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences, King George's Medical University (KGMU), and Balrampur Hospital. Stagnant water in many areas fosters Aedes mosquito breeding; humidity facilitates propagation. Aedes mosquitoes typically bite during the day; breeding sites include rooftops, air coolers, flower pots, old tires, and containers with standing water. Preventive measures: eliminate standing water, change cooler water regularly, cover water tanks, clean planters, and ensure children wear full-sleeve clothing; use bed nets at night; regularly clean flood-related stagnation areas. Health officials advise vigilance for dengue symptoms—high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pain, nausea, and extreme fatigue—and to seek medical care promptly for testing and treatment to reduce severe complications; avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の可能性のある症状が見られたら注意:CMO
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のラクナウでデング熱症例が増加しているが、34例程度で国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は見られず、地域の季節的流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 洪水後の滞留水によるネッタイシマカの繁殖が増加の要因とされ、地元当局が予防策を呼びかけている季節性のデング熱事例。重症度や死亡者数の情報は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans le Haut-Uélé : les opérateurs économiques appelés à s'impliquer dans la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uélé: economic operators urged to get involved in the response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in Haut-Uélé, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Isiro reporting relatively few cases while the Wamba health zone records rising activity, including new cases in Bole-Bole, Mambati, Matete and Asese 10 and associated deaths. If confirmed-case trends continue upward, provincial authorities threaten temporary closures of artisanal mining sites to halt transmission. Governor Jean Bakomito urged economic operators, members of the Federation des Entreprises du Congo (FEC), and youths to act as prevention messengers in Pawa, Bomamangbetu, Bole-Bole and Wamba. The move aims to intensify community outreach and awareness, as the province vows to maintain vigilance amid security and health challenges. FEC provincial chair Colette Banambeaniso and director Sulumu Mwanateba were present, underscoring mobilization to eradicate Ebola in the province.

triage.headline_ja: オート・ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：経済事業者に対応への関与を要請 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国オート・ウエレ州でエボラ出血熱の症例・死亡が増加しており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア関連地名（Asese, Ogun State等）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事の主題はDRCオート・ウエレ州でのアウトブレイクであり対象外とした。鉱山サイトの一時閉鎖検討など経済活動への影響も示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Sudah 789 Anak di Sumut Keracunan MBG, Ombudsman Minta BGN Evaluasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 789 Children in North Sumatra Poisoned by MBG, Ombudsman Asks BGN to Evaluate.
article.articleSummary: Eight MBG (Makan Bergizi Gratis) poisoning incidents in North Sumatra during 2026 have sickened 789 students, up from 107 in 2025. The August outbreak (406 victims) and February (295) contributed most; April, September, and October reported 24, 47, and 17. Incidents span Kabupaten Karo, Pakpak Bharat, Mandailing Natal, Asahan, Deli Serdang, Humbang Hasundutan, Dairi, and Medan. Lab analyses show Bacillus cereus and Staphylococcus aureus in Dairi and Toba; E. coli detected in Pakpak Bharat and Mandailing Natal (melon and watermelon samples); in Medan, suspected spoiled milk prompted testing after school withdrawal. Ombudsman notes most SPPG kitchens hold SLHS (hygiene-sanitization certificates), implying trained staff should ensure food safety, yet lapses persist (e.g., sardines stored outside freezer in Karo; nasi and rendang possibly spoiled in Asahan). Calls on BGN to audit KPPG Sumut-Aceh and strengthen oversight.

triage.headline_ja: 北スマトラの子ども789人がMBG（無料栄養食プログラム）で食中毒、オムブズマンがBGNに評価を要求
triage.triage_reason: 学校給食プログラム(MBG)に起因する食中毒が2026年に789人規模へ急増し、複数県で発生。政府機関（オムブズマン・BGN）の監督強化要求があり社会的・行政的関心が高いため、フルRRAでの精査が妥当。
triage.notes: 本件は学校給食プログラム(MBG)における食品衛生管理不備に起因する複数の食中毒事例（Bacillus cereus、Staphylococcus aureus、E. coliなど複数病原体）であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念はない。発生地域に記載されたJapan（Mie-ken）、Pakistan（Khyber Pakhtunkhwa）は記事本文に言及がなく誤タグと判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines: Increasing dengue deaths in Negros Occidental
article.articleSummary: From January 1 to September 26, 2026, Negros Occidental, Philippines recorded 3,435 dengue cases with 18 deaths, a 42% drop from 4,878 cases in the same period of 2025. Dengue-related deaths increased by 64% year over year, from 11 to 18, with the rise beginning in July 2026. Affected cases span ages 0–94 (median 15), with 53% male. Deaths range 6–88 (median 24); 12 of the fatalities were female (two-thirds), leaving six male deaths. Nationally, as of October 3, 2026, the Philippines reported 186,005 total dengue cases, with nearly 73,000 confirmed, and 707 deaths. The data derive from the Department of Health, illustrating a shift in mortality despite broader case reductions compared with 2025.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン:ネグロス・オクシデンタル州でデング熱による死亡者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: 症例数は前年比で減少しているものの死亡者数が64%増加しており、致死率上昇という異常なパターンが見られるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年流行する風土病だが、症例数減少にもかかわらず死亡者数・致死率が増加している点が異常であり注視が必要。全国データでは707人死亡と公衆衛生上の影響は大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Ela toma 26 remédios por dia": a vida das crianças vítimas do zika vírus, dez anos depois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "She takes 26 medications a day": the lives of the children who were victims of the Zika virus, ten years later.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s 2015–2016 Zika outbreak triggered congenital Zika syndrome (SCZ) with microcephaly and serious neuro-motor impairments. Ten-year-old Jhulia, from Salvador, Bahia, is among about 1,500 children affected and now requires 26 medications daily, multiple surgeries (hips, bladder), a feeding tube, and a recent spinal decompression to ease breathing as respiratory crises persist. Her mother Flávia Oliveira highlights intense caregiving pressures. The surge began near Camaçari; in 2015 there were 51,806 probable Zika cases, rising to 213,350 in 2016, prompting Brazil’s Health Ministry to declare a national emergency in December 2015. Zika was identified by UFBA virologists Gúbio Soares and Silvia Sardi; the virus is transmitted by Aedes aegypti. A decade later, affected families confront ongoing care and social inequality, as public attention to the epidemic has waned.

triage.headline_ja: 「彼女は1日に26種類の薬を服用している」：ジカウイルスの被害に遭った子どもたちの10年後の生活
triage.triage_reason: 2015-2016年のブラジルにおけるジカウイルス流行の10年後を振り返る人間ドラマ記事であり、現在進行中の新規感染イベントではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は2015-2016年の過去の流行による後遺症を抱える子どもたちの現状を伝える回顧的な報道であり、新規の感染症発生イベントではない。社会的関心も『薄れている』と本文中で明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola já fez mais de 4.300 mortos na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic has already killed more than 4,300 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 4,381 deaths among 9,066 confirmed cases (case fatality 48.3%), with 2,389 recoveries and 895 currently hospitalized or in isolation. Contact tracing is 79.5%. The outbreak spans 64 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri (east), Tshopo (center-north), Bas-Uélé (north), Haut-Uélé (northeast), North Kivu (east), South Kivu (east), and Sud-Ubangi (northwest). The Bundibugyo strain drives the epidemic; no specific treatments exist, though the WHO is testing two vaccines in human trials, likely months away from deployment. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals, with symptoms including fever, hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. This is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak globally, behind the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic (≈28,000 cases, ≈11,000 deaths). Data reflect figures through 12 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行、死者4,300人超に
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱流行（死者4,381人、致死率48.3%）が7州64保健地区に拡大しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリー本文では言及がないため除外。史上2番目に死者数の多いエボラ流行であり、ワクチン展開にはまだ数ヶ月を要するとされる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola cases top 9,000
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has reached 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%) as of Oct 13, 2026, per the latest situation report. Declared May 15, the outbreak has spread across 65 health zones in seven provinces, with the eastern Ituri province remaining the epicenter, accounting for over 70% of cases. This outbreak is the largest and deadliest Ebola event in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. There is no vaccine or treatment specifically approved for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, though clinical trials are underway. The report provides no details on transmission sources or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱症例数が9,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の症例数9,066人、死亡4,381人（致死率48.3%）、7州65保健区に拡大しており、同国史上最大・世界史上2番目に大きい流行であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（特にイトゥリ州）の状況のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生については記載がないため除外した。ブンディブギョ株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点も流行対応上の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 9.000 casos confirmados por la epidemia de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 9,000 confirmed Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, with data through 12 October 2026. The Ministry reports 9,066 infections, 2,389 recoveries, 895 hospitalized or in isolation, and a 48.3% case fatality rate; contact tracing is 79.5%. In the last 24 hours, 33 patients were declared recovered. Eastern provinces Ituri and North Kivu are hardest hit, with 56 and 28 new cases respectively, across 65 health zones in seven provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, South Kivu and South Ubangi. The outbreak, second deadliest and most contagious globally, has limited treatments; vaccines in phase 1 trials show safety. Congo began Ervebo vaccination in late August; Uganda recorded 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths; Kenya, France and the Netherlands reported imported cases but no outbreaks. Transmission via bodily fluids causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の確定症例が9,000例を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%の大規模エボラ流行で9,000例超・死者4,381人に達し、複数国への越境事例も発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（20例、うち15例がDRCからの輸入）、ケニア・フランス・オランダで輸入症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない（ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダは対象外）か、アウトブレイクなしと記載されている。主題の発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا تتجاوز 9 آلاف حالة في الكونغو والوفيات تتخطى 4 آلاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases exceed 9,000 in the Congo, with deaths exceeding 4,000
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending with an Ebola virus disease outbreak that has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, according to Reuters citing the National Institute of Public Health. This is the largest and deadliest outbreak in the country’s history, eclipsing the 2018–2020 surge of about 3,300 cases. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccine or approved targeted therapy exists, underscoring the need for early detection and supportive care. Authorities, with WHO and partners, are expanding surveillance, contact tracing, laboratory testing, and health-facility support, while healthcare workers face humanitarian and security challenges and population displacement. A linked case occurred in Kenya—a traveler from the DRC via Uganda—who later died in Nairobi. WHO continues to bolster rapid case finding, isolation, and community education.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者、9千人を超え死者は4千人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（9000例超、死者4000人超）が発生し、国境を越えてケニアでも関連死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準にも合致するため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは関連する越境例として記事に登場するが、対象国リストにケニア・ウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Six more children die with measles-like symptoms in 24 hours
article.articleSummary: Six more children died with measles-like symptoms across the country in the past 24 hours, as 1,074 new suspected measles cases were reported. Between 8am Monday and 8am Tuesday, 139 confirmed measles cases were recorded, with no confirmed deaths in that interval. Since 15 March, the country’s total confirmed measles cases rose to 22,712, while suspected cases reached 207,371. Fatalities comprise 104 deaths among confirmed cases and 1,066 deaths among suspected cases, bringing the overall death toll to 1,170. A total of 176,672 patients have recovered. The data indicate sustained measles activity nationwide, with a high burden of both confirmed and suspected cases and ongoing mortality.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹様症状により24時間でさらに6人の子供が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 疑い症例20万件超、死者1,170人という大規模な麻疹流行が継続しており、重篤度・持続性ともに高い。ただしBluedotが付与した発生国（DRC）は記事内容と整合せず、実際の発生国は特定できない。
triage.notes: ソースURL（daily-sun.com）はバングラデシュの報道機関であり、記事サマリーにも具体的な国名の記載がないため、Bluedotが付与したDRCという発生地域情報は誤りである可能性が高い。対象国リストに実際の発生国が含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。続報で発生国を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Lucknow News: डेंगू ने पकड़ी रफ्तार, 10 महीने में 434 मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lucknow News: Dengue Gains Momentum, 434 Patients in 10 Months.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is gaining momentum in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, with 434 laboratory-confirmed cases from January through October 2026; September records the highest monthly toll (193 cases), and October up to October 13 reports 130 cases. On October 13, two new confirmations were reported in the city (Alambagh, Chand Nagar and Indira Nagar). Hospitals including Balrampur, Civil, Lokbandhu Raj Narayan, and Rani Lakshmi Bai are admitting dengue patients in mosquito-net wards to curb transmission. In the Faizullaganj flood-affected area, 27 rapid-response teams (four members each) distribute chlorine tablets, ORS packets, and essential medicines; anti-larva spraying is underway in sensitive zones to reduce Aedes mosquitoes. Citizens are advised to remove standing water from homes, coolers, pots, tires, and other containers. Government facilities provide free dengue testing and medicines during treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウ便り：デング熱が勢いを増す、10か月で434人の患者
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州ラクナウで季節性デング熱の症例数が増加しているが、重症度・死亡者数などの情報が不足しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められないため、経過観察が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局は病院での蚊帳病棟設置、塩素錠・ORS配布、幼虫駆除スプレーなど通常の季節的対応を実施中。重症度や死亡者数の記載がなく、インド国内の季節性デング熱流行の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Inside Wuhan: How the city at the heart of a global pandemic is fighting back
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-13, the 2026 Wuhan Open tennis tournament is underway in Wuhan, a city that became notorious as the origin point of Covid-19 and is in the process of rebuilding six years after the pandemic's start. The piece notes uncertainty about how Covid-19 began in Wuhan, with many suspect a deadly leak and the Institute of Virology named as a possible starting point. Residents remember lockdowns and a heavy government control over information, with social media restricted and VPNs used to access external services. With about 11 million inhabitants, Wuhan shows rapid modernization: electric cars, vast towers, and signs in English, including in Han Street, the presence of Western brands, and a growing economy. The article mentions the East Lake area as a leisure lure, and notes a nightlife void after sunset.

triage.headline_ja: 武漢の内側：世界的パンデミックの中心地となった都市が、今どのように復興しているか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はテニス大会を切り口にした武漢の復興・観光レポートであり、COVID-19の新規発生や再燃を報じるものではないため、公衆衛生上の新規シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年のパンデミック後の武漢の都市再生・観光・テニス大会を扱ったヒューマンインタレスト記事であり、新規感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola infections surpass 9,000, government report shows
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 9,066 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths as of 13 October 2026. The outbreak, linked to the Bundibugyo strain, was declared in May and is the largest and deadliest in Congo's history, surpassing the 2018-2020 epidemic. There are currently no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain. Globally, it ranks second only to the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak, which infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone, per WHO. The outbreak has spilled over to neighboring countries—Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths earlier this year and was declared Ebola-free in August; Kenya confirmed its first imported case last week, a Kenyan national who traveled from Congo via Uganda and died in Nairobi. A proposed quarantine unit has angered residents who accuse the US of shifting the burden of care to Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が9,000人を超えたと政府報告が示す
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は同国史上最大・最悪規模で9,000例超、死者4,381人に達し、既にウガンダ・ケニアへ国際的に拡大しており、承認されたワクチン・治療法もないため重大な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアも記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ケニアでの輸入症例と検疫施設を巡る住民の反発は社会的関心の高さを示す追加情報。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات الإصابة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو إلى 9066 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola virus infection cases in Congo to 9,066
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 9,066 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 4,381 deaths, as of today, with the outbreak declared in May and ongoing across multiple hotspots. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, and there are no vaccines or therapeutics approved for this lineage. This is described as the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic. Globally, the current Congo outbreak ranks second to the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak that affected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, per WHO. Uganda earlier reported 20 cases and two deaths but was declared Ebola-free in August. Kenya confirmed last week its first imported case: a Kenyan child who traveled from the Congo via Uganda and died in Nairobi.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラウイルス感染症例が9,066例に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中であり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認の株で、ケニアへの越境症例も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニアで輸入症例1例（死亡）が報告されたが、発生の主体はDRC。ウガンダは8月にエボラ終息宣言済みのため除外。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Broj slučajeva ebole u DR Kongo premašio 9.000, preminula gotovo polovina obolelih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in DR Congo has surpassed 9,000, with nearly half of those infected having died.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has reached 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, according to health authorities. The Bundibugyo-linked outbreak, declared in May, is the largest and deadliest in DR Congo's history, surpassing the 2018-2020 outbreak. There are no approved vaccines or therapies for Bundibugyo. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals; early symptoms resemble flu, including fever, headache, fatigue, muscle pain, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding. The World Health Organization notes the DR Congo outbreak is the second-largest globally, after West Africa's 2014-2016 epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). Ebola has also been detected in neighboring Uganda (20 cases and two deaths earlier; later declared Ebola-free in August) and in Kenya, where the first imported case traveled from DR Congo via Uganda and died in Nairobi.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ感染者数が9000人を超え、感染者のほぼ半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで史上最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが発生し、致死率約48%、承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、ウガンダ・ケニアへの国際的拡大も確認されているため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRコンゴでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダ・ケニア・シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは比較対象または輸入例として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ナイロビ（ケニア）は輸入症例の死亡地として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi records 799 dengue, 294 malaria cases so far this year
article.articleSummary: Delhi has recorded 799 dengue and 294 malaria cases in 2026, with the mosquito-borne season ongoing, according to an MCD report up to Oct 10 (released Oct 13, 2026). For October’s first week, 98 dengue and 23 malaria were reported; the second week added 104 dengue and 28 malaria, totaling 202 dengue and 51 malaria through Oct 10. Three chikungunya cases occurred in the week, with the year total at 32 (vs 91 in 2025 and 69 in 2024). Mosquito-control efforts include over 29 lakh inspections and nearly 3.5 lakh house sprays. Inspections found about 1.98 lakh breeding-positive houses; 1.37 lakh legal notices were issued. Prosecutions reached 23,829 with 15,656 penalties. No dengue or malaria deaths have occurred so far this year.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで今年のデング799件、マラリア294件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 例年の蚊媒介感染症シーズン報告であり、死亡者もなく前年・前々年より症例数が少ない。異常性や社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: デリー市当局（MCD）による定例的な季節統計報告。死亡例なし、チクングニアは前年より減少傾向。モニタリングは継続中だが緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）本轮埃博拉疫情确诊病例超9000例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo's current Ebola outbreak has more than 9,000 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak has reached 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, with 2,389 recoveries and a case fatality rate of about 48.3%, as of Oct 11–13, 2026, across seven provinces. There are no approved vaccines or specific therapies for Bundibugyo ebolavirus yet. A late-stage clinical trial named 'Hope' (Phase II/III) to assess multiple candidate vaccines is entering final preparations and could begin in the coming weeks after ethics and regulatory approvals. The study, led by the National Institute of Biomedical Research (DRC) and the University of Antwerp, targets high-risk contacts of confirmed cases. Ervebo, an approved vaccine for Zaire ebolavirus, is expected to be the first candidate in the trial. The outbreak began May 15, 2026, and the WHO has described it as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、今回のエボラ出血熱流行で確定症例が9,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48.3%、9,000人超の確定症例、4,000人超の死者を伴う大規模なエボラ流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: ベルギー（アントワープ）は臨床試験実施機関として言及されているが、発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。WHOにより史上2番目に大規模なエボラ流行と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo supera los nueve mil casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses nine thousand Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 9,066 confirmed Ebola infections and 4,381 deaths (case fatality 48.3%) as of Oct 12, 2026, the second deadliest and most widespread Ebola outbreak in global history. Recoveries reach 2,389; 895 are hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing is 79.5%. The outbreak covers 65 health zones across seven provinces, led by Ituri (56 new cases) and North Kivu (28) in the last 24 hours; affected provinces include Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; two vaccines are in Phase 1 trials with safety shown, but development could take months. Uganda has reported 20 cases (2 deaths; 15 imported from DRC); Kenya, France and the Netherlands have imported cases but no new outbreaks. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic manifestations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の確認症例が9000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%、9000人超の確認症例、7州65保健区に拡大し、ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダへの越境輸入例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダへの輸入症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。特定の治療法がなく、ワクチンはPhase1段階であり、過去最大級のエボラ流行として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Roundup: DR Congo's Ebola cases top 9,000 as vaccine trial nears launch
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths as of Oct 11, with 2,389 recoveries (case fatality rate 48.3%). Bundibugyo ebolavirus is responsible; 65 health zones across seven provinces are affected, Ituri epicenter with 73.8% of cases and North Kivu reporting the highest fatality rate at 57.1%. WHO notes slowing in some areas but ongoing transmission elsewhere, and persistent gaps in contact tracing and community deaths. No vaccine or treatment is specifically approved for Bundibugyo; Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) is administered to frontline workers under research or compassionate use, with 399 vaccinated in Haut-Uele as of Oct 11. The Tumaini Phase 2/3 trial to evaluate vaccines against Bundibugyo is nearing launch, likely starting with Ervebo before strain-specific candidates, pending ethics/regulatory approval. Declared May 15, this is the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC and second-largest worldwide after 2014–2016.

triage.headline_ja: まとめ:DRコンゴのエボラ症例が9,000人を超える中、ワクチン試験が開始間近に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,000人超の症例と致死率48.3%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、複数州にまたがり国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）であり、承認ワクチンがない中でTumaini Phase 2/3試験が開始準備中。WHOは一部地域での鈍化を指摘するも接触者追跡と地域内死亡の把握に課題が残る。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）本轮埃博拉疫情确诊病例超9000例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo's current Ebola outbreak has more than 9,000 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, centered on Bunia, has 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths as of Oct 13, 2026, with about 2,389 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 48.3%. Seven provinces are affected. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for this strain yet. A vaccine trial named 'Hope' (Phase II/III), led by the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB) and the University of Antwerp, is entering final preparation to start within weeks, evaluating safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy among high-risk contacts. Ervebo vaccine for Zaire ebolavirus is expected to be the first candidate in the trial. The outbreak began May 15; WHO in August described it as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の今回のエボラ出血熱流行、確定症例が9000例を超える
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例9,066例・死亡4,381例（致死率48.3%）、WHOが史上2番目の規模と表明した大規模流行であり、承認ワクチンがないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による国際的懸念の高い事案のため。
triage.notes: ベルギー（アントワープ大学）は国際共同のワクチン治験（Hope試験）の実施主体として記事に登場するのみで、流行発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: US issues new order barring travellers from 3 countries for 30 days over Ebola
article.articleSummary: US extends Ebola travel notice for the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan for 30 days, effective Oct 11, 2026, citing ongoing cross-border transmission risk from the DRC. Uganda, declaring Ebola-free as of Oct 6, maintains strong surveillance, but the CDC warns continued overland travel from the DRC poses cross-border risk, especially among healthcare workers and in western Ugandan entry districts. Kenya is excluded from the extension despite reporting its first Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) case and death in a patient who traveled from DRC to Uganda and then to Nairobi, hospitalized and dying on Oct 5, 2026. In the DRC, the Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak persists with contact tracing at 80% as of Oct 5, down from 87% in Sept and well below the 95% threshold for control. WHO and African leaders reject the travel restriction, arguing it has no scientific backing under International Health Regulations.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱を理由に3か国からの渡航者を30日間禁止する新たな命令を発令
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病アウトブレイクが継続し、コンタクトトレーシングが制御閾値を下回る中、国境を越えた感染（ケニアでの初症例・死亡）が確認され、米国が渡航制限を発令するなど国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCにおけるブンディブギョ型エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダ・ケニア・米国・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHO・アフリカ指導者は米国の渡航制限がIHRの科学的根拠を欠くと反対しており、政治的緊張も含む事案。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 4.300 mortos e nove mil casos de ébola na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,300 deaths and nine thousand Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 9,066 confirmed infections and 4,381 deaths, with a 48.3% case fatality rate, as reported for October 12. Recovered: 2,389; 895 currently hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing: 79.5%. The Bundibugyo strain drives this outbreak, spanning 64 health zones in seven of the DRC’s 26 provinces: Ituri (east), Tshopo (central-north), Bas-Uélé (north), Haut-Uélé (northeast), North Kivu (east), South Kivu (east), and Ubangi-Sud (northwest). It ranks as the second deadliest Ebola outbreak globally; the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic caused about 28,000 cases and ~11,000 deaths. There is no specific treatment; two vaccines are in human trials and have shown safety, though development may take months. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, hemorrhagic symptoms, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱、死者4,300人超・感染者9千人に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%、9,066例・4,381死亡という大規模アウトブレイクで、史上2番目に致死的なエボラ流行となっており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確に該当する。
triage.notes: 7州64保健区に拡大しており、ワクチン開発中も特異的治療法はなく、感染拡大継続中。既知の大規模アウトブレイクであり、継続モニタリングとフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Le nombre de cas d'Ebola en RDC dépasse les 9.000, selon des données
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the DRC exceeds 9,000, according to data.
article.articleSummary: By 13 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases, with 4,381 deaths reported by the Public Health Institute, marking the largest outbreak in the country and the second-deadliest globally. The institute's latest situational report tallies 9,066 cases, making it the second-worst Ebola epidemic on record after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak that infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is neither a vaccine nor an approved treatment. Related spread includes Uganda reporting 20 cases and 2 deaths earlier in the year, and Kenya confirming its first Ebola case after a Nairobi resident who had traveled in DRC died.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ感染者数が9,000人を超える、データによると
triage.triage_reason: DRCの史上最大規模のエボラ流行で9,000例・4,381人死亡、ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による拡大で、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境事例も確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダへの越境感染事例が報じられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行であり、致死率・規模ともに歴史的な大規模アウトブレイクである点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Comienzan en Brasil los ensayos en humanos de prometedora vacuna contra la malaria - El Pais Vallenato
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human trials of a promising malaria vaccine begin in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian health authorities authorized the first human trials of a malaria vaccine designed against Plasmodium vivax. Vivaxin, developed by the Vaccine Technology Center at the Federal University of Minas Gerais, will undergo Phase I–III trials with about $2.4 million funding. Phase I includes 48 malaria-naive volunteers aged 18–59, followed for 360 days to assess safety and immunogenicity. Anvisa approval marks progress; Health Minister Alexandre Padilha highlights Brazil’s capacity to develop domestic solutions. In 2025, Brazil reported 118,037 malaria cases. Existing vaccines target Plasmodium falciparum, predominant in Africa, while P. vivax is more common in the Americas and much of Asia. Phase details and clinical development milestones are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでマラリアワクチンの有望な候補のヒト試験開始
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン開発の進展に関する科学・医療ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリアワクチン（Vivaxin）の臨床試験開始に関する報道であり、感染症アウトブレイクの発生を報告するものではない。ブラジルの2025年マラリア症例数（118,037件）は背景情報として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri Wiyagus Ajak Posyandu hingga Media Terlibat dalam Eliminasi TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Wiyagus Invites Posyandu and the Media to Participate in TB Elimination.
article.articleSummary: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Akhmad Wiyagus called for cross-sector collaboration to accelerate tuberculosis (TB) elimination, inviting Posyandu, PKK, community leaders, academics, and media to join the effort at the Deklarasi Desa Siaga Tuberkulosis in Jepara, Central Java, on 13 October 2026. He argued TB is curable and stigma must be reduced through expanded outreach, data collection, and case finding across communities. He outlined a multi-level governance framework: provincial governments set policy; regents and mayors integrate TB programs into the APBD; districts coordinate operations; and villages/kelurahan lead data gathering and detection. He urged that health programs included in planning and budgets be implemented rather than remain on paper. Special thanks were given to TB cadres, with particular praise for women volunteers. Attendees included Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus, Central Java Secretary Sumarno, Jepara Regent Witiarso Utomo, and health cadres from across Java.

triage.headline_ja: 内務副大臣ウィヤグス、結核撲滅にポシャンドゥやメディアの参加を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性疾患である結核対策に関する政策・啓発活動の報道であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核撲滅のための行政・地域協力の呼びかけであり、感染急増や異常事象の報告ではない。政府の関心は高いが、通常の政策活動の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: "Moartea Neagră" pune în alertă OMS. Suspiciune de ciumă pneumonică după decesul misterios al unui cercetător din Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "The Black Death" puts the WHO on alert. Suspected pneumonic plague after the mysterious death of a researcher from Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis, the agent of plague, remains active in nature via fleas on over 200 rodent species, causing thousands of infections annually. The death of a 28-year-old researcher at the Institute of Anti-Plague Research in Irkutsk, Siberia, prompted a WHO biosecurity alert over a possible lab escape. Epidemiological work led to the isolation of over 200 contacts and 5,000 tests; Russia later reported that pneumonic plague was not detected, attributing the death to severe viral pneumonia, though transparency concerns persist. From 2019–2025, 3,860 suspected cases were reported in 10 countries, with 423 confirmed deaths. About 98% of cases are in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar; the United States averages seven cases per year. Plague occurs in three forms—bubonic (most common), septicemic, and pneumonic; the last is a contagious lung infection transmitted by air, and without antibiotics, septicemic and pneumonic forms have near 100% mortality, though early antibiotic treatment is effective.

triage.headline_ja: 「黒死病」がWHOを警戒させる。シベリアの研究者の謎の死後、肺ペストの疑い
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアでの研究者死亡を巡る肺ペスト疑惑だが、ロシア当局は検査の結果ペストを否定し重症ウイルス性肺炎と発表。発生地（ロシア）は対象国リストに含まれず、DRCは過去統計の引用に過ぎずイベントの発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツクでの単一症例疑惑であり、ロシア当局により肺ペストは否定された。DRCやマダガスカルは過去の統計的背景情報として言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生国ではないため対象国には含めない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 9.000 casos confirmados por la epidemia de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC surpasses the 9,000 confirmed cases threshold in the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases, with 4,381 deaths reported as of October 12, 2026. The health ministry records 9,066 infections, a 48.3% case-fatality rate, 2,389 recoveries, and 895 patients hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing stands at 79.5%. Ituri and North Kivu are the hardest hit, with 56 and 28 new cases in the last 24 hours. In total, the epidemic affects 65 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, and Ubangi South. The Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; the WHO is testing two vaccines in Phase 1 trials, with safety demonstrated but development may take months. Uganda reported cases tied to the outbreak (20 cases, 2 deaths; 15 imported from DRC); Kenya, France, and the Netherlands have imported cases but no new outbreaks. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhage.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行で確定症例9,000件の壁を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%、9,000例超の大規模流行で複数国への越境拡大(ウガンダ、ケニア、フランス、オランダに輸入症例)が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダへの輸入症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主たる発生国として唯一該当。

article.articleHeadline: 鼠疫袭俄罗斯恐怖直接翻倍？世卫紧急改口，五国边境升级藏三根刺
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague Strikes Russia, Fear Doubles Instantly? WHO Urgently Reverses Its Position, Five Countries Tighten Borders, Three Hidden Needles.
article.articleSummary: Plague scare in Russia after a 28-year-old female researcher in Irkutsk region died Oct 2 from severe pneumonia. On Oct 6, Russia reported over 5,000 samples negative for Yersinia pestis and ruled out a lab accident; Oct 8 measures were lifted, but a Buryatia regional official later referenced plague, triggering hospital lockdowns, residential disinfection, and isolation of the research institute with ~200 contacts under observation. Neighboring nations tightened controls: Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Uzbekistan strengthened entry checks; Tajikistan boosted border surveillance; Mongolia began health screening. article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진자 9천명 넘어...보름 만에 1천명 증가
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 9,000, rising by 1,000 in just over two weeks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases, with 9,066 cases and 4,381 deaths (case fatality 48.3%) as of Oct 13, 2026, per INSP. The outbreak began May 15 in northeast Ituri Province and has spread to seven provinces, including Sud-Ubangi in the northwest. It is DR Congo’s largest outbreak to date (exceeding 2018–2020 numbers of 3,481 cases and 2,299 deaths) and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths). In neighboring Kenya, a first Ebola case and death were reported on Oct 6, linked to a Congolese resident who lived in DRC for seven years, crossed into Uganda by land, then flew to Kenya on Oct 3; he developed bleeding symptoms and died Oct 5 in Nairobi. Kenya has quarantined 108 of 122 contacts; 293 specimens tested. In Uganda, 20 cases (including 15 from DRC) and 2 deaths; no new cases since July; WHO declared Uganda’s outbreak over in August.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ確定症例が9,000人を超える...2週間余りで1,000人増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中で致死率48.3%、隣国ケニア・ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける過去最大のエボラ流行を主題とし、ケニア・ウガンダへの越境事例にも言及しているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: جهود السلام في منطقة البحيرات الكبرى تحرز تقدما، لكن العنف ومرض الإيبولا يفاقمان المعاناة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peace efforts in the Great Lakes region make progress, but violence and Ebola disease exacerbate suffering.
article.articleSummary: East of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains unstable despite diplomatic progress toward implementing the Framework for Peace, Security and Cooperation in the region. UN Envoy Huang Xia told the Security Council that momentum exists on the Washington and Doha tracks and renewed African Union mediation. DRC authorities and the Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Rwanda (FDLR) signed a disarmament, demobilization and reintegration protocol, followed by an implementing plan, a roadmap, and a monitoring mechanism. Civilian suffering worsens as fighting continues in several areas, with increasing use of armed drones in populated zones. The Ebola outbreak persists in the region, and regional tensions linger between DRC and Rwanda, alongside mistrust between Burundi and Rwanda. Four urgent priorities: strengthen the AU’s strategic role; broaden peace efforts; sustain de-escalation and confidence-building; address economic and structural drivers, notably illicit resource exploitation. Parties are urged to act promptly; the window is time-bound.

triage.headline_ja: グレートレイクス地域の和平努力は進展しているが、暴力とエボラ出血熱が苦しみを悪化させている

triage.notes: 記事は主にグレートレイクス地域の和平プロセスに関する国連報告であり、エボラの具体的な症例数や発生地点などの詳細情報は記載されていない。ルワンダ・ブルンジは政治的緊張の文脈で言及されているのみで、感染拡大の直接的証拠はないため対象国から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : la riposte contre Ebola au centre d'une réunion interinstitutionnelle à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: the Ebola response at the center of an interinstitutional meeting in Beni - ACP.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo – On 13 October 2026 in Beni, an interinstitutional meeting between the North Kivu Provincial Assembly and the provincial executive centered on security and the Ebola virus disease outbreak. Discussions, quoted by vice-president Pelo Kyakwa, addressed the security situation and an Ebola-dominated epidemiological crisis. Officials highlighted a lull in Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) activity and praised the military command for progress, noting improvements in Beni city and Lubero territory. On the health front, the military governor urged deputies to actively participate in Ebola response, to raise public awareness, and to ensure adherence to hygiene and prevention measures. Despite security gains, transmission persists due to community resistance, especially among youths and continued non-compliance with barrier measures. The meeting, chaired by General-major Évariste Somo Kakule, reviewed ongoing military operations and the epidemiological situation.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニでのエボラ対応が省庁間会議の中心議題に - ACP

article.articleHeadline: Arcos utiliza drones para identificar possíveis criadouros do mosquito da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arcos uses drones to identify possible breeding sites of the dengue mosquito.
article.articleSummary: Arcos, Brazil, through its Endemias department, is deploying drones to map areas and identify potential breeding sites of Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The initiative aims to broaden surveillance and preventive actions across the municipality. Drone imagery enables access-restricted areas to pinpoint hotspots requiring attention, guiding vector-control operations and tailored prevention measures. The city urges community involvement: remove stagnant water from containers, maintain clean yards, and regularly inspect properties to prevent new breeding sites. Combining environmental monitoring with public participation is presented as essential to reducing transmission risk of arboviruses.

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé : la reprise des cours timide dans plusieurs établissements scolaires en raison d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haut-Uélé: Cautious Resumption of Classes in Several Schools Due to Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to affect Haut-Uélé in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, disrupting schooling in Isiro and surrounding areas. For the 2026-2027 academic year, several schools have not resumed, including those in Asese 10, and the Institute supérieur des techniques médicales (ISTM) in Wamba remains without classes. Dr. Fines Mola, interim head of the provincial health division, attributes the outbreak to community-level disruption and notes a rise in the number of orphans in several families. During a planning meeting on the Ebola response, authorities called for reinforced handwashing kits in schools and churches as part of ongoing prevention efforts. This ACP report, dated 13 October 2026, highlights the ongoing public health challenge in Haut-Uélé and the broader social impact on education and welfare.

article.articleHeadline: Tubercolosi, prevenire conviene fino a 54 volte. Perché continuiamo a spendere soprattutto quando la malattia arriva?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis, prevention pays off up to 54 times. Why do we continue to spend, especially when the disease arrives?
article.articleSummary: On 12 October 2026, WHO published the second edition of Funding a tuberculosis-free future, an economic analysis of investments to detect tuberculosis early and prevent disease in high-risk individuals. The study estimates a maximum return of up to $54 for every $1 invested, based on scenarios in Brazil, Georgia, Kenya, and South Africa, though this figure cannot be directly transferred to Italy due to different epidemiology, costs, and health-system organization. TB can persist as latent infection without symptoms, risking progression to active disease, so prevention targets those most exposed and may include preventive treatment alongside screening. Benefits include fewer cases, deaths, healthcare costs, and productivity losses. Italy remains low-incidence (3,150 cases in 2024; 5.3 per 100,000; ~70% pulmonary), so targeted rather than indiscriminate screening is emphasized—focusing on contacts of contagious patients, immunocompromised individuals, and groups from high-incidence contexts. The article underscores measuring the cost of disease avoided and building health accounting that values what does not happen.

The City Hall urged residents to remove standing water and other potential breeding sites to support vector control, emphasizing the importance of community participation alongside ongoing public health efforts.

article.articleHeadline: DR CONGO-BUNIA-EBOLA OUTBREAK-CONFIRMED CASES
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in Bunia, capital of Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, associated with Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of Oct 13, 2026, the DRC has recorded more than 9,000 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The latest situation report released Oct 13 indicates continued transmission and a rising toll. A health worker in protective gear is shown at an Ebola treatment center in Bunia on Oct 12, 2026, illustrating ongoing response efforts. There is currently no vaccine or treatment specifically approved for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, though clinical trials are underway to evaluate countermeasures. The report underscores a persistent, severe outbreak in Ituri Province with treatment centers and infection-control measures in place.

article.articleHeadline: 内蒙古呼伦贝尔发布鼠疫提示后删除，当地卫健委回应-上游新闻 汇聚向上的力量
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia, issued a plague advisory and then deleted it; local health commission responds — Upstream News: Gathering Strength.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-13, Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia, issued a plague risk advisory that was later deleted; the local Center for Disease Control and Prevention stated there is no plague outbreak and the notice was routine public science information to raise awareness. The deletion aimed to avoid misunderstanding. Separately, a Russian case involved a female worker at the Irkutsk Siberian and Far East Anti-Plague Research Institute who died on Oct 2 of a pneumonia with unknown etiology. The WHO, in an Oct 10 briefing, said no evidence of sustained transmission linked to the event and the pathogen has not yet been identified. In Inner Mongolia, plague-prevention notices are routinely issued before outdoor work peaks, tourism, and World Health Day; examples include Ulanqab and Arongqi Banner. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis, transmitted by rodents and fleas; a Class A disease in China, now preventable and treatable with isolation and early antibiotics.

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: The United Kingdom continues to support the humanitarian response in the DRC, including through our assistance to the Ebola response: UK statement at the UN Security Council
article.articleSummary: UK states at the UN Security Council that despite diplomatic progress, civilians in eastern DRC face insecurity. More than 26 million are in acute food insecurity, with 3.6 million at emergency levels, as conflict, displacement, Ebola and climate shocks worsen humanitarian needs. The UK continues to support the humanitarian response and the Ebola effort, and calls for safe, rapid, unhindered aid access. Welcomes progress through Doha, Washington, AU mediation, with EJVM+ deployments by MONUSCO; peace must deliver visible improvements on the ground. Parties should cease hostilities, implement commitments, and cooperate with peace processes; MONUSCO must have freedom of movement and all parties must respect international humanitarian law. The rise of drones and heavy weapons in populated areas increases civilian risk. Illicit mineral exploitation finances armed groups; stronger regional certification and traceability are needed to ensure minerals reach local communities. Diplomacy should translate into safer civilians, accessible aid, and lasting peace.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、DRCにおける人道対応を継続支援——エボラ対応への支援を含む：国連安全保障理事会における英国声明

article.articleHeadline: Antisipasi Ancaman Penyakit Pes, RI Perlu Perkuat Pemantauan Tikus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anticipating the Plague Threat, Indonesia Needs to Strengthen Rodent Surveillance
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s Health Ministry is boosting surveillance at entry points in response to a suspected plague case tied to Irkutsk, Siberia, Russia, where a lab worker’s death is being investigated for possible Yersinia pestis exposure; Russian officials cite pneumonia as the cause. Indonesian experts urge caution and careful interpretation until verification, noting Y. pestis persists in wild rodents and poses ongoing risk. Plague transmits via fleas from rats, direct contact with fluids or tissues of infected animals, or droplets; pneumonic plague is a severe form that can spread between humans through droplets. Authorities stress sustained rodent surveillance and population control, and a health-system readiness with prompt antibiotic treatment. Dicky Budiman warns of hantavirus risk from rats as well. Indonesia has had no human plague cases for decades, but vigilance remains essential.
