article.articleHeadline: RDC : plus de 9 000 cas d'Ebola enregistrés, dont 4 381 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: More than 9,000 Ebola cases recorded, including 4,381 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 9,066 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%). Declared in May, the outbreak spans seven provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, and South Ubangi. It is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Africa CDC urges strengthened regional preparedness and response to prevent cross-border spread. Kenya reported its first imported Ebola case last week—a Kenyan national who traveled through the DRC and Uganda before dying in Kenya—highlighting regional transmission risk. Data come from the DRC Ministry of Health situation report.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ出血熱の症例が9,000例を超え、死者4,381人を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（9,066症例、致死率48.3%）が7州に拡大し、ケニアへの越境感染例も確認されており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは越境感染の文脈で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内の流行が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola supera los 9.000 casos en República Democrática del Congo: ya deja más de 4.300 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 9,000 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: it has already claimed more than 4,300 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths (case fatality 48.3%) as of Oct 12. Recoveries reach 2,389, while 895 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing covers 79.5% of contacts. The eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu are the most affected, reporting 56 and 28 new cases in the last 24 hours, respectively. The outbreak spans 65 health zones across seven of the 26 provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. This is the second deadliest and most transmissible Ebola outbreak globally, driven by the Bundibugyo strain for which no specific treatment exists. The World Health Organization is evaluating two vaccine candidates in Phase 1 trials, with safety established but development expected to take months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で9,000例を突破:死者はすでに4,300人以上
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが7州65保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 致死率48.3%、9,000例超、4,300人超死亡、7州65保健地区に拡大中。ブンディブギョ株で特異的治療薬なし。WHOがワクチン候補の第1相試験を実施中だが開発には数ヶ月要する見込み。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola en el Congo superó los 9.000 casos y dejó más de 4.300 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo surpassed 9,000 cases and left more than 4,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths since its May 15 declaration. The latest ministry report, through October 12, records 9,066 infections and a 48.3% case fatality rate, with 2,389 recoveries and 895 currently hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing stands at 79.5%. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, centers in Ituri and North Kivu, with 56 and 28 new infections in the last 24 hours, and has spread to 65 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Upper Uele, South Kivu and Ubangi-Sud. It exceeds the 2018–2020 Congo outbreak but is below the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. There are no approved treatments; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes hemorrhage, with transmission via blood and bodily fluids. The WHO is testing two Bundibugyo vaccines in Phase 1 trials; efficacy and availability remain uncertain. Uganda reports 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths; Kenya, France, and the Netherlands each report one imported case linked to the outbreak; surveillance and response continue.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、症例数9,000人超・死者4,300人超に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）大規模流行が9,000例超・致死率48.3%に達し、複数州に拡大、ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダへの国際拡散も確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダへの輸入症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Eusébio inova na saúde e adota tecnologia com Wolbachia para reforçar combate à dengue, zika e chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eusébio innovates in health and adopts Wolbachia-based technology to bolster the fight against dengue, Zika and Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: On October 13, 2026, Eusébio, Ceará, Brazil, announced a Wolbachia-based strategy to reduce transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya by Aedes aegypti. The municipal government will install 230 oviposition-release devices across nine neighborhoods. Each device is a bucket-like container holding water and capsules with Wolbachia-infected mosquito eggs. After installations, eggs hatch, and the resulting mosquitoes reproduce, aiming for Wolbachia to establish in the local Aedes aegypti population and lower arbovirus transmission. Officials expect devices to be installed on streets in Eusébio by March. The project is led by mayor Dr. Júnior; Gabriel Silvestre is the implementation manager. Wolbachia, naturally found in some insects, reduces viral replication within the mosquito, complementing traditional vector-control measures rather than replacing them. In Ceará, similar efforts are planned for Maranguape and Crato to expand Wolbachia deployment.

triage.headline_ja: エウゼビオ市、保健分野で技術革新 デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱対策強化へWolbachia技術を導入
triage.triage_reason: これは公衆衛生当局による予防的なベクター対策（Wolbachia技術導入）の報道であり、新規の感染症発生や流行拡大を示す情報ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・セアラ州エウゼビオ市におけるWolbachia媒介蚊を用いたデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の予防的ベクターコントロール技術導入に関する報道であり、現時点での感染症流行や異常事態を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola en République démocratique du Congo : un essai clinique de vaccin avant la fin du mois, selon l'OMS - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a vaccine clinical trial before the end of the month, according to the WHO - RTBF Actus.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak—the 17th in its history and the deadliest—has surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,000 deaths since early October, with Tuesday’s health update. Bundibugyo ebolavirus is the current strain; there is no licensed vaccine or treatment for it. A vaccine clinical trial named Tumaini is about to start before month’s end, using Ervebo (RVSV-ZEBOV) vaccine licensed against the Zaïre strain, with tens of thousands of doses already shipped to DRC. The trial aims to progressively include candidate vaccines ChAdOx1 and Moderna, contingent on favorable phase 1 results from the United Kingdom and Canada. Doses of ChAdOx1 are available and ready for a larger trial, according to WHO’s vaccine lead Kate O’Brien. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever.

article.articleHeadline: 中俄傳鼠疫蔓延 民眾恐慌搶購防護用品 | 俄羅斯不明肺炎 | 鼠疫疫情傳聞 | 中國防疫提示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China-Russia plague spreads; the public panics and stockpiles protective gear | Unknown pneumonia in Russia | Rumors of plague outbreaks | China's epidemic prevention tips
article.articleSummary: Internal Russian sources report a staff member at the Russian Plague Institute died on Oct 11 from unknown pneumonia after exposure at the institute; Russian authorities deny plague. A death of a close contact on Oct 11 fuels claims of a wider outbreak. As of Oct 13, Chinese provinces Inner Mongolia, Hunan, and Guangdong issued plague prevention risk alerts amid public panic and stockpiling of masks, disinfectants, and medicines. Social media posts claim plague spreading to China’s cities including Shanghai, Chongqing, and Henan, but verification is lacking. A Shandong pharma executive cites alleged Russian internal messages indicating the latest death involved a man who worked at the plague institute; he flew to Khanty-Mansiysk on Oct 7, was isolated after illness, and tested positive. About 149,700 people within 90 km were tested, with nearly 470 weak positives; the region sealed, with around 9,000 people evacuated, including about 6,400 foreign nationals.

triage.headline_ja: 中露でペスト拡大との噂、市民がパニックで防護用品を買い占め｜ロシアで原因不明の肺炎｜ペスト流行の噂｜中国の防疫注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: ロシアのペスト研究所関連死亡を巡る未検証の噂が発端で、中国各省は予防的に警報を発令したのみで実際の症例確認はなく、公式当局も否定しているため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は大紀元系メディア(NTDTV)による未検証の噂・SNS情報が中心で、ロシア当局はペストを否定。中国国内での実際の鼠疫発生は確認されておらず、各省の警報は予防的措置かつ噂への対応と見られる。ロシア（対象国外）が実際の疑惑発生地であり、中国は噂・パニックの波及先にすぎないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Banda News: डेंगू पीड़ित पांच लोगो को कराया गया भर्ती
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Banda News: Five dengue patients admitted.
article.articleSummary: In Banda district, post-monsoon waterlogging has boosted mosquito breeding, with dengue cases emerging alongside viral fever. Five dengue patients were admitted to Banda District Hospital. Thirteen fever patients were tested for dengue at the hospital’s pathology lab, four samples were dengue-positive, and one additional dengue case was detected at a private pathology lab; all five patients are under treatment. Named dengue cases include 70-year-old Ramkhilavan, son of Maharjwa, of Bachheura; 20-year-old Jyotsna, daughter of KP Vishwakarma, of Gayatri Nagar; 18-year-old Mahesh, son of Ramnihor, of Nagendehi village; and 15-year-old Soumya, son of Rakesh, of Kantipur, Chitrakoot. The report notes rising mosquito-borne diseases with seasonal changes and rainfall contributing to transmission.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases exceed 9,000 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 9,000 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 13 October 2026, marking the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, which emerged in May and has spread across multiple hotspots, complicating containment efforts. There are currently no vaccines or therapeutics specifically approved for this strain. Globally, the outbreak ranks second in size, behind West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic that affected Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, with over 28,600 infections and more than 11,000 deaths. The crisis has spilled into neighboring Uganda, which earlier recorded 20 cases and 2 deaths before declaring the country free of the virus in August.

article.articleHeadline: Congo's confirmed Ebola cases exceed 9,000 as containment efforts falter - MyNorthwest.com
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases, with health ministry data listing 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths as of Tuesday. article.articleHeadline: Congo's confirmed Ebola cases exceed 9,000 as containment efforts falter
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo's Bunia region has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases, with 9,066 cases and 4,381 deaths reported by the health ministry, data released Tuesday. The death toll equals about 48% of confirmed infections, signaling faltering containment and rising transmission. A large share of deaths occurred outside treatment centers, indicating gaps in access to care and isolation for patients. The report confirms ongoing transmission within the outbreak area, with no details on laboratory confirmation methods beyond official counts. There is no mention of imported or exported cases in this release. Health workers warn that the outbreak remains dangerously active, and urgent public health measures are required to improve case identification, isolation, and community engagement to reverse the rising fatalities.

article.articleHeadline: National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme: 69 Panchayats of Reasi declared as TB Mukt - Daily Excelsior
article.articleSummary: 69 Panchayats in Reasi district were declared TB Mukt under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP). District Development Commissioner Kumar Abhishek distributed certificates to Block Medical Officers and health representatives for grassroots tuberculosis elimination. The ceremony, attended by the Chief Medical Officer, District TB Officer (Udhampur/Reasi) and block officials, stressed sustained, coordinated efforts to strengthen NTEP, including active case finding, early diagnosis, timely treatment, adherence, and community participation to achieve a TB-free district. A review meeting chaired by the CMO outlined achievements, gaps, and measures to intensify efforts across blocks and Panchayats under TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan. Participants were urged to ensure timely case identification, treatment completion, and regular progress monitoring, reinforcing interdepartmental coordination and field-level interventions to sustain TB Mukt status.

article.articleHeadline: Jammu: Dengue Cases Rise To 190 In Doda, ICMR-NIV Team Maps Virus Strains At Hotspots - Daily Excelsior
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Jammu and Kashmir's Doda district have risen to over 190 laboratory-confirmed cases requiring hospitalisation, prompting an ICMR-NIV team from Pune to map virus strains at hotspots and assist local authorities. The five-member team, led by Dr Qaiser Farooq Dar, visited Government Medical College Doda’s microbiology lab and several dengue hotspots, examined admitted patients, and reviewed test reports. Samples have been collected for further examination, with findings to be submitted to Jammu and Kashmir health authorities to guide further action. Doda Chief Medical Officer Dr Vinod Sharma said the health department, in coordination with civic bodies, is intensifying efforts to contain spread by leveraging ICMR-NIV support. The surge marks a sharp departure from the district’s historically non-prone mountainous profile.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie im Kongo: Zahl der Infektionsfälle auf über 9000 gestiegen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Congo: the number of infections has risen to over 9,000.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports the worst Ebola outbreak in its history, with confirmed infections exceeding 9,000 and 4,381 deaths as of 2026-10-13. Official figures show 9,066 infections, 4,381 fatalities, and 2,389 recoveries, yielding a 48.3% case fatality rate. The outbreak, first officially identified in mid-May, involves the Bundibugyo Ebola variant. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals; symptoms include fever, muscle pains, diarrhea, and progression to internal bleeding and organ failure. There is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola yet; several therapeutic candidates are in trials. This marks the most severe Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with historical context noting over the past 50 years more than 15,000 Africans have died from Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：感染者数が9,000人を超えて増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（感染9,066人、死亡4,381人、致死率48.3%）が発生しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo型であり、致死率48.3%と極めて高い。歴史上最悪規模の流行として国際的な懸念が高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 俄鼠疫真相未明 香港和大陸多省防控監測 | 俄羅斯不明肺炎 | 鼠疫外洩疑慮 | 中國香港防疫監測
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Truth About Russia's Plague Remains Unclear | Hong Kong and Numerous Mainland Provinces Intensify Monitoring and Control | Russia's Pneumonia of Unknown Origin | Fears of Plague Spillover | Epidemic Surveillance in Hong Kong, China
article.articleSummary: A young plague researcher died in Russia with the cause unknown; hundreds have been quarantined as a precaution, triggering Western and WHO scrutiny despite official claims of no wider outbreak. In Siberia, a female researcher died of severe pneumonia, fueling speculation about a plague link. China’s Inner Mongolia (Manzhouli) warned of risks from imported unknown pneumonia; Hunan and Guangdong disease control centers issued plague-prevention guidance. In Hong Kong, the Centre for Health Protection said it would strengthen health checks on Russian-bound flights, including temperature screening and travel-history declarations, with pneumonia patients referred for hospital evaluation. In Russia and mainland China, mask and supply shortages emerged among locals. Dr. Amesh Adalja cautioned that modern plague is treatable but emphasized clarifying the deceased’s pathogen and risk, while the US and WHO call for full information on possible spillover and public-health implications.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト、真相不明のまま—香港と中国本土複数省が監視・防疫を強化｜ロシアの原因不明肺炎｜ペスト流出懸念｜中国香港での防疫監視
triage.triage_reason: ロシアで若手ペスト研究者が原因不明の重症肺炎で死亡し、数百人が隔離される事態が発生。香港・内モンゴル・湖南・広東など中国各地が入国監視や防疫体制を強化し、WHO・米国当局も情報開示を求めるなど国際的関心が高まっており、異常性・渡航制限・国際的拡大懸念の観点からPICKUPと判断した。
triage.notes: 実際の発症・死亡事例はロシア国内に限定されており、対象国リストに含まれない。中国（香港・内モンゴル・湖南・広東）は予防的監視・検疫強化を行っているのみで、確認された発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めなかった。続報でロシア国内の病原体確定情報（ペストかどうか）および中国国内での実際の症例有無を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Congo testa vacina contra cepa Bundibugyo do ebola antes do fim de outubro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo tests vaccine against Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus before the end of October.
article.articleSummary: WHO and CEPI announced the Tumaini trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to test vaccines against Bundibugyo Ebola. The study will enroll people who had contact with confirmed cases during the outbreak, which has recorded over 9,000 infections and about 4,300 deaths. Initially, Ervebo, effective against the Zaire strain, will be used, though it has not been tested against Bundibugyo. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in Phase I: an Oxford University–Serum Institute of India candidate and Moderna’s mRNA vaccine; both could join Tumaini if early results are favorable. The trial is led by the DRC’s National Biomedical Research Institute and the University of Antwerp. Specialists warn about deaths of young children and insecurity; MSF, Africa CDC, the European Commission, and the U.S. State Department back the initiative.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、10月末までにエボラ・ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチンを試験
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ・ブンディブギョ株による大規模アウトブレイク（感染9,000人超、死亡約4,300人）が継続中であり、WHO・CEPI等国際機関が関与するワクチン治験が開始されるなど公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心の高い事案であるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited States, India, Belgium, UKが含まれるが、これらは国際支援機関・研究機関の所在地（ワクチン開発拠点や治験支援国）として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。感染者数・死者数が極めて多く、既存ワクチン（Ervebo）が効かない株であることから重大性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Two Dhemaji areas declared infected zones after ASF outbreak
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreak in Dhemaji district, Assam, with two infected zones declared on Oct 12. The first is around Nalbari Botakhana village near Gogamukh (Ramchandra Doley’s residence, Bordoloni block); the second around Balijan village near Bagharia (Arati Changmai’s residence, Dhemaji block). A 10 km surveillance zone surrounds each affected area. Within one kilometre, sale, purchase, transport and slaughter of pigs are prohibited, along with movement of raw, cooked or processed pork products into or out of the zones. Slaughter is banned in these zones; vehicles carrying pigs or pig feed face restrictions, and pigs transported by road or rail cannot be unloaded en route without a sanitisation certificate. Removal of live or dead pigs infected or suspected to be infected is prohibited. Veterinary authorities will conduct surveillance, awareness campaigns, disinfection and safe carcass disposal. ASF is highly contagious and fatal, posing severe losses to pig farmers.

triage.headline_ja: デマジ県の2地区、ASF発生により感染ゾーンに指定
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（ASF）で人への直接健康影響はないが、養豚業への経済的影響と感染拡大防止措置が取られており、今後の拡大状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ASFは動物（豚）のみに感染する疾患でヒトへの健康リスクはないが、養豚産業への経済的影響のため地元当局が封じ込め措置を実施している。

article.articleHeadline: Över 9 000 smittade av ebola i i Kongo-Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 9,000 infected with Ebola in Kongo-Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-13, Ebola outbreak in Kongo-Kinshasa has surpassed 9,000 confirmed infections, with nearly 4,400 deaths reported by the health ministry. The authorities express concern over the high fatality toll, noting that many of the registered deaths occurred outside healthcare facilities, AP reports. The article provides no details on laboratory confirmation, transmission chains, or affected communities. The figures underscore the substantial burden of Ebola in Kongo-Kinshasa and highlight reported gaps in care access and surveillance referenced by the health ministry.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ(キンシャサ)でエボラ感染者9,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 9,000人超の感染と約4,400人の死亡という大規模なエボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 致死率が非常に高く、多くの死亡が医療施設外で発生している点から、監視体制・医療アクセスの不備が示唆される。検査確認やヒト-ヒト感染の詳細情報は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's confirmed Ebola cases exceed 9,000 as containment efforts...
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in Congo have reached 9,066 with 4,381 deaths, a death toll representing nearly half of the cases, as authorities warn that community transmission remains a concern. The latest ministry tally shows 88 new confirmed cases and expands the outbreak to 65 health zones across seven provinces. The outbreak continues to spread to new communities, complicating containment. Kenya reported the first imported Ebola case from Congo since Uganda, signaling potential regional spread. A mobile laboratory has been deployed in Butembo to accelerate rapid testing and case finding. The situation underscores the challenge of keeping patients from dying in the community and the need for rapid isolation and treatment to reverse transmission trends. All data reflect Congo's ongoing Ebola outbreak as of 2026-10-13.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確定症例が9,000人を超え、封じ込め対策が困難に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで確定症例9,066人・死亡4,381人に達し、65保健区域に拡大、ケニアへの輸入例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。地域拡大の文脈として注記。

article.articleHeadline: Најтешка епидемија на ебола во историјата на Конго- починал секој втор заразен
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadliest Ebola epidemic in Congo's history — every second person infected died.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, Congo's Ebola outbreak, the Bundibugyo strain, has reached 9,066 infections, making it the deadliest in Congo's history and, according to the World Health Organization, the second-worst globally after the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with more than 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths. Intervention teams are operating at several active hotspots to slow transmission. The outbreak began in May and has surpassed the 2018-2020 Congo outbreak in severity. There are no approved vaccines or proven treatments for this Bundibugyo strain. The disease has crossed borders: Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths earlier this year but was declared Ebola-free in August. Kenya confirmed its first imported case last week—a Kenyan citizen who traveled from Congo via Uganda and later died in Nairobi.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの歴史上最も深刻なエボラ流行―感染者の2人に1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで9,066例に達する過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が発生し、国境を越えてケニアへの輸入例・死亡例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニアは輸入症例1例の報告のみで現地発生ではないため対象国リストに含まれるが、国内アウトブレイクではないためverified_locationsには含めず。ウガンダ・シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは対象国リスト外のため除外。主たる発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Over 100 dengue cases added in Haryana in a week, Panchkula overtakes Gurgaon
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Haryana reached 614 cases by Oct 12, 2026, up 22.1% in seven days, with Panchkula now the worst-affected district at 77 cases, Gurgaon 71, Jhajjar 55 and Rewari 50. Faridabad 49, Sonipat 47, Karnal 38, Rohtak 35 and Panipat 34. No dengue deaths have been reported so far in 2026. Government hospitals reported 365 of the 614 cases; private facilities 249. On Oct 12, 21 new infections were recorded (9 govt, 12 private), and 12 hospital admissions (3 govt, 9 private). In Gurugram city, 23 cases were from govt hospitals and 47 from private. Haryana operates 27 dengue testing labs; NS1/molecular tests are used early, IgM later, CBC for platelets/haematocrit. Measures include weekly Drying Day, mosquito control with 3 crore house visits, fogging in 4,983 localities, release of Gambusia fish in water bodies, and cap on ELISA NS1/IgM at Rs 600.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤーナ州で1週間に100件以上のデング熱症例が追加、パンチクラがグルガオンを上回る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱の増加報告であり、死亡例なし・既存の対策体制も機能しているが、症例数増加傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: インド・ハリヤーナ州における季節性デング熱の報告。死亡例なし、州政府による媒介蚊対策（防除、検査体制、料金上限設定）が既に実施されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯"鼠疫"疑云
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clouds of Suspicion Around Russia's 'Plague'
article.articleSummary: An incident at the Irkutsk-Siberia and Far East Anti-Plague Research Institute in Russia raised plague concerns after a staff member died. Authorities later said the illness was diagnosed as pneumonia of unknown origin, and samples showed no microbes linked to the staff member’s work. Contacts identified to the maximum extent were monitored with daily lab tests; in the past ten days there were no infectious-disease cases among institute staff. Irkutsk Oblast and related cities report stable public health conditions. The World Health Organization confirmed the patient, hospitalized for severe pneumonia, died on October 2. Russian health authorities told WHO that Irkutsk Oblast has had no recent plague cases and contact tests did not reveal high-threat pathogens. WHO requested lab test details for the deceased and contacts, the rationale for measures, and their health status. Experts note plague is Class A in China’s infectious-disease system; vigilance but no panics needed.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア『ペスト』疑惑の雲
triage.triage_reason: ロシアのペスト研究所職員の死亡がWHOの関心を集めたが、当局はペストを否定し原因不明の肺炎と発表、高リスク病原体も検出されていないため、現時点では続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア連邦（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国は記事中でペストが自国の感染症法でクラスAに分類されるという文脈でのみ言及されており、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOが詳細な検査情報を要請中であり、続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: जम्मू कश्मीर के डोडा में डेंगू के 190 से अधिक मामलों की पुष्टि | IBC24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 190 dengue cases confirmed in Doda, Jammu and Kashmir | IBC24
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, more than 190 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases have been reported in Doda district, Jammu and Kashmir, with many patients hospitalized at Government Medical College (GMC) Doda. A five-member ICMR-NIV team led by Dr. Kaesar Farooq Dar visited GMC Doda’s microbiology lab and several dengue-affected areas, reviewing tests and hospital records. Authorities have sought technical support from ICMR-NIV North Zone to strengthen surveillance and identify transmission hotspots. Dr. Dar described the rise as a sharp increase from the district’s historical dengue trends. Doda’s Chief Medical Officer, Dr. Vinod Sharma, said the health department is coordinating with local bodies to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンム・カシミール州ドダ県でデング熱患者が190人以上確認
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なデング熱の急増で、通常以上の発生動向とICMR-NIVの支援要請があるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: Nipahが疾患名リストに含まれているが記事内容はデング熱のみで、ニパウイルスに関する言及はない。地元当局がICMR-NIVに技術支援を要請しており、サーベイランス強化の動きがある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's confirmed Ebola cases exceed 9,000 as containment efforts falter
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-13, Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases, with 9,066 cases and 4,381 deaths reported by the Congolese health ministry. The data indicate relentless community transmission across the country, with Bunia mentioned in coverage. The death toll of 4,381 is nearly half of confirmed infections, underscoring outbreak severity. A large share of fatalities occurred outside treatment centers, signaling barriers to timely care as containment efforts falter. The ongoing pattern shows confirmed cases and high mortality, highlighting urgent needs for improved case detection, isolation, and access to treatment facilities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確認症例が9,000人を超え、封じ込め対策が失敗

triage.notes: 致死率(約48%)が極めて高く、治療施設外での死亡が多いことから医療アクセスと封じ込め体制の崩壊が懸念される。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情確診逾9000宗｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak surpasses 9,000 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak has reached 9,066 confirmed cases and over 4,380 deaths (case fatality rate ≈48%). The outbreak, which began in mid-May, has spread to seven provinces nationwide. There is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The World Health Organization labeled this as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record as of August. The Pandemic Prevention and Innovation Alliance announced that vaccine clinical trials for Bundibugyo ebolavirus have entered final preparation and are expected to start within weeks pending ethical and regulatory approvals, evaluating several candidate vaccines for safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、確定症例9,000件超
triage.triage_reason: 9,000例超・致死率約48%・7州への拡大という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、ワクチン未承認で国際的拡大リスクも高いためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOにより史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行と位置付けられており、ワクチン臨床試験が開始準備段階。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola cases surpass 9,000 as deaths reach 4,381 | News.az
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, declared in May, has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, with a cumulative 9,066 cases and a case fatality rate of 48.3% as of 2026-10-13. The seven affected provinces are Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, and South-Ubangi. This outbreak is the largest and deadliest in DR Congo and the second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. Regional authorities warn of ongoing transmission risk. Africa CDC urges stronger regional preparedness following Kenya’s report of its first imported Ebola case linked to the DR Congo outbreak; the patient traveled through DR Congo and Uganda before arriving in Kenya, where he died. The report emphasizes cross-border spread concerns and the need for heightened surveillance and collaboration to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、症例数9,000人超、死者4,381人に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ケニアへの越境感染例も発生していることから、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: Cruise ships firm suspends boarding of Kenyan crew over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case on Oct 6; the patient travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda to Nairobi and died, with burial under public-health protocols. MSC Cruises temporarily suspended embarkation of Kenyan crew until Oct 31 as a precaution while the situation is monitored; affected workers will be prioritized for November rescheduling. Authorities have intensified surveillance; no further transmissions confirmed yet, though travel advisories could affect bookings. In July, some Kenyan crew were stranded after a cruise company postponed embarkation, but no Ebola case then. The cruise sector remains important for Kenya; by July 2026, nine ships called at Mombasa, with 4,205 tourists last season, and the country targets about 20 vessels by end-2026.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ会社、エボラ懸念でケニア人乗組員の乗船を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ(ブンディブジョ型)感染者がケニアで確認され死亡、渡航制限（クルーズ乗船停止）も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニアで確認された症例はDRCからの輸入症例であり、実際の感染源（アウトブレイク発生国）はDRCと考えられる。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak passes 9,000 cases
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, the 17th in its history, has reached 9,066 cases and 4,381 deaths (case fatality 48.3%) with 2,389 recoveries as of 13 October 2026. The outbreak began in Ituri in the northeast and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces. Transmission continues via contact with bodily fluids; strained healthcare resources, armed-group presence, and distrust from communities hinder response. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Initial doses of Ervebo (effective against the Zaire strain) have been administered to frontline volunteers as part of a clinical trial, and a dedicated Ebola vaccine trial is expected to launch in the DRC before the end of October 2026. The situation marks the worst Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history, with experts suggesting the virus may have circulated weeks or months earlier, per INSP.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、症例数9,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%、9,000人超の症例、7州への拡大、ワクチン未承認というコンゴ史上最悪のエボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株による流行で承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、武装勢力の存在や住民の不信感が対応を困難にしている。DRC史上最悪の流行とされ、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Como se proteger da dengue diante da previsão de El Niño intenso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to Protect Yourself from Dengue Fever in Light of the Forecast for an Intense El Niño
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever risk rises in Brazil amid forecasts of an intense El Niño. Heat and rainfall may boost Aedes aegypti breeding, with an estimated 1.7 million dengue cases in Brazil in 2027, per InfoDengue/Fiocruz. The World Meteorological Organization indicates El Niño is established and could reach very strong intensity, likely persisting through February 2027. Dr. Fábio Argenta, director of Saúde Livre Vacinas, urges combining vector-control (eliminating standing-water sources in pots, bottles, tires), use of repellents, and vaccination. The Qdenga vaccine from Takeda is given in two doses for ages 4–60, offering protection against all four dengue serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) and reducing severe disease, hospitalizations, and health-system impact, regardless of prior infection. In early 2026 half-year uptake reached about 5,000 doses, with roughly 30% higher demand since June. Additional measures include window/door screens to boost protection.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョの強い発生予測を前にデング熱から身を守る方法
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はブラジルで季節的に流行する既知の疾患で、本記事は予防啓発・将来予測に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、緊急性や異常性は低いが、将来の症例増加予測があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発・ワクチン接種推奨を目的とした健康情報記事であり、現在進行中の異常なアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。2027年の推計症例数（170万件）は将来予測であり現状のシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: JJ Hospital Nursing Student Dies of Malaria Complications; Two Resident Doctors in ICU with Dengue
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, a 21-year-old BSc nursing student from Parbhani district at Grant Medical College and Sir JJ Hospital in Mumbai died from complications of malaria after admission on Oct 9 with hyperpyrexia; his fever rose to over 107°F and he was treated in the medical ICU. He lived in a hostel on the JJ campus, prompting repeated fumigation and cleanliness drives to curb mosquito breeding. Two resident doctors living on campus have been admitted with dengue, another mosquito-borne infection. Mumbai has recorded two malaria deaths this monsoon season and nearly 10,000 malaria cases so far this year, with more cases than last year according to the BMC. Infrastructure work across the city is blamed for water accumulation, creating breeding grounds for mosquitoes. The BMC death committee will determine whether the death was caused by malaria or dengue after reviewing medical records.

triage.headline_ja: JJ病院の看護学生がマラリア合併症で死亡、研修医2名がデング熱でICU入院
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイで季節性に毎年発生しているマラリア・デング熱の既知の流行であり、個別死亡例はあるものの異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: マラリア・デング熱はムンバイで毎年モンスーン期に発生する風土病であり、今年は昨年より症例数が多いとされるが、既存の公衆衛生対応（燻蒸・清掃活動）で管理されている。BMCによる死因調査が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Mulher com meningite viral é transferida de Fernando de Noronha para o Recife
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman with viral meningitis is transferred from Fernando de Noronha to Recife.
article.articleSummary: Viral meningitis in a woman treated on Fernando de Noronha, Brazil, and transferred to Recife in Pernambuco. The patient presented last weekend with headache and speech alteration, received initial care at Hospital São Lucas in Fernando de Noronha, remained stable, and was transferred to Recife after 24 hours of treatment with precautions including masks. In Recife, a cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) sample was collected to confirm diagnosis; she remains hospitalized in observation in Recife with stable condition and favorable clinical evolution. Meningitis can be caused by fungi, parasites, viruses, and bacteria; viral meningitis typically has a milder course with spontaneous recovery, whereas bacterial meningitis can progress rapidly requiring urgent antibiotic therapy. Health surveillance contacted family members and hospital staff, all of whom remained asymptomatic. All suspected meningitis cases should be promptly notified.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性髄膜炎の女性、フェルナンド・デ・ノローニャからレシフェへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: 単発のウイルス性髄膜炎症例であり、軽症で安定、接触者も無症状のため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した疾患名『Classical Swine Fever』は記事内容（ヒトのウイルス性髄膜炎）と無関係であり、誤分類と考えられる。単一症例報告でアウトブレイクの兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's confirmed Ebola cases exceed 9,000
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-13, Congo's Ebola outbreak has 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, with 88 new cases in the latest report. The Bundibugyo virus is involved; there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Across seven provinces, 65 health zones are affected; confirmed cases represent about a third of total infections, indicating widespread undetected transmission and ongoing community infection. Deaths are rising, with many occurring outside treatment centers, and community transmission remains a concern. Containment is impeded by fighting between government forces and rebels, a severe humanitarian crisis, large population movements, and shortages of medical supplies and treatment centers. The outbreak surpasses Congo's 16 previous outbreaks and threatens to exceed the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (11,000 deaths). Cross-border risk is evident as Kenya reports an imported Ebola case from Congo, with Uganda affected as well.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確定症例数が9,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が大規模流行し、国境を越えてケニア・ウガンダへの波及が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境症例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、紛争により封じ込めが困難な点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão de limpeza reforça combate à dengue em São Miguel do Anta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cleanup Drive Reinforces the Fight Against Dengue in São Miguel do Anta.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention drive in São Miguel do Anta, Brazil, led by Epidemiological Surveillance teams and Family Health Program (PSF) teams, with support from the Department of Public Works, aimed at eliminating breeding sites for the dengue-transmitting mosquito. A municipality-wide cleanup identified and removed stagnant-water sources and potential mosquito habitats. The coordinated effort reinforces dengue prevention by clearing debris and maintaining areas prone to water accumulation. Public health messaging stressed resident participation: avoid standing water, keep yards clean, and discard containers that can serve as breeding grounds. The initiative highlights integrated action between health surveillance, primary care teams, and the works department to protect the population of São Miguel do Anta. Published 2026-10-13.

triage.headline_ja: サンミゲル・ド・アンタでデング熱対策を強化する清掃活動
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的清掃活動を報じる内容であり、症例急増や異常事態の報告がなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は定例の蚊媒介対策（清掃活動）に関する行政広報であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: FSDA test flags contamination in 203 of 242 packaged water samples
article.articleSummary: Lucknow FSDA tested 242 packaged and mineral water samples across Uttar Pradesh and found 146 substandard and 57 failing microbiological tests, leaving only 39 samples (about 16%) fit for consumption. Microbiological analyses detected harmful microorganisms, including E. coli, coliform bacteria, yeast and mold. Commissioner Roshan Jacob ordered suspension of food licenses for units linked to unsafe samples and an immediate halt to production. Units with substandard results were issued notices for improvement and required to rectify deficiencies; after corrections, the assistant commissioner (food) of the relevant division will verify improvements and report to FSDA headquarters. Failure to improve will invite legal action under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Unsafe samples were linked to units in 39 districts, with Ghaziabad and Hapur recording four failed samples each and Chandauli reporting 12 substandard samples. The department emphasizes consumer safety and trust in drinking water.

triage.headline_ja: FSDAの検査、242件中203件のパック詰め飲料水サンプルで汚染を検出
triage.triage_reason: 規制当局によるルーティンの水質検査結果であり、疾病アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は食品安全当局による包装飲料水の品質検査結果報告であり、実際のヒト感染・発症事例は報告されていない。対象国リストのインドが発生地域に含まれるが、疾病アウトブレイクイベントではないため地域検証の対象から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola cases surpass 9,000 as efforts to contain outbreak falter
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 9,066 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths as of 2026-10-13, with the outbreak spanning 65 health zones across seven provinces and 88 new cases in the latest update. Community transmission remains a concern, and fatalities outside treatment centres are rising. The crisis is driven by Bundibugyo virus, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. Officials estimate confirmed cases account for only about one-third of actual infections. Containment is hampered by fighting between government forces and rebels, widespread disregard for precautions, population movements, and shortages of medical supplies and treatment centres. The outbreak has surpassed Congo’s previous outbreaks and may exceed the 2014-2016 West Africa event (~11,000 deaths). Cross-border risk is highlighted by Kenya reporting an imported Ebola case from Congo, making it the second country after Uganda to record an import, underscoring regional threat.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例数が9,000人を超え、感染拡大の封じ込め努力が難航
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクが9,000例・4,381死亡に達し、過去最大規模に迫る深刻な状況。ケニア・ウガンダへの越境症例も確認され、国際的拡大リスクが明白であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。アンゴラも発生地域に記載されているが記事本文中に具体的言及がなく確認不可。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョウイルス株であり、医療資源不足・紛争による封じ込め困難という点で特に緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un essai clinique de vaccin attendu en RDC avant la fin du mois, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a vaccine clinical trial expected in the DRC before the end of the month, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola vaccine clinical trial named Tumaini is expected to launch in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) before the end of October 2026, per WHO officials. The outbreak marks the 17th Ebola epidemic in the DRC and the deadliest in the country’s history, with more than 9,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths since early October. The surge is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no licensed vaccine or treatment for this strain. Tumaini will initially test Ervebo (Zaïre ebolavirus) with tens of thousands of doses already shipped to the DRC, with plans to add ChAdOx1 and Moderna candidates if phase 1 results are favorable. MSF is conducting BRAVO, an observational vaccination study of 20,000 frontline workers in Ituri and North Kivu starting Sept 19, planned for 9–12 months, including three months of vaccination and at least six months of follow-up. Ebola spreads via contact with body fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOによれば、今月末までにコンゴ民主共和国でワクチンの臨床試験が予定されている
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（9,000例超、死亡4,000人超）のエボラ流行が継続しており、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本流行はDRC史上最悪のエボラ流行とされ、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株が原因。WHO、MSFなど国際機関が臨床試験・観察研究を実施中であり、国際的な支援・関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie im Kongo: Zahl der Infektionsfälle auf über 9000 gestiegen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Congo: the number of infection cases has risen to over 9,000.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports the worst Ebola outbreak in its history, with infections rising above 9,000. Official figures as of 13 October 2026 show 9,066 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, with 2,389 recoveries, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.3%. The outbreak was officially identified in mid-May and represents the most severe Ebola epidemic in the central African nation to date. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals. Patients typically develop fever and muscle pain, followed by diarrhea and, in severe cases, internal bleeding and organ failure. The causative variant is Bundibugyo Ebola; unlike the Zaire variant, there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment currently, though several therapies are in clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：感染者数が9,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ史上最悪のエボラ流行で致死率48.3%、ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyo変異株であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 致死率48.3%、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo変異株による同国史上最悪の流行。国際支援の必要性が高いと推測される。

article.articleHeadline: 21 cases a day: Ahmedabad battles a post-monsoon dengue spike
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Ahmedabad, India, surges post-monsoon with 893 cases Sept 1–Oct 11, averaging 21 daily; 137 cases in Oct 1–11. Jan 1–Oct 11 total dengue cases reach 1,481, with Sept–Oct comprising 60.3% of the year's total and Sept alone reporting 756 cases. Areas reporting rises include Gota, Jagatpur, Chandkheda, Bodakdev, Thaltej, plus Vastral, Lambha, Nikol. AMC conducts vector-control: survey of over 200 open plots for standing water, drainage and larvicide spraying, and intensified inspections of residential societies and construction sites. In the same period, 468 simple malaria, 92 falciparum malaria, and 17 chikungunya cases were recorded. Other monsoon illnesses include gastroenteritis (4,184), jaundice (634), and typhoid (1,758); Oct 1–11 counts: 56 gastroenteritis, 23 jaundice, 73 typhoid. Of 2,368 water samples, six were unfit for consumption.

triage.headline_ja: 1日21件:アーメダバードがモンスーン後のデング熱急増と闘う
triage.triage_reason: インドの風土病地域における季節性（モンスーン後）のデング熱増加であり、異常性はなく、地元自治体（AMC）が通常のベクター対策で対応しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・アーメダバード市における季節性デング熱（マラリア、チクングニア、腸チフス等を含む）の増加を報告するローカルな保健当局の活動レポートであり、地方自治体（AMC）がベクター対策を実施中。インド以外の国（バングラデシュ等）は発生地域に含まれるが記事主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 《TAIPEI TIMES》 Taiwan closely monitoring plague rumors: premier
article.articleSummary: Taiwan is monitoring online rumors of a pneumonic plague outbreak reportedly spreading from Russia into China, with Premier Cho Jung-tai saying quarantine measures could be stepped up if warranted. In a Legislative session, lawmakers noted claims that several Chinese provinces are affected and pressed whether Taiwan is prepared to prevent cross-strait spread given high traffic. The Ministry of Health and Welfare says border quarantine measures were issued two weeks ago, and officials will keep tracking online information from China to identify suspicious developments and decide if controls should be strengthened. Mainland Affairs Council Minister Chiu Chui-cheng said China has been opaque about outbreaks, and the council will keep Taiwanese workers in China informed. The MOH has contacted the WHO to verify whether Oct. 2 death of a 28-year-old lab worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute was due to pneumonic plague; so far no pathogen tests are positive, so a firm link cannot be concluded.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾、ペストの噂を注意深く監視：首相
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストがロシアから中国へ拡大しているとの未確認の噂を台湾政府が公式に監視・検疫強化を検討しており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大懸念・渡航制限検討）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 実際の確定症例はロシア・イルクーツクの検査技師1名の死亡（病原体検査は陰性で肺ペストとの関連未確定）。中国国内での感染拡大はオンライン上の未確認の噂に基づくものであり、WHOへの照会中。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国については噂の中心地として記載したが、確定情報ではない点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito menace: 4 more dengue cases reported, tally rises to 137
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Bhopal, India, reports 4 new cases on 13 October 2026, pushing the total to 137. Fresh infections are from Ginnori, Shahjehanabad, Indrapuri and Lal Ghati. With 21 cases in September and 13 in the past two days, October shows the sharpest two-day rise in dengue in nearly two years in the city. No specific hotspot identified; cases occur across multiple localities. Preventive measures include fogging and vector-control in confirmed areas; district malaria office teams sanitised 50 houses near affected patients and conducted vector-control activities. Bhopal Municipal Corporation’s health department did not respond to questions about measures. Health experts advise residents to prevent water stagnation, regularly clean water-storage containers, and use mosquito repellents, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance and community participation to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の脅威:デング熱新規4例、累計137例に
triage.triage_reason: インド・ボパールでのデング熱の季節的増加であり、通常の公衆衛生対応がなされているが、直近2日間で急増がみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱流行であり、地域限定の蚊媒介感染症対策（燻蒸・消毒）が実施されている。直近2日間での急増は過去2年で最大との記述があり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Fears over Russia bioweapons cover-up grow as 'plague' threat spreads to China
article.articleSummary: Russia's Irkutsk region reports a suspected Black Death outbreak after the 2 October death of lab worker Darya Shipilova, 28, at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia. About 200 people were quarantined and several hospitals closed; authorities have not publicly identified the cause. Former CDC Director Dr. Robert Redfield questions whether it was plague, noting wild-type pneumonic plague is typically treatable with antibiotics and calling for transparency. He speculates about an antibiotic-resistant or genetically modified strain tied to Russia's bioweapons program, but no evidence supports this. The episode has sparked fears of a Russian outbreak spreading to China, with online stockpiling reported per Chinese media outlet FTV.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの生物兵器隠蔽への懸念が高まる中、「ペスト」の脅威が中国にも波及
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員の原因不明死、約200人の隔離・病院閉鎖という異常な事態があり、重症度・異常性の基準を満たし、メディアでの社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 情報源はタブロイド紙(Daily Star)で、生物兵器関連の憶測を含み信頼性に注意が必要。発生国ロシアは対象国リストに含まれず、中国への拡大は『懸念』段階で確定事例の報告はないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。ロシア当局による公式な病原体同定情報がなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Un studiu clinic ce vizează un vaccin va începe în RDC înainte de sfârșitul acestei luni, anunță OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: A clinical trial of a vaccine will begin in the DRC before the end of this month, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization announces that a clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine will begin in the Democratic Republic of the Congo before the end of October 2026. The notice is included in a report dated 13 October 2026. The article provides no further specifics on the vaccine candidate, trial sites, participant numbers, trial design, or anticipated timeline for results. The statement signals ongoing international efforts to evaluate Ebola vaccines in the DRC, ahead of potential outbreak response; however, no epidemiological details such as case counts, transmission chains, or infection sources are disclosed. The text centers on the scheduled initiation window rather than operational particulars. There is no mention of other diseases or locations beyond the Ebola vaccine trial in the DRC. The piece uses WHO as the source for the stated plan and timing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ワクチンの臨床試験が今月末までにコンゴ民主共和国で開始されるとWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラワクチンの臨床試験開始という発表のみで、新規症例数や感染拡大など疫学的詳細が一切記載されておらず、現状のアウトブレイク状況が不明なため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによるワクチン臨床試験開始予定の発表のみで、現行のエボラアウトブレイクの症例数・感染経路等の疫学情報は含まれていない。エボラは疾病特性上重要度が高いが、本記事単独では新規シグナルとしての判断材料が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Irmã de Deolane atualiza quadro de saúde do segurança Nego Jader após melhora infecciosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deolane's sister updates the health status of security guard Nego Jader after infectious improvement.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 12, 2026, Nego Jader, personal security guard of influencer Deolane Bezerra, remained hospitalized in the ICU at a São Paulo hospital with an infectious condition. Medical bulletins reported a significant reduction in signs of infection, though he remains in a grave condition requiring continuous monitoring and daily treatment adjustments. Daniele Bezerra, the influencer’s sister, visited the hospital and said ICU updates are provided daily, with clear results of exams. She noted no fever in the last night and a good response to prescribed antibiotics. While progress is gradual, the medical team is adjusting dosages as lab results evolve, and there are no respiratory complications reported. The family remains cautiously optimistic and asks for ongoing prayers and support.

triage.headline_ja: デオラーネの妹、警備員ネゴ・ジャデールの感染症からの回復状況を更新
triage.triage_reason: 個人の健康状態に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の懸念や感染症アウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 単一個人の感染症（病原体不明）に関する芸能関連記事であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての特徴はない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo supera los 9.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 9,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 9,000 cases, with 9,066 infections and 4,381 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%), per the National Institute of Public Health of Congo. Declared mid-May as the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, the virus is believed to have circulated weeks or months earlier. The outbreak began in Ituri, in the northeast, and has spread to seven provinces in the north and east. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids; Ebola hemorrhagic fever has claimed more than 15,000 lives in Africa over the last 50 years. This outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment, though Ervebo doses (effective against the Zaire strain) have been given to volunteers in a trial. A broader vaccine trial is planned before month’s end per WHO experts. In 2018–2020, RDC’s prior outbreak caused about 3,500 cases and nearly 2,300 deaths, with current recoveries at 2,389. Resources are limited amid armed conflict and distrust of health workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、9,000症例を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで9,000例以上・致死率48.3%に達し、7州に拡大、ワクチン・治療法未確立であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による大規模アウトブレイクであり、武力紛争下で医療資源が限られている点も懸念材料。WHOによる広域ワクチン試験が計画中。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo supera los 9,000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 9,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths, the worst outbreak on record in the country. Since early October, 9,066 infections and 4,381 deaths have been reported, yielding a case fatality rate around 48.3%, per the National Institute of Public Health of Congo. The outbreak began in Ituri, northeast RDC, and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces amid limited health resources and armed-group activity. Local distrust toward medical teams has fueled incidents. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. Initial doses of Ervebo, effective against the Zaire strain, have been given to volunteers as part of a trial. A broader vaccine trial is planned in the DRC before the end of October, according to WHO experts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者数が9,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48.3%で9,000人超・4,381人死亡という過去最悪規模の流行であり、ワクチン未承認株の拡大、武装勢力活動、地域住民の不信による対応困難など国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻性が高い。
triage.notes: 流行株はBundibugyo株でワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、Zaire株向けのErvebo初回投与が試験的に実施されている。武装勢力の活動と住民の医療チームへの不信が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta sanitaria: El Congo supera la barrera de los nueve mil casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health alert: the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses nine thousand confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has reached 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), with 2,389 recoveries and 895 hospitalized or isolated, as of October 12. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal hemorrhages. Contact tracing covers 79% of contacts. In the past 24 hours, 88 new cases and 33 recoveries were reported. The epidemic spans 65 health zones across seven provinces, led by Ituri (56 new cases) and North Kivu (28); others: Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. Declared May 15, this is among the deadliest outbreaks; no specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo. Vaccines are in early human trials; Congo began using Ervebo (Zaire strain) in August, with animal data suggesting possible protection against Bundibugyo. Uganda’s outbreak ended Aug 26 after 20 cases (15 imported); Kenya, France and the Netherlands reported imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生警報：コンゴが確認エボラ症例9,000件を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%、9,000人超の確認症例、65保健地帯・7州に拡大し、複数国への越境伝播（ウガンダ、ケニア、フランス、オランダ）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は8月26日に終息済み、ケニア・フランス・オランダは輸入症例のみのため、主要発生国はDRCのみとした。対象国リストにウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダは含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: திருப்பத்தூா் நகராட்சியில் டெங்கு கொசு ஒழிப்பு தீவிரம்: ரூ.25,000 அபராதம் வசூல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tiruppathur Municipality intensifies dengue mosquito elimination drive; Rs. 25,000 fine collected.
article.articleSummary: Tiruppathur Municipality in Tamil Nadu intensifies its dengue vector control drive, conducting house-to-house inspections across 36 wards to identify breeding sites and raise public awareness. In the 34th ward, on Tuesday, dengue mosquito larvae were found at two locations. A total fine of Rs. 25,000 was imposed and collected into the municipal treasury. Residents are urged to prevent standing water and remove items that collect water—unused tires, coconut husks, open water containers—to curb breeding. If larvae are detected during inspections, penalties under regulations and legal action will follow. The municipality calls for full public cooperation to prevent dengue fever by keeping homes and surroundings clean and water-free.

triage.headline_ja: ティルパトゥール市、デング熱の蚊撲滅活動を強化:2万5000ルピーの罰金を徴収
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体によるデング熱媒介蚊対策・啓発活動の報道であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例の急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はタミル・ナードゥ州ティルパトゥール市における定例的なデング熱媒介蚊対策・衛生啓発活動と罰金徴収の報道であり、感染者数や重症度に関する具体的な数値は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa: appel à la vigilance après un décès non confirmé du Mpox à Kingasani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: call for vigilance after an unconfirmed Mpox death in Kingasani - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa's Kingasani health zone experiences heightened vigilance after rumors of a Mpox-like death. The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) in the Democratic Republic of Congo announced that, following a weekly multisectoral epidemiological coordination meeting, a second suspected mpox case was lab-confirmed negative, and the reported death should not be attributed to mpox without biological confirmation. Dr. Dieudonné Mwamba, INSP Director-General, urged strict adherence to barrier measures and urged the public to cooperate with health teams and seek care promptly for suspicious symptoms. Mpox is a viral disease characterized by painful skin eruption, fever, and swollen lymph nodes. No confirmed mpox case is reported in this article; surveillance remains vigilant in Kinshasa to prevent potential spread.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ：キンガサニでのMpoxによる未確認死亡を受け警戒呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでは既知のMpoxアウトブレイクが継続中だが、本記事では疑い死亡例は未確認であり、2例目の疑い症例も検査で陰性と判明している。新規確定症例情報がないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: DRCはMpoxの既知流行国であり継続監視対象。本記事は死亡疑い例が未確認である旨の公的発表であり、新規確定症例の報告ではない。続報で確定症例数の推移を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: 中国公民尽快撤离！使馆紧急通告，感染确诊超8000例，无特效药
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese citizens urged to evacuate as soon as possible! Embassy issues urgent notice: More than 8,000 confirmed infections, no specific drug.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri and North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, amid mining-driven displacement and ongoing armed conflict. The Bundibugyo strain has no effective vaccine or antiviral; existing vaccines targeting Zaïre Ebola are unlikely to protect against Bundibugyo, contributing to a 40–50% case-fatality. By mid-2026, WHO reported over 2,000 cases and about 830 deaths; by October, more than 60 health zones were affected, with 47 in active transmission and 60–70% of deaths occurring outside hospitals. Cross-border risk is evidenced by a trader infected in DRC who traveled to Uganda and Kenya. East DRC mining hubs such as Lualaba and Haut-Katanga (Kolwezi) host many Chinese workers. The situation prompted urgent evacuation notices from the Chinese embassy; reporting, evacuation, and coordination with peacekeeping forces are urged, though ultimate exit depends on individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 中国公民は速やかに撤退を！大使館が緊急通知、感染確定例8000人超、特効薬なし
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大し、致死率40-50%、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染事例あり、中国大使館が緊急避難勧告を発出するなど社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染事例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。有効なワクチン・抗ウイルス薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による致死率40-50%の深刻なアウトブレイクであり、紛争・鉱山関連の人口移動が感染拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: China Funeral Supplies Trade Booms as COVID Cases Rise, Vendors Say
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases rose sharply in China during July–August 2026, with severe cases increasing from 130 in June to 487 in July and 640 in August, and deaths recorded as 1 in June, 1 in July, and 6 in August. In Shandong Province's Linyi, the Linyi International Expo Center hosted a three-day funeral supplies exhibition from Oct 10-12 that drew dense crowds amid rising demand for funeral and memorial goods. Vendors described strong orders and a surge of young entrants into the sector, though profit margins had normalized after prior booms. Anonymous sources alleged authorities concealed outbreaks and attributed many cases to bacterial infections. A pseudonymous virologist warned of rapid airborne transmission in enclosed spaces and aerosols, noting that people around him reported cold-like illnesses and suggesting repeated infections raise health risks; concerns about school quarantines and surface disinfection not fully addressing aerosol spread. Official counts reflect reported data, not the full infection scale.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でCOVID感染者増加に伴い葬儀用品取引が活況、業者が証言
triage.triage_reason: 山東省を中心に重症例・死亡例の増加傾向と当局による隠蔽疑惑が報告されており、エアロゾル感染拡大の懸念と社会的反応（葬儀用品需要急増）が確認されるため、情報の信頼性検証を含めたフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事は匿名情報源・政治色の強いメディア（NTD）に基づく内容で、当局による隠蔽疑惑など未検証情報を含むため、公式統計との照合が必要。重症化・死亡者数は小規模だが増加傾向があり、継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria Parasite RNA Helicase PfDDX1 Emerges as a Regulator of Blood-Stage
article.articleSummary: Plasmodium falciparum malaria parasites, studied in lab cultures, reveal PfDDX1, a nuclear-localized DEAD-box RNA helicase, as a regulator of the asexual blood-stage IDC. Using CRISPR/Cas9 tagging and a conditional HA-ddFKBP knockdown with Shield-1, researchers observed that PfDDX1 depletion accelerates IDC progression and increases merozoite output per schizont from the first cycle, with cumulative parasitemia rising by the fourth cycle; invasion efficiency remains unchanged. Transcriptomic analysis shows the schizont-stage response broadens with PfDDX1 loss, upregulating genes linked to merozoite development and invasion machinery, including rhoptries, micronemes, inner membrane complex, and cell surface. Ring-stage changes are limited, indicating stage-specific effects. Localization and functional data suggest PfDDX1 acts as a developmental brake rather than part of the invasion apparatus, highlighting RNA-level regulation in malaria and informing new research directions. Work conducted by teams in Xi’an, Northwest University, and China’s National Institute of Parasitic Diseases.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア原虫のRNAヘリカーゼPfDDX1が血液期発育の調節因子として同定
triage.triage_reason: 実験室培養での基礎研究(分子生物学的研究)であり、公衆衛生上の流行事象ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア原虫の基礎研究（実験室培養細胞を用いた分子生物学的研究）に関する内容であり、実際の感染症流行事例ではない。中国西安の研究機関による研究報告のため、地理的な発生地域（実際の患者発生）は存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia conclui contagem de larvas do Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia completes Aedes aegypti larvae count.
article.articleSummary: Hortolândia, Brazil continues the Aedes aegypti larval-density analysis (ADL) to monitor dengue and other arboviruses, with UVZ teams, the Health Secretariat, and resident participation. Sampling covers about 3,000 properties across five city regions (roughly 600 per region; quadrants chosen by lottery). The ADL yields the Breteau index, with 0–1 low, 1–4 medium, and >4 high. The three annual surveys occur in January, July, and October. January 2026 recorded 8.2 (high, due to summer); July 2026 recorded 3.5; October 2025 was 0.3 (low). Residents are asked to allow entry; agents wear badges and uniforms. Results guide vector-control strategies against dengue and other arboviruses in Hortolândia.

triage.headline_ja: オルトランジアがネッタイシマカの幼虫調査を完了
triage.triage_reason: 通常のベクターサーベイランス活動の報告であり、デング熱の異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Mulher diagnosticada com meningite viral em Fernando de Noronha é transferida para o Recife - Portal CBN Recife
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman Diagnosed with Viral Meningitis in Fernando de Noronha Is Transferred to Recife
article.articleSummary: A woman diagnosed with viral meningitis was treated at Hospital São Lucas in Fernando de Noronha and later transferred to Recife for specialized testing and continued investigation. She presented with headache and speech changes, remained stable during the island stay, and was moved to Recife after 24 hours of treatment. During transport, health-protective measures including mask use and standard precautions were observed. In Recife, a cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) sample was collected to aid diagnostic confirmation. The Pernambuco Health Secretariat reports she remains hospitalized in observation with a stable, favorable course. Meningitis inflames the brain and spinal cord coverings and can be caused by viruses, bacteria, fungi, or parasites. Viral meningitis tends to be milder with many recoveries, while bacterial meningitis requires prompt antibiotics. On Fernando de Noronha, surveillance staff contacted close contacts; none are symptomatic, including hospital personnel.

triage.headline_ja: フェルナンド・デ・ノローニャでウイルス性髄膜炎と診断された女性、レシフェへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: 単発のウイルス性髄膜炎症例で経過は安定、接触者にも症状なく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。疾患タグ（豚コレラ）は記事内容と無関係。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した疾患名（Classical Swine Fever）は記事内容（ヒトのウイルス性髄膜炎）と一致しておらず誤タグと判断。単一症例かつ軽症経過であり、サーベイランス上の通常事案。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل أكثر من 9 آلاف إصابة مؤكدة بإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 9,000 confirmed Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases, with the Ministry of Health reporting 9,066 confirmed infections and 4,381 deaths as of October 13, 2026. The death toll is about half of the confirmed cases, highlighting the outbreak’s severity. Containment efforts have faltered, hindering attempts to curb transmission. Notably, a large share of deaths occurred outside Ebola treatment centers, signaling significant gaps in access to care and treatment capacity. The figures reflect ongoing transmission within affected regions and emphasize the ongoing public health challenge posed by this Ebola outbreak. Health authorities continue to monitor the situation amid limited containment progress.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の確定症例が9,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確定症例9,066人・死者4,381人（致死率約50%）と大規模な流行が継続し、封じ込めが難航しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 死亡者の多くが治療センター外で発生しており、医療アクセス・対応能力のギャップが示唆される。致死率が約50%と非常に高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: U Kongu više od 9.000 ljudi zaraženo ebolom, polovina umire, zdravstvo posustaje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, more than 9,000 people infected with Ebola; half die, the healthcare system is faltering.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo faces an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with more than 9,000 infections and about half resulting in death. The latest report records 88 new cases and warns that village-to-village transmission remains a concern; 65 health zones are affected. Confirmed cases account for roughly one-third of total infections, as many go unrecorded. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for this strain. The virus circulates in animal reservoirs (fruit bats) and spreads to humans through contact with blood or bodily fluids; it is not airborne. Early symptoms are fever, severe headache, and fatigue; later: diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, kidney/liver dysfunction, and bleeding. Response is hindered by conflict, nonadherence to precautions, population movement, shortages of medical supplies, and few treatment centers. Kenya imported a Congo case; Uganda previously reported one; this outbreak could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epicenter (11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで9,000人以上がエボラに感染、半数が死亡、医療体制が崩壊寸前
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、9000人超の感染、65保健地域に拡大、国境を越えた症例（ケニア・ウガンダ）があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは輸入症例として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認であること、紛争や医療資源不足が対応を困難にしている点がリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases pass 9,000 as efforts to curb transmission falter
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo strain has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases, with 9,066 cases and 4,381 deaths reported by the Health Ministry as of Tuesday, making it the largest, deadliest outbreak in DRC's history. Globally, only the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic exceeds its toll. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccines or treatments, raising concerns about cross-border transmission. Kenya reported its first imported case from a Kenyan national who lived in the DRC and traveled via Uganda to Nairobi, where he died; Uganda had 20 cases and two deaths earlier but was declared Ebola-free in August. The DRC outbreak began mid-May (possible February onset) and has spread to seven provinces in the north and east. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids. Challenges include community mistrust and ongoing conflict with M23 hindering response. A vaccine efficacy trial forBundibugyo is being prepared in coming weeks, per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、感染者9000人を超える—感染拡大阻止の取り組みが停滞
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（9000例超、死者4381人）で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株による国境を越えた感染拡大（ウガンダ、ケニア）が確認されており、紛争による対応阻害も深刻なため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダへの越境感染例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。記事の主題はDRCでの流行拡大。

article.articleHeadline: Sete Lagoas encerra vacinação contra a chikungunya em 30 de outubro para pessoas de 18 a 59 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sete Lagoas ends chikungunya vaccination on October 30 for people aged 18 to 59.
article.articleSummary: Sete Lagoas residents aged 18–59 have until October 30 to receive the chikungunya vaccine. The municipal vaccination campaign ends on that date, with no doses available in the municipality starting in November. Vaccination can be conducted at health units with vaccination rooms and at Vacimóveis (mobile vaccination units) participating in the campaign. Individuals in the 18–59 age group who have not yet been immunized are urged to seek vaccination before the deadline. The city’s Health Department emphasizes this as part of chikungunya prevention, urging compliance to ensure protection before vaccines run out. October 30 marks the final day of the campaign for the specified age bracket.

article.articleHeadline: RedeTV! ES: Combate à dengue: Serra ultrapassa 290 mil visitas a imóveis - 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RedeTV! ES: Fight against dengue: Serra surpasses 290,000 property visits - 2026.
article.articleSummary: Serra's dengue control effort has logged 291,553 property visits in 2026 by Endemic Disease Control Agents from the Municipal Health Secretariat, targeting Aedes aegypti mosquito. Inspections identify and eliminate potential breeding sites, remove or treat non-removable water-holding deposits, and educate residents on prevention. The Health Secretariat monitors mosquito presence and epidemiological indicators to direct teams to high-risk areas; when needed, blocks and chemical control are implemented per Ministry of Health criteria. Planned actions cover the neighborhoods Praia Mar, Das Laranjeiras, Chácara Parreiral, Valparaíso, Planalto Serrano, Barcelona, Vila Nova de Colares, Pitanga, São Diogo II, Carapina Grande, Novo Horizonte, and Jardim Carapina. Residents should set aside a few minutes weekly to check yards, gutters, plant pots, and other containers, and allow entry for duly identified agents; community participation is essential to interrupt dengue transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Vaccin împotriva Ebola. Peste 9.000 de infectări în RD Congo. OMS, anunț
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccine against Ebola. Over 9,000 infections in DR Congo. WHO announces.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-13, the Democratic Republic of Congo is in its 17th Ebola outbreak, now the worst on record, with over 9,000 infections and more than 4,000 deaths since early October. A Tumaini vaccine trial is to begin in DRC before month’s end, using Ervebo against Zaire ebolavirus, with doses already shipped. The study aims to later integrate candidate vaccines ChAdOx1 (Oxford) and mRNA-1469 (Moderna) if phase 1 results are favorable. MSF coordinates the BRAVO observational study in Ituri and North Kivu among 20,000 frontline health workers, spanning 9–12 months with three months of vaccination and at least six months of follow-up. Earlier in June, Europe reported its first Ebola case in France, a physician who had returned from a mission in the DRC.
