article.articleHeadline: Congo's confirmed Ebola cases surpass 9,000 as containment efforts falter
article.articleSummary: Congo’s Ebola outbreak, confirmed in seven provinces and 65 health zones, has surpassed 9,000 cases with 4,381 deaths (9,066 cases, 4,381 deaths reported). The Bundibugyo virus drives the crisis, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The latest tally records 88 new cases, with authorities warning that community transmission remains a concern and that confirmed cases comprise only about one third of total infections, leaving many undetected. Containment is hindered by fighting between government forces and rebel groups, a severe humanitarian crisis, population displacement, and shortages of medical supplies and treatment centers, with many deaths occurring outside facilities. Bunia, in Ituri province, is among hotspots. The outbreak is larger than Congo’s 16 prior outbreaks and could exceed 2014–2016 West Africa’s toll (11,000). Cross-border risks include Kenya reporting an imported case from Congo, following Uganda as a country with unrelated outbreaks linked to the same event.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確定症例が9,000人を超える、封じ込め努力は難航
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例9,000人超・死亡4,381人に達し、過去16回のコンゴ国内アウトブレイクを上回る規模で、ケニアへの越境感染例も報告されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、紛争・人口移動により封じ込めが著しく困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Sesau reforça mutirões e combate ao Aedes aegypti em Campo Grande - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesau reinforces mass campaigns and fights Aedes aegypti in Campo Grande - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Campo Grande, Brazil, intensifies Aedes aegypti control ahead of the rainy season with campaigns and mobilization. Sesau plans mutirões, mobilization, and educational activities as part of the Municipal Committee to Combat Arboviruses’ 5th Ordinary Meeting, October 13, 2026, at CRF/MS. Created by Sesau Resolution 963 (March 2026), the committee aims to identify high-risk zones for interventions and broaden sector participation, including the Army and private partners. Dengue notifications in 2026 total 1,614 vs 4,603 in 2025; chikungunya 43; zika 1; no arboviral deaths in 2026. Ministry data show 57 probable dengue cases in 2026 vs 534 in 2025 (one death). High-risk areas include Centro, Chácara dos Poderes, Santo Amaro, Carvalho, Noroeste, Nova Lima, Carlota, Santo Antônio. Last week, 20,364 properties were inspected; 684 had Aedes aegypti foci; ~80% inside homes. Emphasize inspections of yards, gutters, water tanks, pots, and drains; eliminate standing water. Campaign Juntos contra as Arboviroses supports these actions.

triage.headline_ja: Sesau、カンポ・グランデでネッタイシマカ対策の集団キャンペーンを強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の症例数は前年より大幅に減少しており、通常の季節的な蚊媒介感染症対策活動の一環であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 2026年のデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の症例数は2025年と比較していずれも減少しており、死亡例もない。雨季前の予防的な蚊駆除活動の通常報道と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Cases Surpass 9,000 as Containment Efforts Stumble
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths as of 2026-10-13, making it the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country's history. The virus has spread to seven provinces in the north and east. Containment is hindered by community mistrust of health workers and ongoing conflict between the M23 rebel group and government forces, which disrupts transport of responders and supplies. A local politician was beaten to death in September after defending the government's Ebola response. Regional developments include Kenya reporting its first imported case—a Kenyan national who lived in the DRC and travelled via Uganda to Nairobi, where he died. Uganda had 20 cases and two deaths earlier this year but was declared Ebola-free in August. A vaccine efficacy trial for Bundibugyo is being prepared for the DRC in coming weeks per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が9,000人を突破、封じ込め対策が難航
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（9,000例超、死者4,381人）が7州に拡大し、ケニアへの越境感染例も発生しており、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確なためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ケニアでの輸入症例およびウガンダでの過去の症例は言及されているが、現時点での主要な発生国はDRCであり、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。紛争（M23）や地域住民の不信感が封じ込めを阻害している点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 39歲男確診猴痘 曾多次到訪胡同 防護中心倡即日起暫時關閉 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 39-year-old man diagnosed with monkeypox; had visited hutongs several times; Centre for Health Protection calls for immediate temporary closure | am730
article.articleSummary: 39-year-old man in Hong Kong diagnosed with monkeypox after a rash developed Oct 5–8; he was isolated at Ruttonjee Hospital and later transferred to Princess Margaret Hospital. He had visits to a Mong Kok venue Hutong on Shanghai Street, where he had high-risk sexual contact with men. CHP and police conducted site checks; staff remained asymptomatic. Because transmission could not be ruled out, Hutong should be temporarily closed immediately. Those who visited on or after Sept 14, especially with high-risk sexual contact, should call Monkeypox Hotline for assessment and testing. Since 2022, Hong Kong has 115 monkeypox cases (24 imported). By Oct 13, 2026, this year's total is 31 (24 locally acquired), with 22 new cases since August, about 70% of annual total. Public Health Laboratory Service found identical viral sequences in some cases, suggesting a common source and MSM transmission chains; vaccination and avoidance of high-risk sex urged.

triage.headline_ja: 39歳男性が猴痘（サル痘）と確診、複数回「胡同」を訪問 衛生防護センターが即日閉鎖を勧告
triage.triage_reason: 香港で性的接触を介した市中感染クラスターが拡大しており（8月以降22例、年間の約7割）、同一ウイルス配列が確認されるなど流行拡大の兆候があり、当局が施設閉鎖を勧告するなど公衆衛生対応が強化されているため。
triage.notes: 香港は中国の特別行政区のためChinaに分類。市中感染が性的接触を介して拡大しており、MSMコミュニティ内での感染連鎖が示唆される。重症例の報告はないが、感染拡大傾向が続いている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Chamba health officials trained in rabies prevention & management - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Chamba health officials conducted a one-day training under the National Rabies Control Programme to strengthen rabies prevention and management. Medical officers and staff nurses attended, chaired by Chief Medical Officer Dr Jalam Bhardwaj, with District Programme Officer Dr Suhail Ahmed delivering the trainer-led briefing. The programme covered rabies prevention, medical management of dog bites and bites from other suspected animals, and the importance of timely treatment. Dr Ahmed stressed that rabies is serious and fatal but preventable through prompt medical intervention and adherence to the vaccination schedule, including anti-rabies vaccination and rabies immunoglobulin where indicated. Participants were advised to wash wounds with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes and seek care promptly, and not to apply chilli, oil, soil, or other household substances to wounds, underscoring proper wound care and timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: チャンバの保健当局者、狂犬病予防・管理のトレーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病予防・管理に関する通常の研修プログラムの報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病の発生報告ではなく、国家狂犬病制圧プログラムに基づく医療従事者向け研修の内容。具体的な症例数や発生状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: ÉBOLA SUPERA LOS 9 MIL CASOS CONFIRMADOS EN EL CONGO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Surpasses 9,000 Confirmed Cases in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has reached 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths (case fatality 48.3%) as of October 12, 2026. 2,389 people have recovered, and 895 are hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing stands at 79.5%. In the previous 24 hours, 33 recovered and 88 new infections were reported, indicating ongoing community transmission. Ituri and North Kivu provinces account for many of the latest cases (56 and 28, respectively); the outbreak affects 65 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. No approved specific treatment exists; the World Health Organization is evaluating two vaccines. Congo began a vaccination campaign with Ervebo (Zaire strain) in late August, with animal data suggesting potential against Bundibugyo, though efficacy against this strain remains under study. Uganda’s outbreak linked to Congo ended on August 26 with 20 cases and two deaths; imported cases were reported in Kenya, France, and the Netherlands. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood and bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで確認症例9,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が9,000例超・致死率48.3%に達し、7州65保健区に拡大、継続的な地域内感染とケニア・フランス・オランダへの輸入例も確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダの関連流行は8月26日に終息済み。ケニア・フランス・オランダは輸入例の報告のみで対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo supera los 9.000 casos y deja más de 4.300 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo surpasses 9,000 cases and leaves more than 4,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of October 13, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, with 88 new cases in the latest report. The outbreak, centered in Ituri's Bunia and spreading across seven provinces to 65 health zones, continues with sustained community transmission. Officials say confirmed cases likely represent only about a third of total infections, with many undetected. Bundibugyo ebolavirus is responsible, and there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Containment is hampered by armed conflict, humanitarian crises, large population movements, and shortages of medical supplies and treatment centers; many deaths occur outside facilities. The outbreak has surpassed prior Congo episodes and risks exceeding the 2014-2016 West Africa toll of about 11,000. Kenya reported an imported Ebola case from Congo last week, highlighting cross-border concerns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、症例数9,000人超・死者4,300人超に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大規模流行（9,000例超、死者4,300例超）に加え、ケニアへの越境輸入例も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が明確に該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニアは輸入症例の報告国であり対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、武力紛争による封じ込め困難、2014-2016西アフリカ流行の死者数を超える可能性があるとされ、極めて深刻な事例。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: UK Keeps Kenya Travel Advisory Unchanged Amid Ebola Spread, Calls for Global Containment Support
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, the United Kingdom keeps its travel advisory for Kenya unchanged amid an Ebola outbreak in the region, urging global containment support. The outbreak is ongoing, with emphasis on the Democratic Republic of the Congo; no new UK travel restrictions for Kenya are planned as the country maintains robust isolation, contact-tracing and treatment capacity. British High Commissioner to Kenya, Matt Baugh, stated this in Mombasa, highlighting Kenya's ability to manage Ebola and calling for international cooperation to curb spread. The remarks occurred during a Mombasa Open House focusing on UK-Kenya cooperation in education, trade, security and the blue economy; the visit also touched on security and trade around the Port of Mombasa. Baugh also noted Kenya's preparations for the 2027 general election and urged peaceful, credible polls, reinforcing UK support for stability and partnership.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、エボラ流行下でもケニアへの渡航勧告を維持、国際的な封じ込め支援を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行について、英国政府高官が国際的な封じ込め支援を呼びかけており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価への移行が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は英国によるケニア向け渡航勧告の据え置きだが、実際のエボラ流行はDRCで発生しているとされ、ケニア国内での感染確認は記載なし。Bluedotが付与したKenya/Mombasa/UKの地域情報は会見開催地・発信国であり、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Около 4,3 тыс. человек скончались в ДР Конго в результате заражения вирусом Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: About 4,300 people died in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as a result of infection with the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of October 13, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 9,066 cases and 4,381 deaths, per authorities cited by Associated Press. By the end of September, about 8,000 cases and 3,900 deaths had been reported. The outbreak, officially declared May 15 in Ituri Province, spread to other provinces and across the border to Uganda, though the World Health Organization noted in August that Uganda was no longer experiencing transmission. WHO called the outbreak the fastest-growing in history, with potential to surpass the largest recorded outbreak of the past decade, which killed over 11,000 people. A significant share of deaths occurred among patients who died outside health facilities, underscoring access and care challenges in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染により約4,300人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が過去最速ペースで拡大し、複数州および国境を越えて感染が広がった大規模流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されたが、WHOは8月時点でウガンダ国内での伝播は終息したと発表しており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯鼠疫疑云 呼伦贝尔发风险提示又撤回 香港澳门发布安全警报
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspicions of plague in Russia; Hulunbuir issues a risk alert, then retracts it; Hong Kong and Macau issue safety alerts.
article.articleSummary: Suspicions of plague in Russia trigger public health alerts in Inner Mongolia’s Hulunbuir, plus Hong Kong and Macau, though China has not implemented new border controls as of 2026-10-13. The WHO reported that a staff member at an Irkutsk plague-research institute died on Oct 2 after severe pneumonia; tests for Yersinia pestis and other high-risk pathogens were negative, with no evidence of sustained transmission or laboratory safety incidents. Hulunbuir briefly posted a plague risk notice on Oct 10 referencing the Irkutsk case, highlighting low likelihood given no human cases since 1927 and routine surveillance; the notice was deleted by Oct 13. Hong Kong’s CHPDS on Oct 12 maintained that immediate risk is low but intensified airport screening: temperature checks for Russia-bound flights, travelers with Irkutsk visits in the last 14 days must declare travel history, and pneumonia cases referred to public hospitals. Macau issued similar health risk alerts and border screening. Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis and transmitted by fleas or pneumonic spread, remains a global surveillance concern; the event also revives attention to Soviet-era bioweapons research.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト疑惑、内モンゴル・フルンボイルがリスク注意喚起を発表後撤回、香港・マカオが安全警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでのペスト疑い死亡事例を受け、香港・マカオが空港での検疫強化、内モンゴル・フルンボイルがリスク通知を発表（後に撤回）するなど、複数地域で社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため、フルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: ロシア・イルクーツクでの疑い症例はペスト菌（Yersinia pestis）検査で陰性と判明しており、持続的伝播や実験室事故の証拠はない。フルンボイルのリスク通知は10月13日までに削除されたが、香港・マカオは引き続き空港スクリーニングを強化中。ロシア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、中国（内モンゴル・香港・マカオ含む）のみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo supera los 9 mil casos y 4 mil muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 9,000 cases and 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reaches 9,066 cases and 4,381 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), the country’s deadliest on record, with 2,389 recoveries. Originating in Ituri (northeast), it has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces; Ituri alone has 6,480 cases and 2,989 deaths as of Oct 6 (WHO). WHO ranks the risk as very high in the DRC, high in neighboring countries, and low globally. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo; no vaccine or approved treatment exists. Ervebo (Zaire strain) has been tested in volunteers, and a vaccine efficacy trial could begin in coming weeks in the DRC. Challenges include limited health resources in conflict areas and community distrust. Cross-border spread: Kenya reported an imported case linked to the DRC via Uganda; Uganda previously had 20 cases and 2 deaths before August."

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、症例数9,000件・死者数4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが複数州に拡大し、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境伝播が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、紛争地域での対応の困難さと地域社会の不信感が課題とされている。WHOはDRC国内リスクを非常に高い、近隣国を高い、世界的には低いと評価。

article.articleHeadline: പനി ബാധിതർ കൂടി; ചിക്കുൻ ഗുനിയ വ്യാപകം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever cases on the rise; chikungunya epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Thiruvananthapuram, Oct 13, 2026: Fever cases are rising as authorities battle a chikungunya epidemic and increasing dengue, with other febrile illnesses also spreading. In the latest tally, 7,617 fever patients were treated yesterday, including six confirmed cases of Shigella dysentery. Malaria cases are reported alongside the febrile mix. To curb dengue and chikungunya transmission, Health Minister K. Muraleedharan has proposed a coordination committee chaired by district collectors; the Health Department Principal Secretary is tasked with implementing the measures. While actions proceed, officials say transmission remains unabated. Prolonged rains have caused water stagnation, heightening mosquito breeding risk. Authorities critique partial implementation of the government’s directive to eliminate breeding sites, even as fever-affected areas see strengthened vector control and the setup or expansion of clinics where needed.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱患者増加、チクングニア流行拡大
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で発熱患者7,617人、チクングニア・デング熱・マラリアが同時流行し、長期的な蚊媒介感染リスクと行政の対応強化が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 季節性の降雨による蚊繁殖増加が主因とされ、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、地域内での持続的な感染拡大と行政の対策強化が報じられている。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde de Campinas registra mais quatro casos de gripe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas Health Department reports four more cases of influenza.
article.articleSummary: Campinas reports four additional influenza-related Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases, raising the city’s total SRAG by influenza to 384. Since January, 34 people have died from influenza, with the latest death confirmed in late September. The Campinas Health Department emphasizes vaccination, with doses available for all people aged 6 months and older at 69 municipal health centers; no appointment is needed. The vaccine covers influenza A (H1N1 and H3N2) and B, and can be administered alongside other vaccines in the National Immunization Schedule, reducing transmission. In 2015, Campinas registered 561 SRAG cases due to influenza and 69 deaths. Preventive measures include frequent handwashing, well-ventilated spaces, adequate hydration, and a healthy diet. If symptomatic, wearing a mask helps protect others. Details on vaccination center hours are on the official Campinas vaccination site.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナス保健局、インフルエンザの新規4症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる通常規模のSRAG症例報告であり、過去の流行（2015年）と比較しても異常な増加は見られず、ワクチン接種呼びかけの通常広報内容である。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの定例的な市レベル報告であり、対象国リストに該当する国（ブラジル以外）はなく、ブラジル自体も通常の季節性変動の範囲内と判断されるため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: CCSS habilitó casi 30 mil dosis adicionales de vacunas contra la fiebre amarilla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CCSS enabled nearly 30,000 additional doses of yellow fever vaccines
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever vaccine availability expanded by Costa Rica's Social Security Fund (CCSS) to about 30,000 additional doses in response to heightened travel demand through the upcoming high season. The extra doses are intended for travelers to Brazil, Colombia, Venezuela, Paraguay, Ecuador, Bolivia, Peru, Trinidad and Tobago, among others, and are conditioned on a valid airline ticket. The immunization area states the vaccine must be given at least 10 days before entry to the destination country, and the travel must be scheduled with a ticket dated by December 31, 2026. The measure aims to facilitate entry to these countries, as yellow fever vaccination is a mandatory requirement for entry. The information was provided by Elvis Delgado, a physician in CCSS immunizations, highlighting the need to meet the ticket and timing prerequisites for travelers.

triage.headline_ja: CCSS、黄熱病ワクチンを約3万回分追加で供給開始
triage.triage_reason: コスタリカが渡航者向けに黄熱病ワクチンの供給を拡大したという行政的・予防的対応の記事であり、対象国での黄熱病の発生や流行を報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はコスタリカにおけるワクチン供給拡大の報道であり、黄熱病の発生国はブラジル等中南米諸国が渡航先として言及されているのみ。対象国リストの中ではブラジルのみ該当するが、ブラジルでの黄熱病発生自体を報じる内容ではない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Scientists Test Whether Ebola Vaccine Can Fight Bundibugyo Virus
article.articleSummary: DRC-based Tumaini Phase 2/3 trial will evaluate safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy of Ebola-related vaccines against Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). Initially prioritizing Ervebo, licensed against Zaire EBOV; cross-protection against BDBV not established. BDBV is a distinct species; vaccine approval for one does not guarantee protection for the other. Two BDBV-specific vaccines are in Phase 1: Moderna and University of Oxford with Serum Institute of India. The adaptive platform trial in DRC will test multiple candidates; ring vaccination of contacts and high-risk people is planned. Led by INRB and University of Antwerp Global Health Institute, with oversight by the DRC Ministry of Health; Africa CDC supporting; WHO providing guidance. Participating groups include Epicentre, MSF, Institute of Tropical Medicine Antwerp; CEPI funding/support, with contributions from European Commission, U.S. State Department, Fund for Science and Technology, and CEPI core funding.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らがエボラワクチンのブンディブギョウウイルスへの効果を検証
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はDRCで計画中のワクチン臨床試験（Tumaini Phase 2/3）に関する研究開発報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや症例急増などの公衆衛生上の異常事態を報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas confirma novos casos de gripe e reforça vacinação em 69 postos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas confirms new flu cases and reinforces vaccination at 69 vaccination posts.
article.articleSummary: Four new cases of influenza-related severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) were confirmed in Campinas, São Paulo, bringing the year's total to 384 cases and 34 deaths, with the latest death verified in late September. Vaccination is reinforced at 69 municipal posts, available to everyone from 6 months of age, with no appointment required; present photo ID and vaccination card if available. The vaccine protects against influenza A (H1N1 and H3N2) and influenza B and can be administered with other vaccines in the National Immunization Schedule. Last year, Campinas recorded 561 influenza-associated SARS cases and 69 deaths. Preventive measures include frequent handwashing, well-ventilated spaces, staying hydrated, and a healthy diet; if symptoms appear, wearing a mask is advised.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナス市、インフルエンザ新規症例を確認し69カ所でワクチン接種を強化

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1/H3N2/B型）に関する地方自治体の定例的なワクチン接種推進記事。昨年同期比で症例・死亡数は減少しており、異例の事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: the outbreak continues in DRC with over 9,000 cases recorded (Minister in charge of Health) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 9,066 total cases (as of Oct 11, 2026), including 3,081 confirmed and 2,289 recoveries; daily deaths fluctuate between 20 and 40. Six provinces are affected—Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo and South Ubangi—across 52 health zones, driven by the Bundibugyo strain and transmitted by direct contact. Authorities stress the outbreak is not over, aided by rigorous alert monitoring and laboratory testing. Financially, an initial plan of $242 million was outlined, with $360 million mobilised; the government has disbursed $50 million to the National Institute of Public Health, while partner support goes through implementing agencies. The response faces challenges from insecurity and high population mobility impacting containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国でアウトブレイクが継続、9,000例超を記録（保健担当大臣）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで6州・52衛生区域にまたがるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続し、9,000例超・死亡多数を記録。治安不安や人口移動により感染拡大リスクが高く、国際支援も進行中でありフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Более 4,3 тыс. человек скончались в ДР Конго из-за заражения вирусом Эбола - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,300 people died in the DRC from Ebola virus infection - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: On 13 October 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, according to the Ministry of Health. The outbreak continues to expand, with new flare-ups and transmission reaching 65 medical zones across seven provinces, indicating a broad geographic footprint and ongoing community spread. Earlier reports warned this outbreak could become the deadliest in the DRC's history. The article notes the scale and spread but provides no details on infection sources, laboratory confirmation methods, or whether there are imported or exported cases. The figures reflect laboratory-confirmed data through 13 October 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Isiro: New Mechanisms Planned to Reduce Mortality Rate - ACP
article.articleSummary: On Oct 13, 2026, in Isiro, Haut-Uele province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, officials unveiled new mortality-reduction measures in the Ebola response during a planning meeting of the provincial epidemic response coordination team. The laboratory team will perform additional tests beyond Ebola diagnostics, targeting diabetes, hypertension, and HIV/AIDS to lower deaths at the Ebola Treatment Centre (ETC). Dr. José Lolekoleko, response operations officer at the Haut-Uele DPS, emphasized establishing intensive-care services, setting up a blood bank, and addressing other emergency needs, leveraging equipment at Isiro General Referral Hospital and within the health zone. Surveillance leaders noted that many deaths stemmed from complications related to comorbidities. The recommendations were authorized for immediate implementation, with participation from WHO’s provincial response coordinator and officials overseeing all response pillars.

triage.notes: エボラ治療センターでの死亡率改善策として、糖尿病・高血圧・HIV/AIDSなどの併存疾患管理を強化する取り組み。既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応の一環であり、新規発生の報告ではないが継続中の公衆衛生危機として評価。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情破9千例 WHO宣布疫苗臨床試驗月底展開 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 9,000 cases; WHO announces vaccine clinical trials to begin by the end of the month.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reaches over 9,000 cases and more than 4,000 deaths as of Oct 14, 2026, prompting WHO to launch Tumaini, a vaccine trial set to begin by the end of October. The study will first test Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) in large-scale human trials to assess cross-protection against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which no approved vaccine or therapy exists. If data show adequate safety and immunogenicity, the framework will expand to include two Bundibugyo-targeted candidates: Oxford University's adenovirus-vector vaccine and Moderna's mRNA vaccine. SAGE chair Anthony Scott said the results will provide critical efficacy data to guide policy. WHO immunization chief Kate O’Brien noted committee review of early data before broader trials, while Doctors Without Borders is already collecting Ervebo efficacy data among frontline health workers.

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진자 9천명 넘어...보름 만에 1천명 ↑
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 9,000, up 1,000 in fifteen days.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases, reaching 9,066 with 4,381 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%) as of Oct 13, 2026, per INSP. The outbreak, declared May 15, began in Ituri Province with Bunia as the initial epicenter and has spread to seven provinces, reaching the northwestern Nord-Ubangi Province. This is the largest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo to date, exceeding the 2018–2020 outbreak (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths). Globally, it ranks as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths). The report highlights ongoing transmission across multiple regions, underscoring sustained public health challenges in the region.

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 9,000 casos confirmados por la epidemia de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC surpasses 9,000 confirmed cases amid the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has surpassed 9,000 confirmed infections, reaching 9,066 cases with 4,381 deaths and a 48.3% case fatality rate as of Oct 12. Recovery stands at 2,389; 895 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing is 79.5%. Ituri and North Kivu are hardest hit, with 56 and 28 new cases in the last 24 hours, across 65 health zones in seven provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, South Kivu, Ubangi del Sur). The Bundibugyo Ebola virus has no specific therapy; two vaccines are in early human trials. Ervebo vaccination began in late August in DRC with positive signals against Bundibugyo in animals. Uganda recorded 20 cases (15 imported) with 2 deaths; imported cases reported in Kenya, France, and the Netherlands. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito Genes Map Colombia's Hidden Aedes aegypti Lineages
article.articleSummary: Colombia's Aedes aegypti populations show two dominant mitochondrial (COX1) lineages, rather than geographic partitioning by coast, highlands, or Amazon regions, according to a PLOS Neglected Tropical Diseases study. Using 394 new COX1 sequences plus public records (n=717), researchers sampled Caribbean, Andean, Orinoco, and Amazonian areas to test spatial-temporal patterns. The finding implies deep maternal lineages persist across the country, with substantial human-mediated mixing via transport networks and urban habitats, eroding fine-scale structure. Urbanization partially explains mitochondrial structure, with time-dependent effects. Demographic analyses indicate an older rise in female effective population size, followed by a reduction and stabilization in recent generations, likely reflecting colonization history, habitat changes, and vector-control impacts, alongside climate signals—min temperature linked to demographic variation. Implications for dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever transmission in Colombia are significant for surveillance and control.

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola na República Democrática do Congo supera 9 mil casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 9,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 9,066 cases and 4,381 deaths, a case-fatality rate of 48.3%, according to the National Institute of Public Health of Congo (INSP). The outbreak began in Ituri in the northeast and has spread across seven northern and eastern provinces where health resources are limited and armed groups operate. Local communities have distrusted health workers and aid staff, contributing to several incidents in recent months. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. Initial doses of Ervebo, protective against Zaire ebolavirus (the more common strain), have been administered to volunteers as part of a trial in recent weeks. A clinical vaccine trial is planned in the DRC before the end of the month, per World Health Organization experts.

article.articleHeadline: Hospital-Acquired Infections Hit 15.7 Percent Globally as Drug-Resistant
article.articleSummary: Global hospital-acquired infections (HAIs) affected 15.72% of patients across studies from 2000–2025, per a BMC Infectious Diseases systematic review led by Fatemeh Sameni and Masoud Dadashi (Iran). Because study heterogeneity was high (I² = 99%), no single pooled prevalence is reported; the observed rate reflects real variation. A stark geographic gradient shows Asia 43.04% and Africa 34.07%, with India at 24.28% national prevalence. Predominant pathogens are Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Acinetobacter baumannii. Vancomycin-resistant S. aureus was found in 11.66% of 300 isolates; broader multidrug resistance includes MRSA, vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus, carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae, and ESBL-producing Gram-negative bacilli. In ICUs, invasive devices and immunocompromised patients drive risk, highlighting gaps in hand hygiene, sterile equipment, and diagnostics in resource-limited health systems.

triage.headline_ja: 院内感染、世界全体で15.7%に達し薬剤耐性スーパーバグが拡大

triage.notes: 本記事はBMC Infectious Diseases誌に掲載された系統的レビュー（メタ解析）の紹介であり、特定の国・地域での急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。著者はイランの研究者だが、イラン国内での発生事例ではない。インドについては国別有病率（24.28%）が具体的に言及されているため参考として記載するが、これも継続的な院内感染の統計データであり、新規の感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Opinión | De Siberia al Congo: alertas para responder mejor a otra pandemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Opinion | From Siberia to the Congo: Alerts to Respond Better to Another Pandemic
article.articleSummary: Plague fears surface after the October death of a laboratory technician in Siberia amid suspicion of plague, triggering worldwide alarm about infectious disease risk. The opinion argues that such incidents, while grabbing headlines and prompting press briefings, have not necessarily spurred a marked strengthening of strategic planning to prevent, detect, and mitigate a potential mass contagion or another pandemic. The piece calls for improved preparedness across borders, highlighting the gap between sensational alerts and substantive public health measures. Locations mentioned include Siberia and, in the title’s framing, the Congo, underscoring a cross-continental framing of pandemic readiness. While the article does not provide laboratory confirmation or outbreak details, it emphasizes the need for proactive surveillance, clear response protocols, and internationally coordinated investment to avert future outbreaks.

triage.notes: 記事はオピニオン記事であり、実際の発生事例の確認情報（検査結果、症例数、発生地域の詳細）を含まない。コンゴは見出し上のメタファー的言及であり、実際の発生報告ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak kills over 4,200 as armed groups undermine response - BT News
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has killed at least 4,205 people and infected about 8,728 since mid-February, with the outbreak declared on May 15; as of October 7 the trajectory remains uncontrolled. Ituri province accounts for roughly three-quarters of confirmed cases, with North Kivu emerging as a new hotspot, and seven of DRC’s 26 provinces reporting infections. The case fatality rate is near 50%. No specifically approved treatment exists for this Bundibugyo strain, and laboratory confirmation relies on blood tests after suspected cases are isolated in Ebola transit and treatment centers. The response is hampered by armed conflict, aid cuts, and weak funding: the UN says the humanitarian plan is only about half funded, with contact tracing at 80.4% (below the 95% target). A September 29 fire destroyed an Ebola transit center in Kigonze camp, displacing thousands of IDPs. Uganda-based CRP militias and Rwanda’s M23 further restrict access.

article.articleHeadline: बागपत के आवारा कुत्ते के काटने से आठवीं के छात्र की मौत, दो महीने बाद सामने आए रेबीज के लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stray dog bite in Baghpat kills an eighth-grade student; rabies symptoms surfaced after two months.
article.articleSummary: Rabies fatality in Bagpat, Uttar Pradesh, India, after a stray dog bite. An eighth-grade student named Sahil died two months after being bitten on the forehead; no anti-rabies vaccination was given at home. Three days before hospitalization, Sahil’s condition deteriorated, with hydrophobia (fear of water) and behavioral changes. He was first taken to a district hospital and then referred to GTB Hospital, where he died late in the evening. Doctors confirmed progression to hydrophobia, the terminal stage of rabies. Health officials advised the entire family to receive anti-rabies vaccination. Wound care guidance emphasized washing the bite with running water and soap for 10–15 minutes, and avoiding home remedies such as red chili, turmeric, or lime. The incident underscores the importance of post-bite vaccination and timely medical care to prevent rabies transmission.

Declared mid-May, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC’s history. The current strain is Bundibugyo; there is no vaccine or approved treatment for this lineage. The outbreak began in Ituri, in the northeast, and has spread across seven northern/eastern provinces. Resources are limited and armed groups complicate response, while local communities’ distrust toward health workers has led to incidents. article.articleHeadline: পুজোর মুখেই মুর্শিদাবাদে বাড়ছে ডেঙ্গু, আক্রান্ত আঠারোশো পার
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue on the rise in Murshidabad ahead of Puja, with 18-plus people infected.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Murshidabad, West Bengal, is rising ahead of Puja with about 1,850 people currently infected; no deaths reported yet. Murshidabad often leads the state in dengue cases. Despite monsoon ending, widespread water stagnation keeps mosquitos active. Health officials say this month’s figures are lower than earlier, attributing progress to public awareness and coordinated vector-control efforts; district chief health officer Sandip Sanyal notes cases stood at about 1,840 by Monday, with door-to-door surveillance ongoing. Hemorrhagic dengue and dengue shock syndrome cases are lower than last year. Dengue patients are being admitted at Murshidabad Medical College Hospital, Lalgola Krishnapur Rural Hospital, Suti Maheshail Rural Hospital, and Raniganj Islampur Rural Hospital. Block- and municipality-level health workers are conducting home visits. Doctors urge early medical consultation if fever lasts several days and recommend blood tests to confirm dengue and begin timely treatment, alongside preventive measures to deter mosquitoes.

triage.headline_ja: プジャを前にムルシダバードでデング熱が増加、感染者1800人超
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域（西ベンガル州ムルシダバード）で例年通りのデング熱流行が見られるが、死亡例なし・重症例は前年より減少しており、地域の通常対応で管理されているため緊急のフルRRAには至らない。
triage.notes: 死亡例なし、重症型（出血性デング・デングショック症候群）は前年より減少。地元保健当局によるベクター対策・サーベイランスが進行中で、インド国内の地域的・季節的流行として管理されている模様。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, malaria hit KEM doctors; hostel under scanner
article.articleSummary: At King Edward Memorial (KEM) Hospital in Mumbai, Maharashtra, more than a dozen resident doctors have been diagnosed with mosquito-borne infections—12 tested positive for dengue, with several more cases of malaria reported; some doctors have recovered while others remain under treatment. The hospital association (MARD) president Dr Shubham Salunke confirmed dual infections, but exact totals for malaria and overall affected individuals could not be independently verified. An anonymous doctor cited overcrowding in hostels, with male and female doctors housed on separate floors due to space constraints, prompting scrutiny of accommodation adequacy and potential mosquito breeding inspections; no proven link between hostel and infections exists yet. Administrative clarification is awaited on occupancy, treatment status, hostel inspections, preventive measures, and housing arrangements for male and female residents. Hospital dean Dr Harish Pathak did not respond by press time.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・マラリアがKEM病院の医師を襲う、寮が調査対象に
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイの単一病院内でのデング熱・マラリアの集団発生であり、国際的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生影響は確認されないが、媒介蚊感染症の集団感染として続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一医療機関内（KEM病院の医師寮）での集団発生で、デング熱とマラリアの重複感染例が複数確認されている。地域社会全体への拡大は報告されておらず、原因（寮の蚊の発生源）も未確定。続報で全体像の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 網傳肺鼠疫蔓延中國 分析：資訊不透明加劇疑慮 | 搶口罩 | 囤藥品 | 恐慌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Online rumors of pneumonic plague spreading across China; analysis: lack of information transparency heightens concerns | Mask rush | Stockpiling medicines | Panic
article.articleSummary: Online rumors claim pneumonic plague is spreading across China after an unknown pneumonia death in Russia, triggering mask shortages and medicine stockpiling. In China, disease control centers in Chenzhou and Yongzhou, Hunan, issued plague-prevention reminders, fueling public concern that plague has reached Inner Mongolia, Shanghai, and Chongqing, and even alarms of city lockdowns. Analysts say the primary issue is Russia's limited disclosure of the deceased's exact cause, which makes it hard to gauge outbreak size and virulence of the strain. Nevertheless, experts emphasize that pneumonic plague is treatable with antibiotics and that there is currently no solid evidence of rapid spread within China, so panic is unwarranted. Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection is monitoring Russia's incident and reinforcing health-screening for travelers on flights to prevent importation.

triage.headline_ja: ネット上で肺ペストが中国全土に拡大との噂、分析：情報不透明が懸念を増幅 | マスク買い占め | 薬品備蓄 | パニック
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの原因不明肺炎死亡を発端にした噂・デマが中国でパニックを引き起こしているが、中国国内での確定症例や急速な感染拡大の証拠はなく、専門家も否定的見解を示しているため、現時点ではフルRRAに進めるだけの確証がない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアでの原因不明肺炎死亡を発端とした『肺ペスト拡大』というネット上の噂であり、実際の中国国内での確定症例情報はない。湖南省疾病対策センターの予防注意喚起が噂を助長したとされるが、専門家は中国内での急速拡大の確固たる証拠はないと指摘。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、中国は公的機関の対応が実在するため含めた。続報でロシア・中国の実際の症例確認状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 鼠疫疑云超一周，俄仍未作出官方解释；国内多地发布鼠疫防护资讯
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague suspicions persist for more than a week as Russia has yet to issue an official explanation; several domestic regions release plague-prevention information.
article.articleSummary: Persistent plague suspicions remain after more than a week as a Russian laboratory worker died of pneumonia without an official cause. Russian public health regulators say thousands of tests on residents and the deceased’s body found no exposure to dangerous pathogens, including Yersinia pestis, and they attribute death to pneumonia of unknown origin. The World Health Organization on Oct 10 said the cause is still unknown and no plague cases or ongoing transmission are reported. Nevertheless, Chinese authorities in Hunan (Oct 9) and Guangdong (Oct 9) released plague-prevention information, and Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia (Oct 10) issued risk notices referencing the Russian case and advising people from Russia’s Far East plague origin areas to monitor health. Cross-border travel has surged since Russia–China visa-free entry began in Sept and Dec 2025, with over 3 million exchanges in 2025 and a 43% rise in the first half of 2026; Russia has become a major source of Chinese inbound visitors.

triage.headline_ja: 鼠疫の疑惑が1週間以上続くも、ロシアは依然として公式説明を出さず；中国国内複数地域が鼠疫予防情報を発表
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの原因不明肺炎死亡例を巡る鼠疫疑惑は1週間以上未解決だが、WHOおよびロシア当局はペスト菌（Yersinia pestis）への曝露を否定しており、中国国内でも確定症例は報告されていない。中国各地の予防情報発表は越境旅行増加を受けた予防的措置であり、現時点で実際の感染拡大は確認されていないため、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 事件の実体はロシアにおける原因不明肺炎死亡例であり、ペスト菌への曝露は否定されている。中国側の発表はロシアからの越境者増加を踏まえた予防的注意喚起であり、中国国内での確定症例は報告されていないため、対象国リストにおけるverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil: Chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleSummary: As of the 39th epidemiological week, Mato Grosso do Sul state in Brazil has logged 10,676 confirmed chikungunya cases in 2026 and 31 associated deaths, according to a Tuesday bulletin from the State Health Department (SES). The report also records 12,275 probable chikungunya cases and 122 pregnant women with confirmed infection. Deaths have been recorded in the municipalities of Dourados, Bonito, Jardim, Fátima do Sul, Douradina, Guia Lopes da Laguna, Itaporã, Ponta Porã, Nioaque, and Corumbá. Among the 31 fatalities, 20 involved individuals with comorbidities, while two deaths remain under investigation by health authorities. The information comes from the SES bulletin for week 39.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル:マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱が流行
triage.triage_reason: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州で1万件超の確定症例と31名の死亡が報告されており、重症度と拡大継続のリスクからフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱はブラジルで地域的に流行している疾患であり、国際的拡大リスクは低いと考えられるが、症例数・死亡数の規模から継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 9000 de cas confirmés d'Ebola en République démocratique du Congo | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 9,000 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | L'actualité
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, with fatalities about half of total cases, across seven provinces and 65 health zones. The latest report notes 88 new cases and persistent community transmission, with many deaths occurring outside treatment centers. The epidemic is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with neither a vaccine nor an approved treatment. Response efforts are impeded by armed conflict, noncompliance with health measures, large population movements, and shortages of medical supplies and facilities. The outbreak has surpassed the DRC’s previous 16 outbreaks and threatens to exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (roughly 11,000 deaths). Kenya has reported an imported Ebola case from the DRC, becoming the second country after Uganda to do so.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定症例が9000人を超える | L'actualité
triage.triage_reason: 確定9,066例・死亡4,381人に達し、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダ、ケニア）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべき重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境例が報告されているが、両国は本トリアージの対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。本流行はBundibugyo株によるもので、ワクチン・承認治療法がなく、武力紛争や人口移動が対応を妨げており、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の死者数超過の恐れがある。

article.articleHeadline: 俄國鼠疫疑雲發酵 中國多地示警引民眾恐慌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rumors of Russian plague intensify as warnings across China spark public panic.
article.articleSummary: A Russian pneumonic plague incident triggers regional alarm. A 28-year-old female researcher at Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute died on Oct 2 from unknown severe pneumonia, prompting fears of pneumonic plague and possible lab exposure. Reports of a second case circulated, drawing WHO scrutiny (Oct 7) for more information. Neighboring countries—Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan—tightened surveillance; Mongolia increased border monitoring. In China, Qinghai, Inner Mongolia, Hunan, and Guangdong issued plague prevention advisories, while Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection strengthened monitoring of travelers from Russia (Oct 12). A self-described China-based P4-lab whistleblower claimed Shanghai and Chongqing patients, but these claims are unverified. WHO says no evidence of sustained transmission; Russia reportedly tested ~5,000 samples with no dangerous pathogen found. Experts in Taiwan, Canada, and Beijing urge caution over information transparency, cross-border import risk, and potential lab-related concerns, amid public panic.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト疑惑が拡大、中国各地で警戒発令し民衆が不安に
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの原因不明の重症肺炎死亡例を契機にペスト（肺ペスト）疑惑が拡大し、複数国が監視を強化、香港も渡航者監視を強化しており、異常性・渡航関連措置の両IHR基準に該当。社会的関心（パニック）も高くPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 実際の確定症例はロシア（イルクーツク）での1例の死亡であり、中国（上海・重慶）での患者発生は匿名の内部告発者による未確認情報とされている。WHOも持続的な人-人感染の証拠はないと述べ、ロシアの検体検査でも危険病原体は検出されていない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれず、中国についても実際の症例発生は未確認のためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от опасной болезни достигло рекордных значений
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from a dangerous disease has reached record highs.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,300 deaths, with 4,381 deaths and 9,066 confirmed cases reported by authorities. The outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri Province and has since spread to other provinces and to Uganda (cross-border transmission). The World Health Organization has labeled it the fastest-growing outbreak in history. A substantial portion of fatalities occurred among patients dying outside health facilities, signaling access and care challenges. As of late September, roughly 3,900 deaths and 8,000 cases were recorded, with ongoing escalation noted by health authorities as the situation evolves across the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な病気による死者数が過去最高に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、死者数が記録的水準に達した上、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準の複数に該当する深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、越境伝播が確認されている点は重要な懸念事項。WHOが『史上最速拡大のアウトブレイク』と評価している点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: 俄国鼠疫疑云发酵 中国多地示警引民众恐慌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rumors of Russian plague ferment as warnings are issued across multiple regions in China, sparking public panic.
article.articleSummary: Death of 28-year-old Darya Shipilova, a researcher at Russia's Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute, on Oct 2 from undetermined severe pneumonia sparked fears of pneumonic plague and laboratory exposure. Rumors of a second case circulated; the WHO requested more information on Oct 7. Russia stated nearly 5,000 samples have been tested with no dangerous pathogen found, and no evidence of sustained transmission by Oct 10. Neighboring Central Asian states Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Tajikistan tightened surveillance, with Mongolia increasing border health monitoring. In China, provinces including Qinghai, Inner Mongolia, Hunan, and Guangdong issued pneumonic plague prevention tips; Hong Kong’s CHP strengthened monitoring of Russian arrivals as of Oct 12. Unverified reports claimed Shanghai and Chongqing plague patients; a mainland P4 lab source warned of earlier infections and potential lab-related risks. Experts caution that information opacity fuels public panic, underscoring calls for cautious cross-border monitoring and protective measures and trust-building.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト疑惑が拡大、中国各地で警戒発令し住民にパニック広がる
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの原因不明重症肺炎による死亡（ペスト研究所職員）を発端に、WHOが情報提供を要請し、中国複数省や中央アジア諸国、香港が警戒・監視を強化するなど国際的な関心と拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 確定症例はロシア（対象国リスト外）での疑い例のみで、ロシア当局は病原体未検出・持続伝播なしと発表。中国国内での患者発生は未確認の噂段階であるが、複数省・香港での警戒発令と社会的パニックが記事の主題となっているため中国を含めた。続報でロシア側の確定診断結果や中国国内での実際の症例確認状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Anápolis adota tecnologia inovadora no combate ao avanço da dengue - Fala Canedo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anápolis adopts innovative technology in the fight against the spread of dengue fever - Fala Canedo.
article.articleSummary: Anápolis launches a Wolbachia-based strategy against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya using Egg Release Devices (DLOs). Starting on Oct 13, 2026, the health surveillance team, supported by 60 endemic agents and teams from the Fire Department and the Frontline Program, will install DLOs in more than 5,000 mapped locations across 45 neighborhoods, including Centro, Vila Jaiara, Jardim Alexandrina, and Filostro Machado, over three weeks. The initiative, a partnership between the municipality, the Ministry of Health, and Fiocruz, builds on prior successes; in Niterói, cases declined by 86%. Officials expect notified dengue, Zika, and chikungunya cases to fall next year. Community participation is essential to maintain traps and report faults at 156. The Wolbachia method uses Aedes aegypti eggs carrying Wolbachia; upon hatching, they do not release adults, but when infected mosquitoes mate, Wolbachia passes to offspring, reducing transmission. This approach complements house visits and breeding-site elimination to control arboviruses in Anápolis.

triage.headline_ja: アナポリスがデング熱の拡大防止に向け革新的技術を導入
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱対策として公衆衛生対策（Wolbachia法）の導入を伝える内容であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や重症例の急増を示すものではなく、既存の対策活動の紹介記事である。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・アナポリス市における媒介蚊対策（Wolbachia法）の導入を報じるもので、感染症の急増や異常事態を示す内容ではない。既存の予防プログラムの一環であり、ニテロイ市での成功例（86%減少）が引用されている。

article.articleHeadline: Awas Bakteri Salmonella! Ini Bahaya Makan Telur Mentah & Cara Aman Mengonsumsinya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of Salmonella bacteria! The dangers of eating raw eggs and how to safely consume them.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 October 2026, a fatal case in Surabaya, East Java, underscores the dangers of raw eggs and Salmonella infection. A baby died after reportedly being fed raw eggs by a family member, prompting IDAI chair Piprim Basarah Yanuarso to warn that undercooked eggs risk causing gastrointestinal infection. Symptoms of Salmonella infection include severe diarrhea, vomiting, fever, abdominal cramps, and dehydration, with the most serious outcomes for infants, young children, pregnant women, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. Beyond infection, raw eggs yield poor protein absorption (about 50%, versus up to 90% when cooked) and can hinder biotin absorption due to avidin in egg white. Safe practices include choosing pasteurized or refrigerated eggs, refrigerating promptly, avoiding dirty, cracked, or expired eggs, washing hands and utensils, and consuming raw eggs quickly if necessary.

triage.headline_ja: サルモネラ菌に注意！生卵を食べる危険性と安全な食べ方
triage.triage_reason: 個別の食品衛生に関する教育的記事であり、単発の死亡例報告のみで、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にParatyphoid/Typhoidが付与されているが、記事内容はサルモネラ食中毒（生卵）に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、腸チフス・パラチフスのアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。単一の乳児死亡例のみで、集団発生の兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola case in Nanyuki turns negative
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Nanyuki, Laikipia County, Kenya, tested negative after analysis at the Kenya Medical Research Institute (Kemri). A 35-year-old woman who worked at a Nanyuki liquor store was admitted to Nanyuki Teaching and Referral Hospital (NTRH) at 5:00 a.m. on Monday with weakness, fever and dry cough; within 24 hours she developed shortness of breath and bleeding from natural openings and skin puncture sites. She reported no travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo or Uganda, nor contact with others with similar symptoms. Samples were sent to Kemri Monday evening. The body was held pending confirmation, the ward cordoned, and healthcare workers protected. Preliminary examinations suggested death from severe anaemia. After negative Ebola results, the body was released to the morgue. Community groups urged calm and called for transparent government communication; a quarantine facility exists in Nanyuki.

triage.headline_ja: ナニュキの疑いエボラ症例、陰性と判明
triage.triage_reason: 疑い症例はケニア医学研究所の検査でエボラ陰性と確定しており、対象国（ケニアは対象外、DRC・ウガンダは渡航歴なし）での実発生事例ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRC・ウガンダが含まれるが、患者はこれらの国への渡航歴なく、検査結果も陰性であったため、実際の感染症発生国は特定されない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Hawaii reports 9th case of travel-related dengue this year | Honolulu Star-Advertiser
article.articleSummary: Nine travel-related dengue cases identified in Hawaii through 2026-10-13, all acquired during international travel in the Pacific Island region; seven on Oahu, one on Maui, one on Kauai, with no links to prior Hawaii cases. The Hawaii Department of Health notes the most recent case was exposed abroad and does not indicate local transmission; risk is considered low, though heavy rainfall last week heightens awareness. Mosquito-control measures have been implemented in the affected area, though specifics were not disclosed. Dengue is a viral illness spread by Aedes mosquitoes; Hawaii is not endemic, and current cases are all import-related. All nine infections involved travel to Pacific Island countries and territories. For returning U.S. travelers, higher-than-usual dengue activity is reported in Costa Rica, Cuba, Malaysia, the Marshall Islands, Panama, Vanuatu, and Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: ハワイで今年9例目の渡航関連デング熱症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 渡航関連の輸入症例のみで地域内伝播は確認されておらず、州保健当局もリスクは低いと評価しており、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも強く該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はハワイ（米国）における渡航関連デング熱の輸入症例報告であり、対象国リストに米国は含まれない。記事中でベトナム・マレーシア等の渡航先国でのデング熱活動の高まりに言及があるが、これは渡航者への注意喚起としての補足情報であり、記事の主題（実際の発生地）はハワイであるため、これらの国は verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo supera los 9.000 casos y deja más de 4.300 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has surpassed 9,000 cases and left more than 4,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpasses 9,000 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths as of October 13, 2026, spreading across seven provinces and 65 health zones. The Ministry of Health reports 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, with 88 new cases in the latest update; a large share of deaths occur outside treatment centers, and community transmission remains a major concern. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Conflict, humanitarian crises, population displacement, and shortages of medical supplies hinder containment efforts. The crisis is larger than previous Congo outbreaks and is approaching the magnitude of Africa’s 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (about 11,000 deaths). Kenya became the second country after Uganda to report an imported Ebola case from Congo last week; Bunia, capital of Ituri province, is among affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、症例数9,000人超・死者4,300人超に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が大規模かつ国境を越えて拡大しており（ケニアへの輸入症例）、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確に認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの症例波及が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株による大規模流行であり、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に匹敵する規模との記述あり。

article.articleHeadline: Focos do Aedes aegypti são encontrados em 684 imóveis em uma semana na Capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aedes aegypti foci found in 684 properties in one week in the capital.
article.articleSummary: In Campo Grande, Brazil, Aedes aegypti foci were found in 684 of 20,364 inspected properties as rains approach, signaling ongoing vector activity capable of transmitting dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. About 80% of foci occur inside homes, with eight neighborhoods at very high risk: Centro, Chácara dos Poderes, Santo Amaro, Carvalho, Noroeste, Nova Lima, Carlota, and Santo Antônio. The Sesau is organizing mutirões, resident mobilization, and educational activities, discussed at the Municipal Arboviroses Committee to target priority areas and involve multiple sectors, including the Army and private partners. Dengue notifications in 2026 total 1,614 (4,603 in 2025); there are 43 chikungunya and 1 Zika case, with no arboviral deaths in 2026 reported. The Ministry of Health cites 57 probable dengue cases in 2026 and 534 in 2025 (1 death). Emphasis on home cleaning, yards, gutters, water tanks, and containers to eliminate standing water.

triage.headline_ja: 州都（カンポグランデ）で1週間に684軒の建物でネッタイシマカの発生源が発見される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・カンポグランデにおける通常の季節的な蚊媒介感染症（デング熱等）対策活動の報道であり、症例数は前年より減少し死亡例の報告もないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体（Sesau）による蚊媒介対策の定例活動報告であり、2026年のデング熱症例数（1,614件）は2025年（4,603件）より大幅に減少している。死亡例の報告もなく、季節性の通常対応として扱われる内容。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo supera la barrera de los 9,000 casos de ébola - Medios OBSON
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses the 9,000 Ebola cases milestone.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD), Bundibugyo strain, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, has surpassed 9,000 confirmed infections and 4,381 deaths as of Oct 12, according to the Ministry of Health. Case fatality is 48.3%. Recoveries total 2,389; 895 patients are hospitalized or in isolation, and contact tracing stands at 79.5%. In the last 24 hours, 88 new confirmed cases were reported, with ongoing community transmission a concern. The eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu are hardest hit, recording 56 and 28 new cases respectively in the latest period. The outbreak spans 65 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. This outbreak is described as the second deadliest and most contagious globally, having surpassed the 2018-2020 regional outbreak, yet far from the 2014-2016 West Africa crisis (about 11,000 deaths and 28,000 infections).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱の症例数が9,000人の大台を突破
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが7州65保健地域に拡大し、致死率48.3%、死者4,381人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的拡大・支援の必要性も高いため。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクは2018-2020年の流行を上回り、過去2番目に死者数が多いエボラ流行とされている。地域コミュニティ内での継続的な感染が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola. Novo ensaio vai testar vacinas específicas contra vírus Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola. A new trial will test vaccines specifically against Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine trial announced by WHO's SAGE in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), using the Tumaini platform to enable randomized testing of vaccines against Bundibugyo and the existing Zaire Ebola vaccine. Immunogenicity data for the Zaire vaccine do not suffice to infer protection against Bundibugyo. Two vaccines are in advanced development: one from the University of Oxford (with Serum Institute of India) and another from Moderna using mRNA technology. Regulators should be ready for prompt approval after results. As of Oct 12, 2026, the DRC reports 9,066 confirmed Ebola infections and 4,381 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), with 2,389 recoveries and 895 hospitalized or isolated; contact tracing stands at 79.5%. Transmission is direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal hemorrhaging.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱。新たな臨床試験でブンディブギョウイルスに特化したワクチンを検証へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,066例の確定感染、4,381例の死亡（致死率48.3%）という大規模かつ継続中のエボラ流行が背景にあり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はBundibugyo株に対する新ワクチン臨床試験のニュースだが、サマリーにはDRCにおける大規模なエボラ流行（9,066例確定、4,381例死亡、致死率48.3%）の最新統計が含まれており、これが主要な公衆衛生上の懸念事項である。インドはワクチン製造（Serum Institute of India）への関与のみで発生国ではないため除外。英国（Oxford大学）も対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Paraíba registra aumento de 16,37% nos casos de dengue e confirma 14 mortes em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraíba records a 16.37% increase in dengue cases and confirms 14 deaths in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Between January and October 2026, Paraíba registered 7,217 probable dengue cases, up 16.37% from the same period in 2025, according to a bulletin from the State Health Secretariat (SES-PB). A total of 14 dengue deaths were confirmed, including two in Campina Grande and four in São Bento; six additional deaths are under investigation in the state. The bulletin also shows a 57.79% drop in chikungunya cases, from 507 to 214. Zika accounted for five cases in the period. The data highlight ongoing dengue activity in Paraíba with fatalities concentrated in specific municipalities, underscoring continued surveillance and response in the state.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ州、デング熱症例が16.37%増加、2026年に14人の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル一州での季節性デング熱の増加・死亡例報告だが、国際的拡大や異常性は認められず、流行地域での継続的なサーベイランス事案として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの流行地域で毎年発生する風土病であり、今回の増加も例年の変動範囲内と考えられる。チクングニア熱は減少傾向、ジカ熱は低水準。州レベルの保健当局による通常の監視報告であり、国際的な懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo supera los 9.000 casos confirmados y se perfila como el mayor de su historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 9,000 confirmed cases and is poised to be the largest in its history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 9,066 laboratory-confirmed infections and 4,381 deaths as of 13 October 2026, with 88 new cases. The case-fatality rate is about 48%, while AFP reports 2,389 recoveries. The outbreak began in Ituri province, centered on Bunia, and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces across 65 zones. It is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy, unlike the Zaire strain. Ervebo doses have been given to frontline workers under a clinical protocol; a dedicated Bundibugyo vaccine efficacy trial is planned in the DRC. Undercounting is likely, with lab-confirmed cases possibly representing only about one third of actual infections. Regional context: Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths this year and was declared Ebola-free in August; Kenya recorded its first imported case, a Kenyan resident in the DRC who died in Nairobi after transit through Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が確認症例9,000件を超え、史上最大規模となる見通し
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が9,000例超・致死率約48%に達し、ケニアへの越境輸入例も発生するなど国際的拡大とIHR複数基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアでの症例報告もあるが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株であることが特に懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : le bilan dépasse les 9.000 cas confirmés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: the tally exceeds 9,000 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases, with 4,381 deaths and a case fatality rate of 48.3%, totaling 9,066 confirmed cases. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, spans 65 health zones across seven provinces, with Ituri in the east as the epicenter, accounting for more than 70% of cases. Since it began on May 15, no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola has been approved, though clinical trials are underway. This is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the DRC and the second-largest globally, following the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ:確定症例数が9,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 9,000例超・致死率48.3%という大規模かつDRC史上最大のエボラ流行であり、ワクチン・治療法未承認で国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大・最も致死率の高いエボラ流行であり、史上2番目に大きい世界的流行。ワクチン・治療法未承認のため国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de SRAG por Influenza B crescem na Bahia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome caused by Influenza B are rising in Bahia.
article.articleSummary: Influenza B–related Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) is rising in Bahia, Brazil, with 1,033 confirmed cases and 23 deaths through September 2026. Data from Fiocruz indicate the second half of 2026 is dominated by Influenza B–associated severe respiratory illness, driving the majority of hospitalizations for respiratory disease in Bahia. An epidemiologist attributes the surge in part to suboptimal vaccination coverage and stresses prioritizing vaccination for risk groups: children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities. Among high-risk individuals, the virus can damage lungs and airways, causing pneumonitis and pneumonia, and increasing risk of bacterial pneumonias, notably involving Streptococcus pneumoniae. In Salvador, vaccination is available at all health units for people aged 6 months and older; required to immunize are photo ID, SUS card, and vaccination card.

triage.headline_ja: バイーアでインフルエンザB型による重症急性呼吸器症候群（SARS）の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザB型によるブラジル・バイーア州での重症呼吸器疾患の増加であり、死亡例も見られるが地域限定的で国際的拡大の兆候はなく、経過観察が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: インフルエンザB型による季節性の重症呼吸器疾患増加。ワクチン接種率の低さが一因とされ、地域の公衆衛生当局が対応中。国際的な影響や異常な病原体変異の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak, DRC and Region, Situation Report #14 (October 13, 2026)
article.articleSummary: EVD outbreak in the DRC, Bundibugyo strain, declared May 15. As of Oct 11, 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths across the DRC, centered in Ituri with spread to Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, North Kivu, South Kivu, South Ubangi and Tshopo, indicating uncontrolled transmission. On Oct 5, a case imported to Kenya was confirmed; the patient traveled from the DRC via Uganda to Nairobi and died. No confirmed cases in South Sudan or the Central African Republic, but cross-border transmission risk remains high due to porous borders and transient populations. Uganda has declared its outbreak over; preparedness continues. Response includes case management, IPC, screening and triage, risk communication and community engagement, with >110 facilities screening and treating EVD. DRC sites have conducted >1,000,000 screenings and treated 2,806 patients (828 confirmed). Training totals 6,451; supported by US DoS, DG ECHO and partners, employing a hub-and-spoke model.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、コンゴ民主共和国および周辺地域 状況報告書 #14（2026年10月13日）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,066例・死亡4,381例と大規模流行が継続し、ケニアへの国際的な症例輸出も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: ケニアへの輸入症例は発生地域として記載されているが、現地での二次感染拡大の報告はないため対象国リスト上のverified_locationsには含めず、DRCのみを計上した。南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国での確認例はなし。

article.articleHeadline: நீா்த்தேக்கத் தொட்டியில் டெங்கு தடுப்பு நடவடிக்கை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue prevention measures in the water storage tank.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention measures were carried out in the elevated water storage tank that supplies drinking water to seven wards of the Chidambaram Annamalai Nagar Town Panchayat. As a dengue-control activity, the tank was cleaned with insecticide powder on Tuesday morning. The intervention targets municipal water infrastructure to curb dengue vector breeding in storage facilities. The report does not mention dengue cases or deaths. It frames the operation as a routine preventive step within Tamil Nadu's urban water systems, highlighting chemical treatment of water storage components to support ongoing dengue prevention and public health efforts. No additional details on personnel, chemical concentrations, or monitoring results were provided.

triage.headline_ja: 貯水タンクにおけるデング熱予防対策
triage.triage_reason: 症例や死亡の報告がなく、日常的な予防活動（殺虫剤による貯水タンク清掃）を伝える内容であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は通常の蚊媒介対策活動の報告であり、症例数や感染状況に関する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Paraná confirma 71 novos casos de dengue desde setembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná confirms 71 new dengue cases since September.
article.articleSummary: Paraná, Brazil, reports 6,191 confirmed dengue cases in 2026 up to epidemiological week 40, with 71 new confirmations since Sept 29, according to Sesa. Total dengue notifications reach 68,154, including 11,682 probable cases; deaths remain six. Regional breakdown: Londrina leads with 1,643 confirmed cases, followed by Maringá (656), Paranavaí (613), and Cascavel (550). Autochthonous local transmission cases number 1,519 in Londrina, 596 in Paranavaí, and 566 in Maringá; 285 municipalities have confirmed dengue. Chikungunya has 167 confirmed cases (1,514 notifications; no deaths). Zika shows 80 notifications since January, with no confirmed cases or deaths. Data from Secretaria de Estado da Saúde (Sesa); information through epidemiological week 40; published 2026-10-14.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州、9月以降デング熱新規71例確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パラナ州での季節性デング熱の定期統計報告であり、新規事例数も既存の流行の延長線上。顕著な異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められないが、継続的なモニタリング対象として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 死亡者数6名は変化なし。年間を通じた定期的な疫学週報であり、既知の季節性デング流行の継続を示すもの。ジカ熱・チクングニア熱も同地域で報告されているが確認症例は少数。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh tay chân miệng ở trẻ: Dấu hiệu nhận biết sớm và các biện pháp phòng ngừa hiệu quả
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease in Children: Early Signs and Effective Preventive Measures
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) in Hanoi, Vietnam, predominantly affects children under 5. During Oct 2–9, 2026, Hanoi reported 286 HFMD cases in 87 wards/communes; 2026 total 6,014 cases with no deaths, across 126 wards/communes. Three new outbreaks were identified in Yen Hoa, Co Do, and Ba Vi; five outbreaks remain active. HFMD is caused by enteroviruses and spreads via fecal-oral routes, direct contact with vesicle fluids or respiratory secretions, and contaminated objects. Incubation is 3–7 days. Early signs include fever, sore throat, and reduced appetite; 1–2 days after fever onset, painful oral ulcers and vesicles may appear on hands, feet, mouth, tongue, inner cheeks, and sometimes buttocks. Diagnosis relies on clinical exam and PCR testing from vesicles, throat swabs, or stool; imaging (chest X-ray for edema, MRI for CNS) as needed for complications. Management is supportive—maintain fluids and soft foods, enforce hygiene, avoid antibiotics and home remedies, and seek urgent care for severe breathing difficulties, dehydration, or seizures.

triage.headline_ja: 小児の手足口病：早期発見のサインと効果的な予防策
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでHFMDの症例数は多いが死亡者なく、疾患自体は既知かつ季節性のもので、現時点で異常な拡大や重症化は認められない。定例的な公衆衛生情報であり続報を注視する。
triage.notes: HFMDはベトナムで季節性に流行する既知の疾患で、死亡例なし。複数のアウトブレイクが継続中だが管理可能な範囲内と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: MSC Cruises Stops New Kenyan Crew Joining Ships as Ebola Spreads
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) since mid-May 2026 has reached 9,000 confirmed cases and 4,339 deaths as of Oct 13, 2026, with all but three deaths occurring in the DRC. Kenya reports its first imported Bundibugyo case: a Kenyan man who had lived in the DRC, traveled to Nairobi while ill, died Oct 5; lab confirmation by the National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI on Oct 6. Contact tracing and traveler screening in Kenya have been intensified; no additional Kenyan cases reported. MSC Cruises has temporarily suspended embarkation of Kenyan crew through Oct 31, 2026; no current itinerary changes, though staffing shortages may occur. The outbreak is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, with over 1,000 cases within 40 days of alerts, in contrast to the 2018 outbreak that reached 3,470 cases with ~66% mortality.

triage.headline_ja: MSCクルーズ、エボラ拡大によりケニア人新規乗組員の乗船を停止
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが9,000例・4,339死亡に達し史上最速の拡大を見せ、ケニアへの越境感染例も確認、国際的な渡航制限（MSCクルーズの乗船停止）も発生しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアへの輸出例が報告されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyoは株名であり地名としてのウガンダ発生は記事サマリー上明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Activités d'éradication de la poliomyélite en République démocratique du Congo (IEP)- S39 - 2026, Mise à jour au 01 octobre 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poliomyelitis Eradication Activities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (IEP) - S39 - 2026, Update as of October 1, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis Eradication Activities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (IEP) – Week 39, 2026, update as of 1 October 2026. AFP surveillance shows 122 acute flaccid paralysis cases notified and lab-received during week 39. Isolates sent for sequencing: 35 to NICD this week (32 AFP isolates and 3 contact isolates); none sent to the CDC. 60-day follow-up examinations were conducted for 2 cases, both located in South Kivu province. No other 60-day follow-up data reported in this update. The data indicate ongoing AFP surveillance with laboratory characterization via NICD sequencing, contributing to poliovirus lineage assessment and outbreak risk monitoring; no CDC sequencing submissions reported for this week.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるポリオ根絶活動（IEP）- 2026年第39週、2026年10月1日時点の更新
triage.triage_reason: 定例のAFPサーベイランス週報であり、新規のポリオウイルス確定例や異常な増加は明記されていないため、継続監視が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 本報告は定例のAFP（急性弛緩性麻痺）サーベイランス週報であり、122件のAFP症例が通知されたことが記載されているが、確定ポリオ症例数や新規アウトブレイクの有無については言及がない。南キブ州での60日後フォローアップ調査が2件実施されたのみで、具体的なリスク評価には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rapport de la situation epidemiologique du cholera en RD Congo (Interne OMS), semaine 39, 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiological situation report on cholera in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (WHO internal), Week 39, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Week 39 of 2026 cholera surveillance in the Democratic Republic of the Congo records 2,932 suspected cases, up 17.6% from Week 38. Four health zones were newly affected in Week 39 (three in Tshuapa DPS, one in Sud-Kivu DPS). Ten zones resumed reporting: Haut-Katanga (4), Haut-Lomami (2), Lualaba (1), Maniema (1), Kinshasa (1), and Nord-Kivu (1). Sud-Kivu, Nord-Kivu and Haut-Katanga together account for about 59.82% of suspected cases. Notification levels remain roughly threefold above the alert threshold of 500 suspected cases per week in endemic zones. In Sud-Kivu, reactive vaccination activities are underway in Mulungu and Shabunda, with community outreach and funding awaiting approval. Vaccination efforts along the Congo River corridor are being prepared, including a joint cross-border plan between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるコレラの疫学状況報告（WHO内部資料）、2026年第39週
triage.triage_reason: コレラ疑い症例が週間17.6%増加し、警戒閾値の約3倍に達し、新規感染地域の拡大と国境を越えたワクチン接種計画も進行中であり、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにBrazil(Paraíba, Mulungu)が含まれるが、記事はDRCのコレラ流行のみを扱っており無関係。地名の「Mulungu」はDRC南キブ州の地名と重複しているため混同に注意。

article.articleHeadline: State confirms ninth dengue case of 2026, a travel-related infection on Oʻahu
article.articleSummary: Dengue on Oʻahu is travel-related, bringing Hawaii’s 2026 total to nine cases. The Hawaiʻi Department of Health says the patient was infected while traveling in a region with dengue transmission and has no link to prior Hawaiʻi cases. All nine cases this year involved travel to Pacific Island countries and territories. Health teams have been deployed to inspect mosquito breeding sites and conduct control; the risk of local transmission is considered low. Residents are urged to remove standing water that can harbor mosquitoes, including buckets, bromeliads, planters, rain barrels and other containers. Dengue spreads through mosquitoes and is not endemic in Hawaiʻi. Risk regions include tropical/subtropical areas, with Pacific destinations such as American Samoa, FSM, Marshall Islands, and Palau, plus Caribbean Puerto Rico; several countries report higher counts (e.g., Bangladesh, Costa Rica, Cuba, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Vietnam). CDC guidance urges travel risk check 4–6 weeks before departure and continued bite-prevention for three weeks after returning; seek evaluation if symptoms appear within two weeks. Symptoms: fever, nausea, vomiting, rash, body aches; typically two–seven days. For suspected dengue, call 808-586-4586.

triage.headline_ja: ハワイ州、2026年9例目のデング熱症例を確認、オアフ島で渡航関連感染
triage.triage_reason: ハワイにおける渡航関連の単発デング熱症例であり、現地での持続的伝播リスクは低いとされ、対象国における発生でもないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はハワイ（米国）における渡航関連デング熱症例の報告。ベトナム、バングラデシュ等は『より高い発生数を報告している国』として言及されているのみで、本事例の発生地ではないため対象国として含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 内蒙古呼伦贝尔发布鼠疫防控提示后删除 当局澄清当地无疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia, deletes plague-prevention tips after posting them; authorities clarify there is no local outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 14, 2026, Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia, posted plague prevention risk tips, later deleting them after the regional health commission clarified there is no plague outbreak there. The notices were routine public education, not an active outbreak. They cited Hulunbuir as plague-endemic with frequent cross-border travel to Russia’s Far East and advised travelers from plague-endemic regions to monitor health and report travel history if symptoms appear. Similar routine alerts have been issued in Ulanqab City during peak outdoor work and tourism. Separately, a female worker at Russia’s Irkutsk-Siberia Far East Plague Institute died on Oct 2 from unknown pneumonia. The WHO said on Oct 10 that tests for high-risk plague pathogens were negative and there is no evidence of sustained transmission, though the exact cause remains undetermined. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis, transmitted by fleas from wild animals, and is classified as Category A infectious disease in China.

triage.headline_ja: 内モンゴル・フルンボイルがペスト予防啓発を投稿後に削除、当局「現地に疫情なし」と説明
triage.triage_reason: フルンボイルでは実際の流行は否定されたが、ロシア極東ペスト研究所職員の原因不明肺炎死亡事例があり、WHO調査済みも原因未確定のため継続注視が必要。
triage.notes: ロシア・イルクーツクの事例はWHOにより高リスク病原体陰性・持続伝播の証拠なしと確認済み。中国側は当局が公式に疫情無しと否定した定例啓発情報であり、対象国リストにロシアは含まれないため、ロケーションは中国のみとした。
